31503.s: The bill amends the annex to the Wet op de rechterlijke organisatie to remove the status of nevenvestigingsplaats from Wageningen, Gorinchem, Winschoten, Groenlo and Oude IJsselstreek, redesignating them as nevenzittingsplaatsen (hearing locations) instead. It is a purely administrative reclassification of court locations, requested by the Raad voor de rechtspraak, with no change to powers of the executive or checks.
31503.j: The memorandum justifies the reclassification by declining caseload, small staffing, and the inability to guarantee required security levels at the sites.
q: At the request of the Council for the Judiciary, on behalf of the courts' boards, the status of the Wageningen, Gorinchem, Winschoten, Groenlo and Oude IJsselstreek sub-locations is changed to that of sub-hearing location.

Op verzoek van de Raad voor de rechtspraak, mede namens de betrokken gerechtsbesturen, wordt de status van de nevenvestigingsplaatsen Wageningen, Gorinchem, Winschoten, Groenlo en Oude IJsselstreek gewijzigd in die van nevenzittingsplaats.

31700-IIB.s: This bill sets the 2009 budget (begrotingsstaat, in thousands of euros) for the Raad van State, Algemene Rekenkamer, Nationale ombudsman, Kanselarij der Nederlandse Orden and the Governors' cabinets of the Netherlands Antilles and Aruba. The explanatory memorandum describes the budgetary figures and policy priorities of these bodies, without delegating rule-making or new executive powers.
q: The present statutory article aims to establish the budget statement for the Raad van State, the Algemene Rekenkamer, the Nationale ombudsman, the Kanselarij der Nederlandse Orden, the cabinet of the Governor of the Netherlands Antilles and the cabinet of the Governor of Aruba (IIB) for the year 2009.

Het onderhavige wetsartikel strekt ertoe om de begrotingsstaat van de Raad van State, de Algemene Rekenkamer, de Nationale ombudsman, de Kanselarij der Nederlandse Orden, het kabinet van de Gouverneur van de Nederlandse Antillen en het kabinet van de Gouverneur van Aruba (IIB) voor het jaar 2009 vast te stellen.

31792-XVIII.s: This bill amends the 2008 budget statements of the Ministry of Housing, Neighbourhoods and Integration (XVIII) and the baten-lastendiensten statement, adjusting appropriations and receipts in the supplementary (Najaarsnota) budget. It sets the effective date as 1 December 2008 with retroactive effect where publication is later.
q: We Beatrix ... have deemed fit and resolved ... The budget statement of the Housing, Neighbourhoods and Integration budget (XVIII) for 2008 is amended.
Wij Beatrix ... hebben goedgevonden en verstaan ... De begrotingsstaat van de begroting Wonen, Wijken en Integratie (XVIII) voor het jaar 2008 wordt gewijzigd.

31965-G.s: This bill amends the 2009 budget statement (begrotingsstaat) of the BTW-compensatiefonds, reducing expenditure and receipts by 45,532 thousand euro in line with the spring budget memorandum. It sets the figures in thousands of euros and fixes entry into force at 1 June 2009, with retroactive effect where publication is later.
q: The 2009 budget statement of the BTW-compensatiefonds is amended as shown in the statement attached to this law.
De begrotingsstaat van het BTW-compensatiefonds voor het jaar 2009 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de bij deze wet behorende staat.

32016.s: The bill amends the Architects Title Act to require two years of professional experience before registration, extends mandatory continuing education to urban planners, landscape architects and interior architects, and replaces the private foundation running the register with a statutory public-law agency subject to the Framework Act on independent administrative bodies. It also adds an information duty for registered professionals toward clients.
32016.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations as needed to make the title law a stronger quality instrument and to keep the register body's operations technical and participatory.
q: The Experiment aims to let young recently graduated architects gain practical experience and prepare them for full professional practice as architects.
Het Experiment heeft ten doel jonge pas afgestudeerde architecten praktijkervaring te laten opdoen en voor te bereiden op een volwaardige beroepsuitoefening als architect.
d: register agency sets further requirements, exam rules and two-year experience rules
ministerial approval of agency rules and guidelines
minister lays down rules on recognised training and diplomas
agency guidelines on continuing education with exemptions
p: The register body moves to a public-law agency under the Framework Act, with ministerial approval, dismissal and intervention powers over its board and rules.

parties: Asks whether the Act complies with the EU directive and whether the new conduct-rule duty adds bureaucracy, how it is enforced and what sanction applies; also questions the representativeness of the governing board.
They wonder whether the current legislation complies with the European Directive.
Zij vragen zich af of de huidige wetgeving in overeenstemming is met de Europese Richtlijn.
Welcomes the bill with approval and raises no check-related concerns.
The PvdA members have noted the bill with approval.
De leden van de PvdA fractie hebben met instemming kennis genomen van het wetsvoorstel.

Regrets the absence of professional protection and the removal of statutory conduct rules and a complaints right for consumers, arguing the Council of State's concerns were not properly addressed; also asks about confidentiality under a ZBO, board pay and the single complaints commission.
In the members' view the drafter made no attempt to substantiate the choice, and therefore chose simply not to regulate the complaints right by statute.

Naar mening van de leden is door de opsteller van deze voorgenomen wetswijziging geen poging ondernomen te komen tot een onderbouwing, maar is daarom slechts gekozen het klachtenrecht niet bij wet te regelen.
Asks on which points the proposal deviates from EU rules and how the government will control administrative burdens and costs.
They do ask on which points the proposal deviates from the European rules in this area.
Zij vragen zich wel af, op welke punten het voorstel afwijkt van de Europese regels op dit terrein.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised against sending the bill on the Architect Title Act to parliament in its submitted form, objecting to the proposed conduct rules and complaints procedure, the open-ended regulatory powers, the proposed public-body structure, and several drafting and transitional points. The minister's nader rapport reports that the conduct rules and complaints procedure were removed, the transformation into a public body was dropped, and most drafting remarks were adopted.
concerns: The Afdeling found the necessity and proportionality of the power to set conduct rules for architects not demonstrated, and the government removed that power.
The Afdeling found a complaints procedure with disciplinary character lacked an independent body and a clear justification, and the government dropped the procedure.
The Afdeling found the scope of the conduct rules too vague and open-ended, which the government addressed by removing the rules.
The Afdeling found no compelling reasons to transform the register body into a public body under article 134 of the Constitution, and the government dropped that transformation.
The Afdeling raised drafting and consistency issues about fees, transitional rules, examination committees and names, several of which the government adjusted.

32025.s: The bill adds rules to the Wft (Financial Supervision Act) introducing licensing and direct prudential supervision of settlement service providers (afwikkelondernemingen), which currently are only supervised indirectly through oversight frameworks. It sets licensing requirements for Dutch-seated and foreign-seated providers, allows recognition of foreign states with adequate supervision, and adds conduct and reporting obligations.
32025.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation by the need for uniform international standards and by the bill's codification of existing oversight frameworks, with the AMvB setting objective criteria for recognising foreign states.
d: rules on designating foreign states with adequate supervision
additional settlement services to be designated by general administrative order
rules on reporting threats to orderly settlement services
further rules on custody, settlement and client information
p: The Minister may designate foreign states as adequately supervised and may withdraw that designation, exempting their providers from the licensing requirement; DNB and AFM are consulted beforehand.
DNB may grant exemptions from certain licensing requirements if the aim is achieved otherwise, without a statutory standard for such exemptions.
Providers must immediately report threats to orderly settlement to DNB, which informs the AFM.

parties: Asks the government to explain the necessity of the bill, what changes from indirect to direct supervision, and how double supervision is limited.
In addition, these members wonder what exactly changes with the shift from indirect to direct supervision of clearing firms.
Daarnaast vragen deze leden zich af wat er nu precies verandert door de overgang van indirect naar direct toezicht op afwikkelondernemingen.
Asks why the bill is needed when the current system functions satisfactorily, what the Raad van State thinks of the current version, and how supervisors AFM and DNB coordinate.
Thus the members ask why there is a need for this proposal if the current supervisory system, as the Raad van State notes, functions satisfactorily.
Zo vragen de leden waarom er behoefte is aan dit voorstel als het huidige systeem van toezicht, zoals de Raad van State opmerkt, naar tevredenheid functioneert.
Asks the government to confirm that amendments avoid creating a form of indirect supervision by clearing firms, and about EU-level gaps and coordination.
The VVD members ask the government to confirm that these amendments prevent a form of indirect supervision by the clearing firms from arising.
De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen de regering te bevestigen dat met deze aanpassingen wordt voorkomen dat er een vorm van indirect toezicht door de afwikkelondernemingen ontstaat.
Asks whether the bill removes the remaining indirect supervision (oversight), what this means for systemic supervision, and why the firm itself requested supervision.
Does the remainder of the indirect supervision, the so-called oversight, disappear through this bill?
Verdwijnt de rest van het indirecte toezicht, het zogenaamde oversight, door dit wetsvoorstel?

v.summary: The Raad van State advised in 2007 on a bill adding a sixth part to the Wft for systemic supervision of clearing and settlement undertakings, raising concerns about scope, enforcement, EU law compatibility, participant relations, competition overlap and broad delegation, and advising reconsideration before submission. The government's 2009 nader rapport accepts most points, amends the bill on scope, enforcement, EU law (notification and exemption rules), delegation and competition, and reorganises the provisions into existing Wft parts.
concerns: The bill's scope criterion 'afwikkeldiensten verlenen in Nederland' is unclear and risks legal inequality; the government added paragraphs clarifying when services are provided into the Netherlands.
The Raad questioned the necessity of direct supervision given the functioning existing system; the government did not abandon the bill but dropped the 'aanmerkelijke invloed' limitation.

Enforcement across borders is problematic because the provider need not be established in the Netherlands and there is no harmonisation or mutual assistance; the government amended the bill to prohibit services from non-designated states.

Requirement to obtain a Dutch licence for foreign-established undertakings may breach EU free movement of services and MiFID rules; the government restructured the regime with designated-state exemptions and notifications.
The shared responsibility for participants creates indirect supervision and uncertainty about supervisory responsibilities; the government deleted the relevant provisions.
Overlap with competition law (Mededingingswet, Article 82 EC) was unclear in purpose and necessity; the government removed the competition-related paragraphs.

Broad delegation and subdelegation provisions (articles 4:76d and 6:16) were inadequately motivated; the government deleted article 4:76d and grounded regulatory power in article 3:17 with explanation.

32052.s: The bill strengthens the position of the referent (sponsor) in ordinary immigration law by letting referents apply through a recognised-referent procedure and faster entry, and introduces a referent register, information and administration duties, care duties and fines. It also regulates supervision of referents by IND officials, cost recovery of expulsion from referents, and allows delegation of further rules by general administrative order and ministerial regulation.
32052.j: The memorandum justifies delegation as needed to fix technical and procedural detail and to ensure effective supervision and enforcement of referent duties.
q: To ensure these duties are actually met, compliance by the referent is monitored and an administrative fine may be imposed for any established violation.

Om te waarborgen dat deze ook daadwerkelijk worden genomen, wordt op de naleving door de referent van diens verplichtingen toegezien (paragraaf 5) en kan bij geconstateerde overtreding een bestuurlijke boete worden opgelegd (paragraaf 2.5).
d: rules on who may act as referent and referent care duties
administrations and data the referent must supply
application and processing rules for recognition as referent
data and administrations exempt from direct verification, own declarations
extending supervision of referents to police officers
obligations to provide and administer information
level of administrative fines for referents
rules on recovering expulsion costs from referents
p: The minister decides whether to recognise, refuse, suspend or withdraw referent status, giving broad discretion over access to the faster procedure, subject to stated grounds and appeal.
The minister may obtain data directly from administrations, refuse or suspend recognition on broad grounds such as reliability and conformity with a code of conduct.
Applicants may submit own declarations instead of documents, and the IND may still demand the underlying data at any time.
Administrative fines up to EUR 2000 may be imposed on referents, increased by 50 percent for repeat violations, without criminal procedure.
Expulsion costs may be recovered from the referent or former referent, enforced by dwangbevel.
A central migration administration is created and public bodies must supply data to the minister, subject to a privacy proportionality limit.

parties: Asks how sponsor oversight and enforcement will work, whether sponsors can be excluded for abuse, and whether sponsor duties conflict with EU directives.
The CDA members stated in the discussion of the Blueprint that they attach great importance to thorough control of persons, institutions and companies acting as recognised sponsors.

De leden van de CDA-fractie hebben bij de bespreking van de Blauwdruk modern migratiebeleid aangegeven zeer te hechten aan een gedegen controle op personen, instellingen en ondernemingen die als erkend referent gaan optreden.
Asks for concrete sponsor duties, supervision intensity, and whether the IND has enough capacity; seeks clarity on responsibilities between sponsor, state and migrant.
The PvdA members ask whether the government can state precisely when being a sponsor begins and ends.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie vragen of de regering kan aangeven wanneer het zijn van referent precies begint en eindigt.
Opposes active labour migration exploiting workers and harming origin countries; wants stronger oversight, suspension of recognised sponsors and attention to housing and data correction rights.
The SP members believe more powers for sponsors must go together with strengthened supervision and enforcement.
De leden van de SP-fractie zijn van mening dat meer bevoegdheden voor referenten zullen moeten samengaan met versterkt toezicht en handhaving.
Questions whether the bill achieves selective migration, asks about sanctions discretion, boundaries of sponsor liability for removal costs, and the role of parliament in lower regulation.
Fears relaxing the mvv requirement rewards illegal stay and that loosening elderly-migrant policy increases costs; asks whether sponsors committing fraud should be permanently excluded.
The PVV members fear such a policy relaxation rewards illegal residence in the Netherlands.
De leden van de PVV-fractie vrezen dat een dergelijke beleidsversoepeling leidt tot een beloning van illegaal verblijf in Nederland.
Asks how the accuracy of data reused across agencies is guaranteed and how the Chamber will be involved in lower regulation.
These members ask the government to explain how the accuracy of this data is guaranteed.
Deze leden verzoeken de regering toe te lichten op welke wijze de juistheid van deze gegevens gewaarborgd wordt.
Asks about risks of misuse of recognised sponsor status, how supervision is organised, and whether education institutions can impose conditions on students.
The SGP members ask to what extent there is a risk that recognised sponsor status is used for improper purposes.
De leden van de SGP-fractie vragen in hoeverre er risico bestaat dat de status als erkende referent voor oneigenlijke doelen wordt gebruikt.

v.summary: The Council of State advised on the Wet modern migratiebeleid, which strengthens the referent's position in regular immigration law and speeds up procedures, supporting its aim but raising objections on the added value of referent status, conflicts with EU directives and Turkish association law, the vagueness of care duties, and enforcement and legal protection. The government's reply (nader rapport) accepted several points, such as clarifying the duties, timing, and legal remedies, but rejected others, such as dropping ex officio referent designation for directive-based residents and the Turkish workers exemption.
concerns: The Council doubts that ex officio referent designation and requiring a referent for Turkish workers are compatible with EU immigration directives and the standstill clause of Decision 1/80, and advises dropping them; the government rejected this for directive-based residents and only partly accepted it for Turkish workers, citing an unclear case law position.

The Council questions whether the referent system adds value over existing convenants and the knowledge-migrant scheme, and asks for evidence of current problems; the government clarified the convenant weaknesses but provided limited empirical data.

The Council advises that the core elements of referent care duties be set out in the statute itself and that sanctions not rest on codes of conduct; the government rejected putting more elements in the law, though it clarified the codes will not be sanctioned.
The Council raises whether the administrative fines and penalties are proportionate; the government pointed to the general proportionality rule in the General Administrative Law Act.

The Council asks whether supervision from behind the desk can be effective enough to base fines and criminal sanctions on; the government explained the information sources and investigation methods IND will use.

The Council asks for alignment of legal remedies and deadlines between the referent scheme and the aliens procedural law; the government confirmed the four-week deadline applies and clarified the remedies.
The Council made redactional remarks, including on article 14, article 24 and article 107 purpose limitation; these were largely adopted.

32123-IIB.s: This bill sets the 2010 budget (begrotingsstaat) for the Raad van State, Algemene Rekenkamer, Nationale ombudsman, Kanselarij der Nederlandse Orden and the governors' offices of the Netherlands Antilles and Aruba, in thousands of euros. It takes effect on 1 January 2010 or retroactively from that date if published later.
q: The budget statement attached to this law for the Raad van State, Algemene Rekenkamer, Nationale ombudsman, Kanselarij der Nederlandse Orden, and the governors' offices of the Netherlands Antilles and Aruba (IIB) for 2010 is established.

De bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat van de Raad van State, de Algemene Rekenkamer, de Nationale ombudsman, de Kanselarij der Nederlandse Orden, het kabinet van de Gouverneur van de Nederlandse Antillen en het kabinet van de Gouverneur van Aruba (IIB) voor het jaar 2010 wordt vastgesteld.

32133.s: The bill makes technical and editorial amendments to several Dutch tax laws (income tax, wage tax, VAT, BPM, collection and general tax acts) for fiscal year 2010, including adjusted disability thresholds, cross-references and retroactive effective dates. It contains no notable delegation of rule-making power or shift of power to the executive.
32133.j: The memorandum justifies the changes as corrections of erroneous cross-references and outdated statutory references, not as new executive powers.
q: Article 19g, fourth paragraph, subsection c, of the Wage Tax Act 1964 mistakenly refers to the Investment Institutions Supervision Act.
In artikel 19g, vierde lid, onderdeel c, van de Wet LB 1964 wordt abusievelijk verwezen naar de Wet toezicht beleggingsinstellingen.

32151.s: The bill amends several economic ministry statutes (CBS, chambers of commerce, NMa competition law, OPTA telecom regulator, Verispect metrology, Waarborgwet, and transport laws) to align them with the Kaderwet zelfstandige bestuursorganen, largely removing ministerial approval, veto and steering powers over these independent bodies. It also exempts the NMa, OPTA, Verispect and waarborginstellingen from the minister's annulment (vernietigingsrecht) power and gives the minister new information and consent powers in some places.
32151.j: The memorandum justifies exempting NMa, OPTA and Verispect from annulment by arguing that ministerial interference in individual case handling is undesirable for market and compliance supervisors, and that the minister lacks the technical expertise.
q: Not including the annulment power is linked to the undesirability of politics interfering in individual case handling by this market supervisor.
Het niet opnemen van het vernietigingsrecht houdt verband met de onwenselijkheid dat de politiek zich ten opzichte van deze markttoezichthouder kan mengen in individuele gevalsbehandeling.
d: CBS budget and annual accounts approval
rules on data exchange with CBS
criteria for board remuneration of chamber of commerce
rules on data exchange between minister and NMa
amount above which OPTA contracts or investments need ministerial consent
minister may refuse approval of inspection tariffs above reasonable cost
p: Artikel I, onderdelen E, G, H, J, K (artikelen 9, 11, 12, 19, 22, 24 WCBS)

Removes various ministerial appointment, approval and steering provisions for the CBS, leaving the director-general to exercise the civil service powers and requiring only consultation of the CCS on suspension or dismissal.
Artikel I, onderdeel Z and Artikel II, onderdelen A-W (WKKF)

Removes ministerial approval of chamber of commerce budgets, accounts and regional retributions, and removes the minister's power to approve fees, shifting control away from the ministry toward the chambers themselves.
Artikel III, onderdelen A, F, J (Mededingingswet)

Exempts NMa decisions from ministerial annulment and replaces the minister's prior review of NMa policy rules with a notification procedure, while the minister retains the power to block proposed policy rules that harm the NMa's task performance.
Artikel IV, onderdelen B, D, N (WOPTA)

Exempts OPTA decisions from the ministerial annulment power and makes OPTA investments and contracts above a ministerially set amount subject to consent, narrowing ministerial oversight in some respects while retaining it in others.
Artikel V, onderdelen A, B, E (Metrologiewet)

Extends the minister's information demand power over Verispect and other supervisory bodies, including the right to inspect all business records where reasonably necessary, while excluding the annulment power and requiring a four-yearly evaluation report to parliament.
Artikel VIII, onderdelen A-D (Loodsenwet, Spoorwegwet, Wet personenvervoer 2000, Wet luchtvaart)

Requires that policy rules on competition concepts be set by the transport minister only in agreement with the economics minister, shifting some sector rule-making from the transport minister to the economics minister.

parties: Asks whether the technical amendments affect financial and competition supervision practice, and why the minister's approval of regional Chamber of Commerce tariffs is not aligned with existing approval powers.
The CDA members ask whether the proposed technical amendments to the instellingswetten of these zbo's have consequences for financial supervision and competition supervision practice.

De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen of de voorgestelde technische wijzigingen van de instellingswetten van de genoemde zbo's gevolgen hebben voor de praktijk van het financiële toezicht en het mededingingstoezicht van de regering.
Questions whether the minister can be held accountable for zbo implementation and intervene in individual cases, and doubts the waiver of annulment power in individual cases.

The PvdA members ask whether, where implementation has been delegated to zbo's, the minister must ultimately be able to be held accountable for the quality of implementation and also intervene in the meantime, whether or not at the request of the House of Representatives?

Deze leden vragen of, als de uitvoering is gedelegeerd aan zbo's, de minister over de kwaliteit van de uitvoering uiteindelijk ter verantwoording moet kunnen worden geroepen en ook tussentijds, al dan niet op verzoek van de Tweede Kamer moet kunnen ingrijpen?
Asks whether the Chamber of Commerce regional tariff discretion could produce large differences in charges for similar activities, and how compliance with the guideline is ensured.
The SP members ask whether this approach could not lead to large differences in retributions per Chamber for similar activities.
De leden van de SP-fractie vragen of deze werkwijze niet kan leiden tot grote verschillen in retributies per Kamer voor gelijksoortige activiteiten.
Asks whether the upcoming evaluation of the Chambers of Commerce has been taken into account and what the reasons are for dropping the public-meeting provision of the OPTA law.

The VVD members ask whether the upcoming evaluation of the Chambers of Commerce has been taken into account with regard to the Chambers, and what the possibilities are if in future it turns out the Chambers can be streamlined.

De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen of met betrekking tot de Kamers van koophandel rekening is gehouden met de komende evaluatie van de Kamers, en wat de mogelijkheden zijn, mocht in de toekomst blijken dat de Kamers kunnen worden gestroomlijnd.

32205.s: The bill places the Central Agency for the Reception of Asylum Seekers (COA) under the Framework Act on independent administrative bodies and replaces its single board with an executive board of up to three members plus an independent supervisory board (raad van toezicht) that approves key decisions and advises the minister. It also removes many detailed statutory provisions on governance and finance, leaving the minister wide powers to set rules and information arrangements.
32205.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations and minister's powers by the political sensitivity of asylum reception and the need for effective ministerial responsibility and external supervision.
q: Because of the continuing political and social sensitivity of asylum reception, close involvement of the Minister in forming the COA board is required.
De voortdurende politieke en maatschappelijke gevoeligheid van de opvang van asielzoekers vergt nauwe betrokkenheid van de Minister bij de vorming van het bestuur van het COA.
d: rules on benefits provided to asylum seekers and other categories of aliens
rules on information exchange between minister, board and supervisory board
rules on the structure of the COA activity report
p: Artikel I, H (art. 8, derde en vijfde lid; art. 10, tweede en vijfde lid)
The minister appoints, suspends and dismisses board and supervisory board members, and may deviate from the board's nominations after only consultation.
Artikel I, D and H (art. 3 in the old version, art. 9 on board decisions and art. 9, derde lid)

Operational powers move from the former bureau to a board under ministerial control, and the minister must approve subcontracting of statutory tasks, with only notification to parliament when public authority is affected.

parties: Asks whether the bill expands the Minister of Justice's controlling and steering influence over COA and whether the supervisory board will be genuinely independent or only nominally so.

Asks the government to address the Council of State's point on uncertain future overlap of financial supervision frameworks, and asks how parliament will be informed and can check the government's supervision of COA.
They ask the government to elaborate on this. Is the government also willing to inform parliament annually about the annual report and the detailed annual accounts of COA?
Zij verzoeken de regering hier nader op in te gaan. Is de regering verder bereid het parlement jaarlijks te informeren over het jaarverslag en de gedetailleerde jaarrekening van het COA?

v.summary: The Raad van State supports the bill placing COA under the Kaderwet zbo and creating a supervisory board, but advises strengthening the board's powers and choosing a single financial supervision framework. The government adopted the first advice (stronger approval and consent powers for the board) but did not follow the second, keeping two overlapping financial supervision frameworks, arguing the combined regime is coherent and durable.
concerns: The board's role is a hybrid of internal and external supervision and its powers were unclear, so the Afdeling advised strengthening its consent and approval powers, which the government adopted.

Two overlapping financial supervision regimes (subsidy title of the Awb and the Kaderwet) apply, undermining clarity and durability, and the Afdeling advised choosing one; the government did not follow this.
Several drafting remarks on numbering and wording of articles 11 were made and processed, with a redactional improvement to article 11, sixth paragraph.

32222-IIB.s: This bill amends the 2009 budget statement (IIB) for the Raad van State, Algemene Rekenkamer, Nationale ombudsman, Kanselarij der Nederlandse Orden and the governors' offices of the Netherlands Antilles and Aruba, mainly by raising the Raad van State budget by EUR 4.1 million. It leaves the institutional powers and oversight functions of these bodies unchanged.
q: Amendment of the budget statement of the Raad van State, the Algemene Rekenkamer, and the Nationale ombudsman for 2009
Wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van de Raad van State, de Algemene Rekenkamer, de Nationale ombudsman

32241.s: The bill merges the municipalities of Renswoude, Scherpenzeel and Woudenberg into a new municipality of Woudenberg, adjusts its boundaries with Barneveld and Utrechtse Heuvelrug, and moves the Gelderland-Utrecht provincial border so the new municipality lies wholly in Utrecht. It also makes consequential amendments to judicial district, police and safety region rules and sets transitional rules for council elections and transfers.
q: With effect from the date of reorganisation the municipalities of Renswoude, Scherpenzeel and Woudenberg are abolished.
Met ingang van de datum van herindeling worden de gemeenten Renswoude, Scherpenzeel en Woudenberg opgeheven.

parties: Asks whether Renswoude's own cooperation with Veenendaal is a sufficient alternative and whether the firm opposition in Renswoude should outweigh the merger.
Does the government share the opponents' argument that the administrative capacity of the individual municipalities does not make the merger necessary?
Deelt de regering het argument van de tegenstanders van deze herindeling dat de bestuurskracht van de afzonderlijke gemeenten de herindeling als zodanig niet noodzakelijk maakt?

Worried that the complete lack of support in Renswoude will undermine cooperation in the new municipality and asks about the basis for the conclusion that the three municipalities cannot be seen separately.
Opposes a forced merger lacking local support; notes unanimous council opposition and two referendums in Renswoude and asks why the Van der Staaij motion was set aside.
Support for a merger is one of the important criteria for the SP in assessing the proposal.
Het draagvlak voor een herindeling is voor de leden van de SP-fractie een van de belangrijke criteria voor de beoordeling van het voorstel.
Asks whether the government may allow a small municipality to influence the whole process and whether the proposal meets the government's own merger framework.
Does the proposal actually meet the government's merger framework?
Voldoet het voorstel wel aan het herindelingskader van de regering?
Argues a decision without majority local support is undemocratic and that residents were not consulted, despite the Renswoude referendum results.
The decisions in the various municipal councils were taken, in the view of the PVV, in an undemocratic way, without consulting citizens.
De beslissingen in de verschillende gemeenteraden zijn naar de mening van de leden van de PVV-fractie op een ondemocratische wijze genomen, waarbij de burgers niet zijn geconsulteerd.
Holds that a merger on a voluntary basis is the starting point and that compelling reasons are needed for forced merger; questions whether alternatives were dismissed too quickly.
Since the SGP starts from merger on a voluntary basis, these members believe there must be compelling reasons to nonetheless proceed to a (forced) merger.

Aangezien de leden van de SGP-fractie als uitgangspunt herindeling op basis van vrijwilligheid hebben, zijn deze leden van mening dat er zwaarwegende redenen dienen te zijn om toch tot (gedwongen) herindeling over te gaan.

32250.s: The bill amends the Dutch notarial act following its evaluation: it introduces a new Bureau Financieel Toezicht general compliance and integrity supervision, separates supervision from disciplinary law, expands disciplinary sanctions and shrinks the chambers from nineteen to five, creates a toegevoegd notaris (associate notary) role, and transfers the central wills register management to the KNB. It also expands ministerial and board powers over appointments, interim substitutes, ordermaatregelen and fine/dwangsom powers, and lets the Bureau waive confidentiality for supervision.
32250.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations as technical detail to be set by general administrative order, by KNB regulation or by ministerial regulation, given the evaluation's recommendations.
q: The Bureau will be given the power to impose a fine or penalty payment for violation of rules on a notary's administration or the duty to report on the notary's financial position.

Het Bureau zal daarbij de bevoegdheid krijgen om bij overtreding van voorschriften met betrekking tot de administratie van een notaris of voor overtreding van de meldingsplicht met betrekking tot de financiële positie van een notaris, een boete of een dwangsom op te leggen.
d: reporting and assessment of ancillary positions by notaries
rules on content of notarial deeds
rules for complaints and dispute scheme (verordening by KNB)
grounds for dismissal of notaries proposed by minister
rules on referral of client requests to other notaries (verordening)
content of annual reports and accountant statements (verordening)
duty to report events affecting notary's financial position
rules on quality audits by KNB (verordening)
rules on register for notariat, its maintenance and inspection
advice and investigation by admission committee
collection of fines imposed on notaries
transitional procedure for applications to be substitute notary
rules on traineeship and recognition of qualifications
p: Bureau supervisors may demand access to personal financial records and client files, and the notary's confidentiality is lifted for supervision, with administrative fines and penalties available and appeal to the administrative court.
Disciplinary investigations and pre-investigations are placed under chamber control with an expanded role for the chair, while confidentiality is lifted for the investigators.
I, onderdeel K en Q (art. 14, 26 Wna)
Ministerial proposal may lead to dismissal of notaries, and the chair of the chamber may suspend notaries automatically on certain court decisions.
I, onderdeel H en T (art. 10, 29 Wna)
Appointment and revocation of interim substitutes are placed with the chair of the chamber, with appeal to a court of appeal.

parties: Asks whether the bill adequately tackles integrity problems and whether the BFT is sufficiently equipped, and questions the soft design of intercollegiate quality checks by the KNB.
They ask, however, whether the government believes this bill can adequately address the integrity problems.
Zij vragen echter of de regering meent dat met dit wetsvoorstel de integriteitsproblemen voldoende kunnen worden aangepakt.
Asks how the BFT's enforcement powers and its access to KNB quality assessments will work, and whether it can impose sanctions or file complaints.
These members understand that the KNB can voluntarily give those assessments to the BFT, but that the BFT cannot request them.
Deze leden begrijpen dat de KNB die toetsen wel uit eigen beweging aan het BFT kan geven, maar dat het BFT er niet om kan vragen.

Argues the separation of supervision and disciplinary law is unclear, that the BFT needs adequate resources, and that the KNB's intercollegiate review is too voluntary, favouring BFT inspection rights.
These members attach more value to external supervision.
Deze leden hechten meer waarde aan extern toezicht.

Supports the new exceptions to confidentiality enabling effective BFT supervision, and asks for timing of bringing the BFT under the framework act for autonomous bodies and for the rationale of transferring the testamentenregister to the KNB.
These members favour the new exceptions to the duty of confidentiality and the accompanying privilege so that the BFT can supervise notarial integrity effectively.

Deze leden zijn een voorstander van de nieuwe uitzonderingen op de geheimhoudingsplicht en het daarbij behorende verschoningsrecht zodat het Bureau Financieel Toezicht (BFT) goed toezicht kan uitoefenen op de integriteit van het notariaat.
Supports the bill's aim of improving notarial integrity and quality and forgoes detailed questions at this stage.
They endorse the aim of the bill, namely promoting the integrity and quality of the notarial profession.
Zij onderschrijven de doelstelling van het wetsvoorstel, te weten het bevorderen van de integriteit en kwaliteit van het notariaat.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised on the draft bill amending the Notary Act (Wet op het notarisambt) after evaluation, which strengthens supervision of notaries, separates supervision from disciplinary law, introduces the associate notary, and transfers the testament register to the KNB. The Raad supports the bill's aims but raised objections on overlapping supervision and complaint handling, the BFT's expanded tasks and conflict with the Kaderwet zelfstandige bestuursorganen, lack of a financial section, the BFT name, the breach of confidentiality, the fine as disciplinary sanction, the client-notary relationship, and the powers of the silent administrator, and the government's nader rapport largely adopts these points with some rejected (e.g. no additional bewindvoerder powers, Kaderwet deferred).
concerns: The Raad objected that the BFT's supervisory task is too broad and overlaps with disciplinary law and KNB quality supervision, requiring clearer demarcation; the government redrafted art. 110 and 111b to link BFT supervision with disciplinary jurisprudence and clarified KNB-BFT relations.

The Raad said the BFT is a zelfstandig bestuursorgaan whose expanded tasks must be tested against the Kaderwet zelfstandige bestuursorganen and that the bill should be co-signed by the Minister of BZK; the government replied the Kaderwet does not yet apply and will be brought in via a later omnibus bill.
The Raad asked for a financial section on the BFT's increased exploitation costs, which the government added to the general part of the explanatory memorandum.
The Raad advised renaming the BFT to reflect its expanded tasks; the government deferred renaming pending evaluation reports.

The Raad flagged that breaking the notarial confidentiality duty for supervision and discipline sets a precedent for other professions and asked for broader discussion; the government acknowledged the wider parliamentary debate and said it is considering a vision on supervision of lawyers and bailiffs.
The Raad advised introducing the fine as a disciplinary sanction sooner than the Huls-report uniform regime; the government added a fine as a disciplinary measure (arts. 103 and 103a Wna).

The Raad asked the explanatory memorandum to address how the changed client-notary relationship affects ordinary clients, not just those with improper intentions; the government expanded paragraph 2.5 of the general part.

The Raad noted the silent administrator's tasks and powers are unregulated and asked for rules as in the bankruptcy act; the government added an explicit task (art. 25b) but declined broader management powers as beyond the Wna's scope.
The Raad gave redactional comments in an annex, which the government adopted.

32304.s: The bill amends the Water Act to create a national Delta Programme for flood protection and freshwater supply under climate change, with a government Delta Commissioner who coordinates and monitors it. It also creates a Delta Fund financed largely by budget transfers, with an experimental clause allowing funds to be used for nature, environment and spatial quality measures.
32304.j: The memorandum justifies the experimental clause as allowing integrated financing when additional budget from other departments is available, and the Delta Commissioner as needed to prevent stagnation of the programme.
q: To this end the bill provides the possibility, as an experiment and deviating from the fund's objectives, to spend or subsidise for those additional measures, provided sufficient funds are available (article III).

Hiertoe is in het voorstel van wet de mogelijkheid opgenomen om, bij wijze van experiment en in afwijking van de doelstellingen van het fonds, uitgaven of subsidies te doen ten behoeve van die bijkomende maatregelen, mits daarvoor voldoende middelen beschikbaar zijn (artikel III).
d: content and yearly submission of the Delta Programme
activities and conditions for subsidies from the Delta Fund under the Kaderwet subsidies
experimental use of Delta Fund for nature, environment and spatial quality measures
p: Creates a government Delta Commissioner with coordinating and advisory powers over provincial and water board bodies and access to ministerial information.
Allows the minister, as a ten-year experiment, to deviate from the Delta Fund's statutory purposes and spend on other policy fields without statutory amendment.

parties: Warns against inflation of the commissioner function and bureaucratic burden, and asks how the tension between the commissioner's public signalling and ministerial political responsibility will be managed.
Inflation of the House of Thorbecke must, in these members' view, be prevented, as must additional administrative burden.
Inflatie van het huis van Thorbecke moet volgens deze leden voorkomen worden, evenals extra bestuurlijke drukte.
Asks why the delta programme is set up sectorally and why the commissioner is tied to a single ministry rather than the prime minister as the Veerman committee advised.
These members ask why the delta commissioner was linked to a single department and why the Veerman committee's advice was not followed.
Deze leden vragen waarom gekozen is voor een koppeling van de deltacommissaris aan één departement, en het advies van de commissie Veerman niet is gevolgd.
Argues the programme mainly produces studies and delay, questions whether investment priorities are sound, and asks whether parliament retains oversight and can hold the commissioner accountable.
The PVV members ask to what extent it will be ensured that the House retains a say in the delta commissioner's conduct and the ability to hold him (indirectly) to account.

De leden van de PVV-fractie vragen in hoeverre ervoor gezorgd zal worden dat de Kamer inspraak blijft houden in de handelswijze van de deltacommissaris en de mogelijkheid heeft om hem (indirect) ter verantwoording te roepen.

Sees value in the commissioner but worries about the czar-like position outside the hierarchy, unclear allocation of responsibilities, and undisclosed appointment decision; asks for evaluation and continued parliamentary involvement.
These members ask how the government intends to sufficiently guarantee this involvement of the House of Representatives.
Deze leden vragen op welke wijze de regering deze betrokkenheid van de Tweede Kamer voldoende wil waarborgen.

Doubts the fund's financing is robust, notes the fund's feeding from FES is only a possibility, and says the discretionary subsidy power for regional water works should be a firm obligation giving local authorities financial certainty.

They note that this power is framed as a discretionary may-provision, whereas it seems no more than reasonable to give decentralised authorities implementing parts of the delta programme certainty about the Rijk's financing.

Zij constateren dat deze bevoegdheid geformuleerd is als een kan-bepaling, terwijl het hen niet meer dan redelijk lijkt om decentrale overheden die delen van het deltaprogramma gaan uitvoeren, zekerheid te bieden over de bijbehorende financiering daarvan door het Rijk.
Questions the commissioner's sufficient enforcement power, the fund's funding guarantees, and the exact link to the MIRT, asking for clarity in the law.

Supports the integrated approach and the fund but asks about the boundary between flood and waterlogging funding, which affects regional authorities, and about the commissioner's space relative to ministerial responsibility.
These members ask whether the dividing line between waterlogging and flooding can always be drawn sharply.
Zij vragen of de scheidslijn tussen wateroverlast en overstroming wel altijd strak te trekken is.
Asks that the commissioner's official advice be made public and questions whether the legal basis secures a stable, substantial fund feed, especially after the FES was scrapped.
They ask whether the government is willing to make public the proposals, reports, advice and visions that the delta commissioner must draw up under the proposed article 3.6b and part C of article I.

Zij vragen of de regering bereid is om de voorstellen, rapporten, adviezen en visies die de deltacommissaris, gelet op het voorgestelde artikel 3.6b en onderdeel C van artikel I, op moet stellen, openbaar te maken.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised that the Deltawet waterveiligheid en zoetwatervoorziening bill, which creates a delta programme, delta fund and Deltacommissaris, broadly supports the aim but needs adjustments: the Deltacommissaris need not be set out in statute, the relation to the national water plan, regional plans, MIRT and the hoogwaterbeschermingsprogramma needs clarifying, and a transitional provision is needed. The government's nader rapport accepted most points, rejecting the statutory-basis objection and the reply on reporting, and added clarifications and a consultation duty for decentralised authorities.
concerns: The Raad advised that statutory regulation of the Deltacommissaris and his tasks is unnecessary, but the government kept the function in the law while adding supplementary provisions on appointment, information powers and consultation.

The Raad asked for clearer explanation of how the delta programme relates to the national water plan, the river basin management plans and regional and management plans, and for a direct duty to consult decentralised authorities, which was added.

The Raad flagged risks to administrative speed and cost control from linking the delta programme to MIRT area agendas; the government acknowledged the risks but kept the integrated approach, pointing to separate budgets as protection.

The Raad asked for clarification of the relation between the statutory hoogwaterbeschermingsprogramma and the rest of the delta programme and for explanation of how ongoing projects relate to changed safety norms; the explanatory memorandum was supplemented.
The Raad asked for a transitional provision in Article IV for possible appeal procedures on subsidies under the former Infrastructuurfonds regime, which was added.

The Raad made redactional remarks on article references, costs of the Deltacommissaris office and the scope of Article III; most were adopted, while the call to narrow the policy areas and the reference to civil service rules were not.

32395-I.s: The bill amends the 2010 budget statement of the Household of the King (Begroting van de Koning) by reallocating amounts across its articles, effective from 1 June 2010. The explanatory memorandum also restricts the gift-tax exemption under the Successiewet 1956 for members of the Royal House, except gifts to the King and the presumptive successor.
32395-I.j: The memorandum justifies the gift-tax restriction by aligning it with the Grondwet's exemption provisions for gifts to the King and the presumptive successor.
q: This restriction means that mutual gifts between members of the Royal House are no longer exempt but fall under the normal regime.
Deze beperking houdt in dat onderlinge schenkingen tussen de leden van het Koninklijk Huis niet langer zijn vrijgesteld, maar onder het normale regiem vallen

32395-XVIII.s: The bill amends the 2010 budget of the Ministry of Housing, Neighbourhoods and Integration and the budget for its baten-lastendienst (Rijksgebouwendienst), in line with the spring memorandum. It sets the amended budget tables, uses thousands of euros, and takes effect on 1 June 2010 with retroactive effect where the Staatsblad appears later.
32395-XVIII.j: The memorandum justifies the amendments as a supplementary budget reflecting updated implementation and parliament's budget authority, not any delegation of power.
q: The supplementary budget is intended to submit (interim) deviations from the original budget to the States General.
De suppletore begroting is bedoeld om (tussentijds) afwijkingen ten opzichte van de oorspronkelijke begroting voor te leggen aan de Staten-Generaal.

32403.s: The bill amends several transport and water laws in technical and miscellaneous ways, including a new export-services recognition scheme for vehicle deregistration and an experiment accepting Spanish APK inspections. It also merges the transport consultation bodies into one Overlegorgaan and makes the chairperson appointable by the minister, while adding enforcement powers against persons ignoring public-transport bans.
32403.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations mainly by operational need, such as practical export arrangements, enforcement gaps for traffic controllers and transport bans, and the need to test rules through experiments.
q: In practice it has become clear that current legislation gives no powers to enforce an imposed public-transport ban.
In de praktijk is gebleken dat de huidige wetgeving geen bevoegdheden kent om een opgelegd openbaar-vervoerverbod te handhaven.
d: prohibited vehicle categories and safety/detection-hindering devices
detailed categories, acts and exceptions for banned devices
rules on recognition, supervision method and withdrawal/suspension
further rules on registration exemption for trailers at events
conditions for reissuing driving licences after recidivism ban
experiments on APK acceptance and driver competence rules
minister appoints and dismisses consultation chairpersons and may designate others to chair
appointment of traffic controllers and seizure of their passes
p: Concessioning authority may initiate timetable/tariff changes and then consult consumer bodies only in a modified way.
VI.G-H (Wet advies en overleg verkeer en waterstaat, Art. 9-10)

Minister appoints and removes the consultation chair and may designate others, while the separate consultation bodies and the minister-chairing guarantee are removed, reducing stakeholder independence in consultation.
Broad executive rule-making and recognition/withdrawal powers over vehicle equipment bans and export-services firms, with limited specification in the statute.
Concessioning authority may grant exemptions from the public-transport exclusivity ban, and refusals are no longer limited to the statutory grounds.

parties: Supports the amendments but opposes the personnel clause, arguing it may hinder competition in concession tenders.
The VVD members support the proposed amendments and clarifications, with the exception of one aspect.
De leden van de VVD-fractie ondersteunen de voorgestelde wijzigingen en verduidelijkingen, met uitzondering van één aspect.
Welcomes the changes but asks how municipalities will enforce the public transport ban and what the costs are.
The PvdA members therefore ask the government for additional explanation on the enforceability of the ban by municipalities.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie vragen de regering daarom om een aanvullende toelichting op het punt van de handhaafbaarheid van het verbod door gemeenten.
Supports easing export procedures but wants mandatory APK inspection before export, and asks how the transport ban is enforced and what legal consequences apply.
However, the PVV members consider it a good idea to subject vehicles to a legally mandatory periodic inspection (APK) before they are exported.

Wel lijkt het de leden van de PVV-fractie een goede zaak om te exporteren voertuigen aan een wettelijk verplichte Algemene Periodieke Keuring (hierna: APK) te onderwerpen alvorens deze voertuigen te exporteren.
Criticizes the broad advisory consultation body as undermining the original purpose of the law and asks for a maximum duration of the public transport ban to ensure proportionality.

The current proposal is formulated so broadly (a single overarching consultation body where individuals are invited depending on the subject) that the original purpose of the law is no longer achieved.

Het huidige voorstel is dusdanig ruim geformuleerd (één overkoepelend overlegorgaan waarbij al naar gelang het onderwerp individuen worden uitgenodigd voor overleg) dat daarmee de oorspronkelijke doelstelling van de wet niet meer bereikt wordt.

Stresses that imposing the public transport ban is a serious restriction of freedom, questions legal certainty, appeal options and privacy, and urges a statutory maximum duration as advised by the Raad van State.
For the D66 members, this is precisely confirmation that a maximum duration must be set from the standpoint of legal certainty.
Voor de leden van de D66-fractie is dit juist een bevestiging dat vanuit het oogpunt van rechtszekerheid een maximumduur moet worden vastgesteld.

v.summary: The Raad van State agreed with the bill amending eight transport and water laws but advised that Article 98 Wp2000 should require rules by or under general administrative order on the maximum duration of a public-transport ban that is criminally enforced, citing legality and legal certainty. The minister declined, arguing the legality principle is already met by the penalty provisions and that a fixed maximum is not yet practical, though it adjusted the explanatory memorandum and adopted the editorial remarks.
concerns: The Raad advised that rules on the maximum duration of a criminally enforced public-transport ban be set by or under general administrative order, for legality and legal certainty; the government did not adopt this, arguing the existing penalty provisions suffice.
Several editorial remarks on the wording of articles I, II and VI were adopted in the amended bill.

32421.s: The bill harmonises the definition of income across several Dutch social security acts (Werkloosheidswet, WAO, WAZ, Wajong, ZW, Toeslagenwet, AOW, Anw, IOAW, IOAZ) by replacing terms like 'inkomsten uit arbeid' with a single 'inkomen' and unifying the delegation basis so that the Minister or an AMvB defines income. It also abolishes the Arbeidsongeschiktheidskas and Reïntegratiefonds structures, transfers their assets, and removes several provisions on coordination of benefits and employer obligations.
32421.j: The memorandum justifies the harmonised delegation by stating it creates clarity and allows one income decree (inkomensbesluit), without explaining why content should not be set in statute.
q: The proposal is to unify the aforementioned delegation bases.
Het voorstel is om de hiervoor bedoelde delegatiegrondslagen te uniformeren.
d: definition of income for unemployment benefit deduction
rules for direct revision of disability benefit on resumed work
extension of five-year benefit rule and income rules
definition of income for WWIK benefit calculation
definition of income for sickness benefit
definition of income for allowance purposes
definition of income from work and other income
definition of income for survivors' benefit
definition of income and indexation of exemption amount
definition of income and indexation of exemption amount
setting premium amounts per wage period
p: Artikel I, B (Werkloosheidswet art. 34) and related harmonisation articles
Defining income by general administrative order rather than in statute moves the substantive content of income deductions from parliament to the executive.
Artikel II, Artikel III, D (WAZ art. 58 lid 6)
The Minister may extend the unlimited income-disregard rule to certain groups of persons without statutory criteria.
The Minister may decide that the unlimited income-disregard applies to specified groups of beneficiaries.
Rules for direct revision of benefits upon resumed work are left to ministerial regulation, with a limiting principle in the statute.
Premium wage maxima are set annually by the Minister rather than in statute.

parties: Asks the government to justify the selection of simplification proposals, whether alternatives were examined, and whether the general income decree may change benefit entitlement, amounts or duration.
Were other possibilities for simplification and harmonisation also examined, and if so, why did these possibilities not lead to a proposal for a statutory amendment?
Zijn er ook andere mogelijkheden tot vereenvoudiging en harmonisering onderzocht, en zo ja, waarom hebben deze mogelijkheden niet tot een voorstel tot wetswijziging geleid?
Asks what the consequences for implementation are given that the bill refers to the Wet Uniformering Loonbegrip, which has been declared controversial.

ask what the consequence currently is for the implementation of the present bill, given that the bill refers to the Wet Uniformering Loonbegrip which, as stated in the supplementary report, has been declared controversial.

vragen wat op dit moment het gevolg is voor de uitvoering van het voorliggende wetsvoorstel gegeven het feit dat het voorstel verwijst naar de Wet Uniformering Loonbegrip die, zoals vermeld in het nader rapport (Kamerstuk 32 421, nr. 4 ), controversieel is verklaard.

Supports the aims of simplifying UWV implementation and speeding benefit determination, while asking the government to justify cost estimates and the removal of exclusion grounds, including the UWV and SVB remarks.
They wholeheartedly support the government's aim with this act to simplify implementation by the UWV, speed up benefit determination and increase the transparency of the system for insured persons.

Zij steunen van harte het streven van de regering om met deze wet de uitvoering door het UWV te vereenvoudigen, de uitkeringsvaststelling te versnellen en de inzichtelijkheid van het stelsel voor verzekerden te vergroten.

32430.s: The bill amends the General Old Age Pensions Act (AOW) to introduce an 8% reduction on the partner supplement for pensioners whose younger spouse is under 65, applying where combined income plus pension would otherwise remain at or above 110% of the statutory minimum wage. The reduction is motivated by economic circumstances and aims to avoid increased reliance on social assistance.
32430.j: The memorandum justifies the reduction by economic circumstances, protection of low-income households from social assistance claims, and alignment with the announced income threshold; it does not justify the delegation beyond technical detail.
q: In this part it is provided that rules may also be laid down by ministerial regulation for determining the combined income of the married pensioner and spouse from or in connection with work, as well as the period to which the determination relates.

In dit onderdeel wordt geregeld dat ook voor het vaststellen van het gezamenlijke inkomen van de gehuwde pensioengerechtigde en diens echtgenoot uit of in verband met arbeid nadere regels kunnen worden gesteld bij ministeriële regeling
d: rules for determining combined income from work and the period of assessment

parties: Supports the budgetary aim in principle but questions the threshold rationale, the choice against using supplementary assistance as the Raad van State advised, administrative workability, and the speed of introduction.
The Council of State has been critical on this point.
De Raad van State is kritisch geweest op dit punt.
Welcomes the replacement of the earlier plan and supports basing the reduction on joint household income so the lowest incomes are spared.
These members favour calculating the reduction on the basis of the joint household income rather than the age difference deciding whether people are entitled to an allowance.

Deze leden zijn voorstander van het berekenen van de korting op basis van het gezamenlijke inkomen van het huishouden in plaats van het verschil in leeftijd de doorslag te laten geven of mensen recht hebben op een toeslag of niet.
Asks whether the measure shifts the crisis costs onto pensioners, whether the administrative burden and the feasibility of the 2011 start date are sound, and what alternatives were considered.
Are the consequences of the crisis not implicitly shifted onto AOW recipients?
Worden de gevolgen van de crisis hiermee niet impliciet afgewenteld op AOW'ers?

Prefers the generic reduction over the earlier targeted abolition because affected people could not prepare for that, supports protecting the lowest incomes, and asks under which conditions the SVB can meet the January 2011 date.
These members prefer this generic reduction over the early abolition of the partner allowance for a limited group, because that group could not prepare for this measure.
Deze leden prefereren deze generieke korting boven de vervroegde afschaffing van de partnertoeslag voor een beperkte groep, omdat deze groep zich niet op deze maatregel heeft kunnen voorbereiden.
Argues people cannot adequately prepare for a measure with large income effects and asks whether government trustworthiness is harmed; questions the feasibility of the timeline.
The SP members note that people cannot or insufficiently prepare for the intended decision, whose effects on purchasing power are large.
De leden van de SP-fractie constateren dat mensen zich onvoldoende of niet kunnen voorbereiden op het voorgenomen besluit waarvan de gevolgen voor de koopkracht groot zijn.

Understands the need for budget discipline but asks why the measure is considered proportionate, what alternatives exist, how the timing affects people's ability to prepare, and how gradual cases such as a sick partner will be handled.
These members would welcome a fuller explanation of why the government considers the proposed measure appropriate and proportionate.
Deze leden ontvangen graag een uitgebreidere toelichting waarom de regering de voorgestelde maatregel dan passend en proportioneel acht.

Objected earlier to abolishing the partner allowance and argues the reversal breaks an existing agreement that gave people twenty years to prepare; questions the proportionality justification, administrative burden, and the short timeline, and suggests postponing the start date.
Why does the government choose to break this existing agreement?
Waarom kiest de regering ervoor deze lopende afspraak te doorbreken?

v.summary: The Raad van State supports the bill imposing an 8% reduction on the AOW partner allowance but advises revising the exemption for low joint incomes, which introduces a means-tested (bijstand-like) element into the AOW and raises the question whether this is necessary within the AOW. The government's reply rejects the need to amend the bill, but sharpens the explanatory memorandum to acknowledge the new income-dependent element and its effect on the AOW's simplicity.
concerns: The Raad finds no proportional link between joint income and whether the reduction is waived, a means-tested element that goes beyond the AOW's partner allowance logic; the government rejects amending the bill but notes the point in the memorandum.

The Raad questions whether the bijstand-like income test needs to be regulated within the AOW given the Wet werk en bijstand, and asks the explanatory memorandum to address this; the government adds a passage acknowledging the new element but keeps the 110% WML threshold as necessary to protect low incomes.
The Raad notes the AOW's basic character of predictability and simplicity, which the income test partly undermines; the government adds explanatory text acknowledging this effect on simplicity.

32520.s: This omnibus bill amends many social security and employment laws (child benefit, survivors' benefits, old-age pension, occupational pensions, unemployment and disability benefits, participation budget, social work provision, Wet werk en inkomen naar arbeidsvermogen) mainly with technical and administrative changes. It also adds some delegations to ministerial regulation and a few administrative powers for UWV, SVB and municipalities.
32520.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations and new powers mainly as technical repairs, administrative simplification and reducing burdens on citizens and bodies, citing SVB and IWI views on feasibility.
q: Provided no specific statutory provision stands in the way, the SVB and UWV are therefore entitled to continue the existing practice of deducting transfer costs from benefits paid abroad outside the EU.

Mits een specifiek wettelijk voorschrift daaraan niet in de weg staat, zijn de SVB en het UWV dan ook bevoegd om bij uitbetaling van een uitkering in een land buiten de EU de bestaande praktijk, inhouden dat de kosten van overmaking op de uitkering in mindering worden gebracht, voort te zetten.
d: Artikel II, onderdeel A, 2 (Anw art. 26, lid 5)
further rules implementing survivors' benefit eligibility
Artikel IV, onderdeel A (Pensioenwet art. 37, lid 2)
rules on reporting incapacity to pension providers
Artikel XIV, onderdeel A (WPB art. 5, lid 3)
supplying data and payment when municipality data are missing or deficient
Artikel XVIII, onderdeel A (WVB art. 45, lid 2)
rules on reporting incapacity to pension providers
Artikel XVII, onderdeel B (Wet SUWI art. 73a, lid 1)
which data UWV and SVB may reuse for other tasks
p: Artikel XII, onderdeel B (Wet investeren in jongeren art. 56a)
Allows municipalities and benefit agencies to pay recovered debts directly from a person's benefits to another municipality without the person's consent.
Allows direct payment of recovered assistance costs from benefits or assistance of another body without the beneficiary's authorisation.
Artikel XVII, onderdeel B (Wet SUWI art. 73a)
Allows UWV and SVB to reuse data collected for one task for other tasks, with the data specified by general administrative order.
Artikel XI, onderdeel B (IOOW art. 4, lid 3)
Gives UWV discretion to depart from the one-year limit on retroactive benefit claims in special cases.
Artikel V, onderdeel B (Toeslagenwet art. 11, lid 7)
Limits retroactive claims for allowance to one year, with UWV free to deviate in special cases.
Artikel XX, onderdeel C (WWB art. 60, lid 3)
Lets the municipality offset recovered costs directly against benefits from other schemes.

parties: Asks whether the delegation power for the survivors' benefit act is sufficiently limited in line with the Council of State advice, and why the delegation is broader than just setting up an advisory committee.
Can the government explain why it chose not to specify the delegation power more precisely than limiting it to the possibility of setting further rules on the second paragraph of article 26?

Kan de regering een nadere toelichting geven waarom ervoor is gekozen om de delegatiebevoegdheid niet nog nader te preciseren dan de delegatiebevoegdheid enkel te beperken tot de mogelijkheid om nadere regels te stellen
Asks about the effect of the amendments on entitlement, height and duration of benefits, the relation to the Reparatiewet, and the added value of removing incapacity safeguards.
Can the legislative amendments in the bill still affect the entitlement to, height and duration of a benefit?
Kunnen de in het wetsvoorstel opgenomen wetswijzigingen nog gevolgen hebben voor het recht op, de hoogte en duur van een uitkering?
Doubts that banks or insurers will issue unlimited guarantees to SMEs once the specific guarantee amount is dropped, and questions whether the measure really reduces burdens.
These members expect that such a guarantie will not simply be issued by banks or insurers to SMEs because it would mean an unlimited risk for those institutions.
Deze leden verwachten dat zo'n garantie niet zomaar door banken of verzekeraars wordt afgegeven aan MKB ondernemingen omdat het een oneindig risico voor deze instellingen zou betekenen.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised that the delegation power added to Article 26 of the Algemene Nabestaandenwet be narrowed, since its stated purpose was only to allow an independent advisory committee, and gave several drafting remarks. The government's reply accepted the point, limited the delegation to rules on the second paragraph of Article 26, and incorporated all drafting remarks.
concerns: The delegation power in Article 26 of the Algemene Nabestaandenwet was broader than the stated purpose of establishing an advisory committee and needed to be narrowed.
Several drafting corrections to articles IX, X, XI, XIV, XXI, XXII and the explanatory note were recommended and incorporated.

32610.s: The bill amends the Embryo Act and the Medical-Scientific Research Act (WMO) to allow certain prenatal and embryo research, including research on pregnancy-supporting tissues, under conditions set by the Central Committee (CCMO) or the METC. It also adds a counselling requirement for egg or sperm donation for another's pregnancy and removes the duty to notify the CCMO and the minister of changes to research protocols.
32610.j: The memorandum justifies the CCMO competence by the expected new developments in this field of research and the need for central expertise, and the removal of the notification duty by the finding that the notifications no longer have the assumed added value.
q: Because this is a field of research where many new developments are expected, it is advisable to give the CCMO the power to determine that certain forms of this research are assessed by itself.

Omdat het een terrein van wetenschappelijk onderzoek betreft waarop nog veel nieuwe ontwikkelingen te verwachten zijn, is het raadzaam de CCMO de bevoegdheid te geven te bepalen dat bepaalde vormen van dit onderzoek door haarzelf worden beoordeeld.
d: institutional protocol on support for donation decisions
CCMO may decide which research forms it assesses itself
p: Empowers the central research ethics committee to take over assessment of certain research protocols from local committees, based on its own discretion.
Lets the CCMO assume assessment powers where a local METC lacks the required expertise, and removes the duty to report protocol changes to the CCMO and the minister.

parties: Asks how the purpose of verifying the testability of conduct is secured now that the submission obligation for institutional protocols is dropped.
ask whether and how the second purpose of the obligation, increasing the verifiability of conduct, is secured in the new situation.
vragen of en hoe het tweede doel van de verplichting, het vergroten van de toetsbaarheid van het handelen, geborgd wordt in de nieuwe situatie.
Doubts that dropping the protocol submission duty is justified merely because it is poorly complied with, and asks how conduct is currently checked.
consider that this in itself is insufficient reason to simply drop this obligation on the argument that it is hardly complied with.
menen dat dit op zich onvoldoende reden is deze verplichting dan maar geheel te laten vervallen met als argument dat de verplichting niet of nauwelijks wordt nageleefd.
Asks who is responsible if a seemingly small protocol change brings about a fundamental change after the amendment.
But suppose that small change nonetheless brings about a fundamental change, who is then responsible for that?
Maar stel dat die kleine wijziging toch een fundamentele verandering teweegbrengt, wie is daarvoor dan verantwoordelijk?
Accepts dropping the submission duty but wants a careful explanation of how the legislature keeps watch and how parliament will be involved.
would still like carefully explained how the legislature will keep a finger on the pulse and how the House will be involved in this.
zien wel graag nog eens zorgvuldig uitgelegd op welke manier de wetgever een vinger aan de pols gaat houden en hoe de Kamer hierin betrokken zal worden.
Asks how often they can receive signals from the CEG and whether protocol changes are addressed in the trend analysis.
These members ask how often they can receive a signal in the field of human germ cells and embryos from the Centre for Ethics and Health (CEG).
Deze leden vragen hoe vaak zij een signalement op het terrein van humane geslachtscellen en embryo's van het Centrum voor Ethiek en Gezondheid (CEG) kunnen ontvangen.
Asks whether the CCMO retains the ability to inspect institutional protocols and give directions, and how review will otherwise take place.
Does the CCMO still retain the possibility of gaining access to the institutional protocols and giving directions for this?
Blijft de CCMO wel de mogelijkheid behouden om inzage te krijgen in de instellingsprotocollen en hiervoor aanwijzingen te geven?
Asks how the ban on creating embryos for research will be evaluated.
therefore only want to ask how the ban on culturing embryos for scientific research in the Embryo Act will be evaluated?
willen daarom slechts vragen op welke wijze het verbod op het kweken van embryo's voor wetenschappelijk onderzoek in de Embryowet wordt geëvalueerd?

v.summary: The Raad van State supports the proposed amendment of the Embryowet to allow certain research on foetuses, but raises remarks on extending research that cannot benefit the foetus and on aligning the Embryowet with the WMWO. The government's reply clarifies the division of tasks between METCs and the CCMO, the relation to the WMWO, and makes limited redactional changes.
concerns: The Afdeling asks that the desirability of extending research that cannot benefit the foetus but may carry risks be convincingly motivated; the government explains the necessity and gives reasons, though no such protocols had been submitted to the CCMO.
The Afdeling asks that the division of tasks between METCs and the CCMO be clarified in the explanatory memorandum; the government clarified it in the general and article-by-article parts.

The Afdeling asks for explanation of the alignment between the Embryowet and WMWO, given differing criteria (nieuwe inzichten, minimale versus verwaarloosbare risico's); the government clarified the relationship and the scope but did not move research on foetuses into the WMWO, citing the need to keep the amendment limited.
Redactional remarks are addressed, including making the law enter into force as a whole and a textual correction in the explanatory memorandum.

32700.s: The bill inserts two new paragraphs into the Dutch Notaries Act requiring notaries, despite their confidentiality duty, to disclose information about their special client account to the tax authorities (on ministerial authorisation, for specific transactions) and to criminal investigators and prosecutors on demand. It aims to improve correct tax collection and combat financial-economic crime.
32700.j: The memorandum justifies the new information duty by the need for correct tax collection and effective prosecution of financial-economic crime, arguing that notarial confidentiality creates a black box, and it limits tax requests to specific transactions with ministerial authorisation.
q: The notary discloses to the criminal investigation officer, the public prosecutor or the investigating judge, despite his confidentiality duty under article 22, the information regarding the special account that they demand under powers in the Code of Criminal Procedure.

De notaris verstrekt, in uitzondering op zijn geheimhoudingsplicht, bedoeld in artikel 22, aan de opsporingsambtenaar, de officier van justitie of de rechter-commissaris, de gegevens met betrekking tot de bijzondere rekening die deze vordert uit hoofde van de uitoefening van een bevoegdheid op grond van het Wetboek van Strafvordering.
d: authorisation of tax authority information requests by the Minister of Finance
p: Tax authorities can obtain notarial client account information that was previously protected by confidentiality, limited to specifically identified transactions and subject to ministerial authorisation.

Criminal investigators, prosecutors and examining judges can demand notarial client account information under the Code of Criminal Procedure, overriding the notarial confidentiality duty with limited statutory conditions that rely on existing powers and a prosecutorial directive.

parties: Stresses that confidentiality and privilege may only be breached in very exceptional cases and asks how often courts have found disclosure unlawful, protecting notaries and clients against state intrusion.
The duty of confidentiality and the right of non-disclosure can only be breached in highly exceptional cases.
De geheimhoudingsplicht en het verschoningsrecht kunnen alleen bij hoge uitzondering worden doorbroken.
Asks whether the bill undermines Supreme Court case law that only in very exceptional circumstances does truth-finding outweigh confidentiality, and questions the scope of the information duty.
These members ask to what extent the bill cuts across the existing Supreme Court case law, which holds that truth-finding outweighs confidentiality only in very exceptional circumstances.
