Voornoemde leden vragen in hoeverre met het voorliggende wetsvoorstel de geldende jurisprudentie van de Hoge Raad, die kortweg inhoudt dat slechts in zeer uitzonderlijke omstandigheden het belang van waarheidsvinding boven dat van geheimhouding gaat, wordt doorkruist.
Asks why the bill does not cover other forms of fraud in the real-estate sector beyond criminal activity using notarial third-party accounts.
Supports limiting confidentiality where a weighty public interest exists, while asking how the notary can be sure a request is legitimate and asking about extending the duty to advocates.
In these members' view, that confidentiality duty may be restricted only by legislation and only where a weighty public interest requires it.
Die geheimhoudingsplicht mag wat deze leden betreft louter en via wetgeving worden ingeperkt indien een zwaarwegend maatschappelijk belang daartoe noopt.

Strongly supports the disclosure duty but argues the notary's current interpretation of privilege is too strict and that the notary is vulnerable; asks why a judicial check was not chosen for broader disclosure.
Raises proportionality and purpose concerns, noting the Council of State found the information duty too broadly formulated and asks whether it should be limited to financial-economic crime.
The Council of State is of the opinion that, under the requirements of proportionality and subsidiarity, the proposed provisions are formulated too broadly.
De Raad van State van oordeel is dat naar de eisen van proportionaliteit en subsidiariteit de voorgestelde bepalingen te ruim zijn geformuleerd
Asks whether notaries can appeal to a judge against information requests, whether disclosure should be a last resort, and whether the burden of proof should lie with the Minister of Finance.
Could it not be arranged so that the burden of proof expressly rests with the Minister of Finance?
Zou het niet zo kunnen worden vormgegeven dat de bewijslast uitdrukkelijk bij de Minister van Financiën komt te liggen?

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a bill requiring notaries to disclose data on their third-party-funds account to the tax authorities and criminal investigators, finding the necessity insufficiently justified for regular tax collection and the provisions too broad in scope, and advised reconsidering. The government's reply accepts several points (narrowing purpose language, ministerial authorisation, limiting the investigating authorities) and defends the broader fiscal and financial-crime purposes while retaining the core of the bill.
concerns: Necessity of breaching the notarial confidentiality duty and legal privilege is insufficiently justified for regular tax levy and collection, which the government only partly accepts by pointing to fraud-prevention rationale.

Scope of the information duty is too broad, with no purpose limitation in the statute and no requirement of suspicion of a criminal offence, leading to added safeguards such as ministerial authorisation.
Existing anti-fraud measures aimed at notaries were not shown to be insufficient, and the government's reply maintains that confidentiality is a key obstacle to enforcement.
Information requests to notaries should be a last resort, which the government addresses through a ministerial guideline and authorisation requirement rather than statutory text.
Authority to request data should be limited to prosecutors and examining magistrates rather than all investigating officers, which the government accepts through a prosecution service directive.

33006.s: The bill amends the income tax, corporate tax, wage tax, gift and inheritance, environmental tax and general tax acts to tighten and simplify the tax incentives for gifts to charitable (ANBI) and cultural institutions, including a new general statutory definition of public-benefit institutions in the AWR and a sunset clause for the cultural gift multiplier. It also replaces several existing ministerial-regulation-based conditions and gives the tax inspector discretion to grant, withdraw and attach conditions to ANBI status by decision.
33006.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations on the ground that the existing ministerial regulation's scope was questioned in case law, so the reach of the delegation needs clarifying, and that the inspector must be able to verify compliance.
q: Case law has sometimes questioned whether the scope of the current delegation provision is sufficiently broad to impose those conditions.
In de rechtspraak is wel eens de vraag aan de orde gesteld of de reikwijdte van de huidige delegatiebepaling voldoende ver strekt om die voorwaarden te mogen stellen
d: Artikel 5b, eerste lid, onderdeel a, sub 2° (AWR)
conditions an institution must meet to qualify as public-benefit institution
further rules for applying the withdrawal and eligibility provisions
conditions for treating a cultural institution's whole assets as business assets
replacing the percentage used for the tax-rate adjustment at the start of each calendar year
tax inspector grants, withdraws or conditions public-benefit and cultural institution status by decision
p: Inspector may refuse or withdraw public-benefit status where a related person has a criminal conviction for incitement to hatred or violence, extending executive discretion over charitable status.
Artikel 2, negende lid en Artikel 6 (Wet VPB 1969)
Tax inspector decides on requests and sets conditions by binding decision subject to objection, widening discretion over corporate tax treatment of cultural institutions.

parties: Asks how the 90% public-benefit test is measured, what the multiplier's effects are, and on what basis the five-year evaluation will be judged positive.
Can the government indicate on what basis this percentage is measured?
Kan de regering aangeven op basis waarvan dit percentage wordt gemeten?
Criticises the Geefwet as offering little compensation and questions the 90% criterion, the EUR 100,000 cap and the imbalance of the multiplier for individuals versus companies.
However, does the 90% criterion for use for a useful purpose not lead to endless procedures?
Leidt echter het criterium van 90% aanwending voor een nuttig doel niet tot eindeloze procedures?
Opposes expanding giftenaftrek and the multiplier, and wants stricter conditions such as limits on executive pay and tighter caps on the profit-tax exemption.
The PVV members consider the instrument of a policy decision inappropriate here; a statutory framework is necessary.
Het instrument van een beleidsbesluit achten de leden van de PVV-fractie daarbij niet gepast, een wettelijk kader is hiervoor noodzakelijk.
Asks for the commercial-activities policy decision to be sent to parliament before debate, and criticises the multiplier's limitation to cultural ANBIs and the EUR 100,000 cap.
Can the government send this policy decision to the House as soon as possible, or else postpone the Geefwet's treatment so the decision can be discussed together with it?
Kan de regering dit beleidsbesluit zo spoedig mogelijk aan de Kamer doen toekomen of anders de behandeling van de Geefwet uitstellen, zodat dit besluit samen met de Geefwet besproken kan worden?
Asks how the 90% public-benefit requirement can be demonstrated and controlled, and whether existing ANBIs could be crowded out.
How can it be demonstrated and checked that more than 90% is aimed at the general benefit?
Hoe kan worden aangetoond en gecontroleerd dat meer dan 90% het algemene nut wordt beoogd?

Raises implementation and misuse risks of the cultural/non-cultural ANBI distinction and asks how the tax inspector will judge 'high-quality' culture, and how the Belastingdienst will supervise competition distortion.
Does this not make the legislation unnecessarily complex and create new risks of abuse?
Wordt de wetgeving op deze manier niet onnodig complex en ontstaan er geen nieuwe risico's op misbruik?
Finds the Geefwet insufficiently ambitious given the lack of budget room and asks for room for new forms of philanthropy.
These members, however, believe the elaboration is not very ambitious, as illustrated by the budgetary room that is lacking for a generous Geefwet.
Deze leden zijn echter van mening dat de uitwerking weinig ambitieus is, dit wordt geïllustreerd door de budgettaire ruimte die ontbreekt voor een ruimhartige Geefwet.
Asks why the measures are split across three bills and why the integral tax liability option is limited to cultural institutions.
Can the government explain why it did not choose one clear bill containing all measures on giving, in kind or money?
Kan de regering aangeven waarom niet gekozen is voor één overzichtelijk wetsvoorstel waarin alle maatregelen omtrent «geven», in natura of geld, zijn opgenomen?
Asks for the commercial-activities decision before parliamentary debate and questions the rationale for the EUR 100,000 cap and the exclusion of corporate legal forms from ANBI status.
These members would like to receive this decision before the parliamentary treatment, so it can still form part of parliamentary deliberation.
Graag ontvangen deze leden dit besluit voor de parlementaire behandeling, zodat het nog deel kan uitmaken van de parlementaire gedachtevorming.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised that the bill (Geefwet) on giving to charities be adapted: a sunset clause was placed on the wrong measure, the purpose and expected effectiveness of the giving deduction expansion need to be specified, the negative giving deduction must include the 50% multiplier, and the monument deduction simplification needs fuller justification given the prior evaluation. The government's reply (nader rapport) accepted most points by amending the bill and explanatory memorandum, and largely rejected or did not adopt the editorial remarks.
concerns: The sunset clause (horizonbepaling) was attached to the wrong measure and must be moved to the income tax giving deduction expansion in this bill; the government followed this by moving it.
The purpose and expected effectiveness of the giving deduction expansion must be stated in measurable terms for a meaningful evaluation; the government added this to the explanatory memorandum.
The negative personal giving deduction must also reverse the 50% multiplier amount; the government adjusted the bill accordingly.

The justification for simplifying and restricting the monument deduction is thin and sits uneasily with the 2009 evaluation's finding of effectiveness; the government expanded the memorandum but maintained the measure, stating a future evaluation will test it.
Several editorial remarks, including using the abbreviation ANBI and repeating the definition of institution, were not followed by the government.

33015.s: This omnibus bill (Verzamelwet SZW 2012) amends many social security and labour laws under the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment, mostly technical and terminology updates. It also changes sickness benefit, disability and unemployment rules, and adds a few delegations allowing ministerial and general administrative orders to set terms and conditions.
33015.j: The memorandum justifies the changes mainly as technical corrections and practical adjustments requested by implementing agencies such as UWV and SVB, with delegation used to allow flexibility in timing and procedure.
q: By general administrative order it may be determined that the consent, referred to in the ninth paragraph, first sentence, and the termination, referred to in the tenth paragraph, part b, is granted or takes effect only as of 1 January of any year.

Bij algemene maatregel van bestuur kan worden bepaald dat de toestemming, bedoeld in het negende lid, eerste zin, en de beëindiging, bedoeld in het tiende lid, onderdeel b, uitsluitend wordt verleend onderscheidenlijk plaatsvindt met ingang van 1 januari van enig jaar.
d: timing of eigenrisicodrager consent and termination
shortening the thirteen-week application period in special circumstances
setting time limits and designating enterprises for mediation
transitional treatment of income for sickness benefit
p: Adjusts employer reporting obligations for sickness notification; technical change without shift of power.
Changes deadlines for the employer's reporting duty and the end of the waiting period, tightening timing rules for disability benefit claimants.
Removes an exception concerning cases where sickness benefit law may apply, narrowing the scope of a protective provision for claimants.
Repeals several provisions on anti-cumulation and related Rijk transfers, removing a statutory obligation without a clear replacement.

parties: Asks about digital reporting of workplace accidents, fraud risks from dropping medical certificates, and effectiveness of premium discounts, without raising checks on the executive.
The VVD members have taken note with interest of the proposed amendments to the Verzamelwet SZW 2012.
De leden van de VVD-fractie hebben met belangstelling kennis genomen van de voorgestelde wijzigingen in de Verzamelwet SZW 2012.
Insists omnibus laws meet the government's own criteria and asks for budgetary consequences per measure, plus questions on the reduced employee leeway in new contracts.
The PvdA members attach importance to omnibus laws meeting the criteria the government has set for itself.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie hechten eraan dat verzamelwetten voldoen aan de criteria, die de regering zichzelf heeft opgelegd.
Asks about legal complications for evidence law, statute of limitations for unknown-address cases, and the amount at which premium discounts are effective.
The PVV members have taken note of the bill and wish to put a few further questions to the government.
De leden van de PVV-fractie hebben kennisgenomen van het wetsvoorstel en willen de regering nog enkele vragen voorleggen.
Questions replacing an AMvB with a ministerial regulation and asks how the House can still exercise influence, and asks whether a delegation clause limits employers' freedom of choice.
Can the government explain why the AMvB is being replaced by a ministerial regulation? How can the House exercise influence over the decisions after the proposed amendment?
Kan de regering aangeven waarom de AMvB wordt vervangen met een ministeriële regeling? Op welke manier kan de Kamer na de voorgestelde wijziging invloed uitoefenen op de besluiten?
Asks the government to carry out the evaluation of premium discounts despite the coalition agreement, to examine their effectiveness and level.
These members ask the government to nonetheless carry out the evaluation and examine the effectiveness and level of the discounts.}
Deze leden vragen de regering om de evaluatie wel uit te voeren en hierbij de effectiviteit en de hoogte van de kortingen onder de loep te nemen.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised that the Verzamelwet SZW 2012 bundles technical and substantive changes across social security, pensions and childcare without sufficient cohesion, and advised motivating the omnibus choice or adapting the bill. The minister's reply reports that the bill was split into three bills (pensions, childcare, SZW) and redactional remarks were adopted.
concerns: The omnibus bill lacks sufficient cohesion among its parts and does not meet the criteria for omnibus legislation, particularly the pension and childcare amendments.
Redactional remarks on the child benefit decision (article 12 AKW) and the pension decree article 6 alignment were adopted or noted for amendment.

33024.s: The bill amends the Wet op de zorgtoeslag to add a wealth test: no healthcare allowance is granted if the savings and investments base in box 3 exceeds €80,000 (individual or joint with partner). The threshold is indexed annually by ministerial regulation via the tax table correction factor and may be raised by general administrative order (AMvB).
33024.j: The memorandum explains that the wealth test follows the kindgebonden budget test, and that a deviating test was chosen to limit income effects for allowance recipients; it gives no specific justification for the AMvB power to raise the threshold.
d: annual indexation of the €80,000 wealth threshold via tax table correction factor
raising the wealth threshold on grounds other than indexation
p: The executive may raise the wealth threshold by general administrative order without parliamentary approval, a discretionary change to an eligibility limit affecting citizens' entitlements.

parties: Asks whether the wealth test taxes savings and how the Belastingdienst will estimate 2013 wealth and administrative burdens.
In the minister's view, is this a tax on saving/wealth accumulation?
Is dit naar de mening van de minister een belasting op sparen/vermogens-opbouw?
Questions the justification for the wealth test, the thresholds, the choice to exclude wealth from the original design, and possibly underestimated implementation costs.
Why does the minister think citizens must draw on accumulated wealth to reasonably pay the nominal basic insurance premium?
Waarom vindt de minister dat burgers hun opgebouwde vermogen moeten aanspreken om redelijkerwijze aan de nominale premie voor de basisverzekering te kunnen voldoen?

Asks why the test is placed in the Zorgtoeslag act rather than the general AWIR framework, objects to non-differentiation between single and two-premium households, and fears wealth shifting outside box 3.
Wil de minister dat alsnog overwegen?
Argues the measure is not structural, does not fit the allowance's logic, may hit people with savings or self-employed retirement savings, and is a disguised budget cut.
They ask the minister whether she agrees that introducing a wealth test is not a structural measure and does not fit the system of the healthcare allowance.
Zij vragen de minister of zij het met hen eens is dat de introductie van een vermogenstoets geen structurele maatregel is en niet aansluit bij de systematiek van de zorgtoeslag.
Asks for the basis of the four percent impact figure and the justification for the 80,000 euro threshold.
They further want to know why the government considers the 80,000 euro threshold decisive for whether parents need healthcare allowance.
Voorts willen zij weten waarom de regering de grens van € 80 000 bepalend vindt voor de vraag of ouders al dan niet zorgtoeslag nodig hebben.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division supports the bill introducing a wealth test for the healthcare allowance but asks for a justification of the threshold, reconsideration of the deviation from the Awir, and a fix for non-Dutch-taxable assets of beneficiaries abroad. The government's reply accepts the calculation of the 4-6% affected households, adds a justification and a provision in the Awir for assets not taxed in the Netherlands.
concerns: The Awir deviates from the harmonised wealth test without adequate justification, which the Council asks to be provided in the bill.
The chosen wealth threshold lacks stated grounds for the need threshold, and the Council asks to reconsider the test and the deviation from article 7(3) Awir.
Non-Dutch-taxable assets of beneficiaries residing abroad are not captured by the wealth test, creating a gap and possible unequal treatment.
The memorandum does not explain how the roughly 4% of households affected by the test was calculated, which the Council asks to add.

33132.s: The bill implements EU Directive 2010/40/EU on intelligent transport systems for road transport by adding a new chapter VIB to the Wegenverkeerswet 1994. It lets the minister designate the directive by ministerial regulation, requires intelligent transport systems to meet specifications set under the directive, and allows supplementary rules by ministerial regulation.
33132.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation by the framework character of the directive, whose detailed specifications the Commission will fill in, so supplementary rules must be set quickly by ministerial regulation to meet the implementation deadline.
q: To be able to implement these fillings in time, a delegation provision is included in the second paragraph, on the basis of which the Minister of Infrastructure and the Environment can, where necessary, set additional rules by ministerial regulation.

Om deze invullingen tijdig te kunnen implementeren is in het tweede lid een delegatiebepaling opgenomen op basis waarvan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu bij ministeriële regeling zo nodig aanvullende regels kan stellen.

parties: Asks whether the minister can introduce national additions to the rules by ministerial regulation without the House of Representatives being involved.
Does this mean the minister can introduce national additions to the regulations without the House of Representatives having to be involved?
Betekent dit dat de minister nationale koppen op de regelgeving kan doorvoeren zonder dat de Tweede Kamer hierbij betrokken hoeft te worden?
Wants assurance that the directive is non-binding and that travel and traffic information stays free of extra cost for everyone, and that no obligations are imposed on business.
For the PVV members it is essential that the directive has a non-binding character and that travel and traffic information is available to everyone at no extra cost.
Voor de leden van de fractie van de PVV is het wel essentieel dat de richtlijn een vrijblijvend karakter heeft en dat de reis- en verkeersinformatie zonder extra kosten voor iedereen beschikbaar is.
Asks why the government does not support the Ford Emergency Assistance system while it is supported elsewhere in Europe.
the CDA members ask why the government does not support the Emergency Assistance (EA) system introduced by Ford, while it is supported in the rest of Europe.
vragen de leden van de fractie van het CDA waarom de regering het door Ford geïntroduceerde Emergency Assistance (EA) systeem niet ondersteunt, terwijl dit in de rest van Europa wel het geval is.

Critical of electronic toll collection and whether it opens the door to mileage charging; asks how privacy is safeguarded, especially for eCall, and whether the minister can automatically pass on future EU amendments without parliamentary involvement.
To what extent does this bill open the door to introducing mileage-based charging for motorists?
In hoeverre zet dit wetsvoorstel de deur open om kilometerbelasting in te voeren voor automobilisten?

33141.s: The bill amends the Primary Education Act so that the parental-contribution cap for preschool applies only to children at risk of a Dutch-language disadvantage, and requires parents' written consent before a pupil receives activities aimed at Dutch-language proficiency. It also corrects a cross-reference in the 2010 amending act and sets entry into force by royal decree.
q: This act enters into force on a date to be set by royal decree and may have retroactive effect to a date set in that decree.
Deze wet treedt in werking op een bij koninklijk besluit te bepalen tijdstip en kan terugwerken tot en met een in dat besluit te bepalen tijdstip.
d: entry into force date and retroactive effect by royal decree

parties: Supports removing the written consent requirement and the cap logic but asks the government to clarify the scope of 'entirely outside regular school hours' and the remaining municipal discretion.
These members do want clarity from the government on what it means by 'entirely outside regular school hours'.
Deze leden wensen wel duidelijkheid van de regering over wat zij bedoelt met «volledig buiten de reguliere onderwijstijd».

Asks whether the government's claim that the former minister's proposal would increase segregation is substantiated, and whether leaving the fee policy to municipalities shifts responsibility for national policy effects onto them.
Can the government dispel the impression that it is making municipalities responsible for solving problems that the national government has caused, ask the members.
Kan de regering de indruk wegnemen dat zij gemeenten vervolgens verantwoordelijk maakt voor het oplossen van problemen die de rijksoverheid veroorzaakt heeft, zo vragen de aan het woord zijnde leden.

Asks about the reasons parents do not enroll children in preschool beyond cost, the findings of the Utrecht pilot and why the consent requirement is limited to activities entirely outside school time.
The members therefore ask in what form the government intends to act on the insights gained.
De leden vragen dan ook in welke vorm de regering aan de opgedane inzichten gevolg wil geven.
Asks why there is no uniform national fee rule for low-income parents, arguing that leaving it to municipalities amounts to municipal income policy that is undesirable.
By leaving this to municipalities, municipalities are conducting income policy, these members believe.
Door dit over te laten aan gemeenten, wordt door gemeenten inkomenspolitiek gevoerd, zo menen deze leden.
Asks whether the target group definitions for early and preschool education versus childcare are still up to date.
They ask whether the definition of target groups for early and preschool education on the one hand and childcare on the other is still current.
Zij vragen of de definiëring van de doelgroepen van enerzijds vroeg- en voorschoolse educatie en anderzijds de kinderopvang nog van deze tijd is.

33150.s: The bill amends the Soil Protection Act to reduce administrative burdens, for example by replacing mandatory decisions on soil-remediation notifications with discretionary powers for provincial authorities and allowing certain groundwater extraction to proceed on notification. It also widens the grounds on which authorities can review and refuse approval of remediation plans and reports, and adds a duty for owners of business sites to carry out a further investigation.
33150.j: The memorandum justifies the changes mainly by reducing administrative and bureaucratic burdens and by making enforcement and plan review more effective.
q: With a view to reducing administrative burdens, the mandatory decision is therefore replaced by a power to decide.
Met het oog op een vermindering van bestuurlijke lasten wordt de verplichte beschikking daarom vervangen door een bevoegdheid om te beschikken.
d: notification content for groundwater extraction exemptions
rules on notification timing and categories of remediation exempt from report approval
provincial discretion to withhold approval of remediation plan
p: Provincial authorities may decide whether to issue a decision on serious contamination instead of being obliged to do so, reducing a formal procedural guarantee for affected parties.
Authorities gain wider discretion to review remediation plans and reports against conditions and directions, including the power to withhold approval.
Provincial authorities may designate which natural or legal person must comply with an imposed obligation.

parties: Has no questions or comments on the bill.
The VVD members have taken note of the amendment to the Soil Protection Act and currently have no need to ask questions or make comments.
De leden van de VVD-fractie hebben kennisgenomen van de wijziging van de Wet bodembescherming en hebben thans geen behoefte aan het stellen van vragen of het maken van opmerkingen.
Has no input on the bill.
The PvdA members have taken note of the bill and have no need to provide input on the amendment to the Soil Protection Act.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie hebben kennisgenomen van het wetsvoorstel en hebben geen behoefte aan het leveren van een inbreng wat betreft de Wijziging van de Wet bodembescherming.
Welcomes faster remediation and cost savings, asks whether the 15 changes will be carried over into the broader future revision of soil regulation.
These members are of the view that the proposal will contribute to an accelerated approach to remediating contaminated business sites.
Deze leden zijn van mening dat het voorstel zal bijdragen aan een versnelde aanpak van de sanering van vervuilde bedrijfsterreinen.
Worries that lighter reporting, reduced authority review and less public notification could weaken environmental and health protection and public participation.
The question is whether the reduction in burdens in environmental laws and rules outweighs possible damage to the environment and public health.
De vraag is of de lastenverlichting in wetten en regels op milieugrondslag opweegt tegen mogelijke schade aan milieu en volksgezondheid.

Questions whether the simplification serves remediation effectiveness, the discretion given to provinces and competent authorities risks unequal outcomes, and asks about provincial enforcement capacity.

The D66 members ask the government to explain to what extent the amendments, primarily aimed at reducing burdens, could unintentionally result in a lower environmental effect than under current legislation.

De leden van de D66-fractie vragen de regering uiteen te zetten in hoeverre de primair op lastenvermindering beoogde aanpassingen van de wet zouden kunnen leiden tot het al dan niet onbedoeld realiseren van een lager milieueffect dan onder de vigerende wetgeving.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division supports the Wet bodembescherming amendment aimed at reducing administrative burdens but objects that it lacks analysis of effects on soil protection and advises clarifying building before approval of the remediation plan. The State Secretary's reply adds an environmental effects analysis, justifies urgency, and reformulates the building condition as part of the decision under art. 29/37 Wbb.
concerns: The Council objects that the bill's reduction of permit decisions lacks analysis of its consequences for the current level of soil protection, and the reply adds an environmental effects analysis.
The Council questions proceeding with far-reaching changes ahead of a fundamental revision of soil and environmental law, and the reply explains the urgency but only supplements the memorandum.
The Council finds unclear who decides whether building obstructs remediation and how this is enforced, and the reply moves the condition into the Wbb decision under articles 29 and 37.
Several redactional remarks on terminology and article references are adopted in the bill.

33204.s: The bill amends the Algemene Wet Bijzondere Ziektekosten and the Wet maatschappelijke ondersteuning so that the level of co-payments for care can also depend on the insured person's and spouse's wealth, in addition to income. It also extends the CAK's role in the AWBZ collection and data provisions, and takes effect on 1 January 2013.
33204.j: The memorandum explains that the existing amvb power in article 6(4) AWBZ is extended so co-payments can also be made dependent on the insured person's and spouse's income, which the bill adds wealth to.
q: It may be determined that this contribution is also made dependent on the income of the insured person and their spouse.
Daarbij kan worden bepaald dat deze bijdrage mede afhankelijk gesteld wordt van het inkomen van de verzekerde en zijn echtgenoot.
d: ARTIKEL I A (article 6, fourth paragraph AWBZ)
conditions and level of co-payments tied to income and wealth

parties: Asks the government whether municipalities are applying income limits unlawfully in the Wmo and whether the VNG has informed them that this is not allowed.
The VVD members have repeatedly drawn attention to the fact that some municipalities unlawfully applied income limits in the Wmo contrary to the law.
De leden van de VVD-fractie hebben al meerdere keren aandacht gevraagd voor het feit dat er gemeenten zijn/waren die onterecht en in strijd met de wet inkomensgrenzen hanteerden in de Wmo.
Objects to introducing the wealth test without broader financing reform and asks why no evaluation clause is included to monitor income effects on client groups.
These members find an evaluation clause very appropriate, given the many health care measures of recent years and the very diverse client groups affected by this measure.

Deze leden vinden dat een evaluatiebepaling zeer op zijn plaats is, gezien de veelheid aan maatregelen in de zorg van de afgelopen termijn en de zeer uiteenlopende cliëntengroepen waarop deze maatregel betrekking heeft.
Asks a single question about the expected implementation costs of the amendments.
The PVV members ask what expectation the government has regarding the level of implementation costs of these legislative amendments.
De leden van de PVV-fractie vragen welke verwachting de regering heeft met betrekking tot de hoogte van de uitvoeringskosten van deze wetswijzigingen.
Supports the principle but asks about the choice of 4%, the consequences of income limits in the Wmo, and the cumulative income effects on middle incomes and the deviation from the Awir.
These members find it understandable that municipalities, when compensating, want to take into account the financial situation of the client and/or client system.
Genoemde leden vinden het begrijpelijk dat gemeenten bij het compenseren rekening willen houden met de financiële situatie van de cliënt en/of het cliëntsysteem.
Rejects the measure as a one-sided cut on the chronically ill and disabled, questions whether residents in institutions have any real choice, and asks for cumulative distributional effects.
These members ask the government what choice these people have.
Deze leden vragen de regering welke keuze deze mensen hebben.

Supports the principle of wealth-based contributions but asks why 4% was chosen, how fluctuating wealth and wealth tied up in a home are treated, and whether an exception or appeal route is available.
If not, can the government explain why that option was not chosen?
Indien nee, kan de regering toelichten waarom daarvoor niet gekozen wordt?
Asks technical questions about the wealth definition under the Wet IB 2001 and why socially responsible investments are relevant, and whether the same threshold should apply to all.
Would it not be more unambiguous in the context of this bill to set the same threshold for everyone?
Zou het in het kader van dit wetsvoorstel niet eenduidiger zijn om voor iedereen dezelfde grens te trekken?

v.summary: The Raad van State advised on a bill introducing a wealth-income surcharge (4% of box 3 wealth above the tax-free allowance) for AWBZ and Wmo co-payments, raising concerns about cumulative effects, the departure from the Awir harmonisation framework, the arbitrary wealth base, and the lack of essential rules in the statute itself. The government's nader rapport rejected most objections, defending the approach as aligned with the fiscal system and sufficiently motivated, while making only textual changes to the explanatory memorandum.
concerns: The Afdeling asked for insight into cumulative effects of the various cost-cutting measures on income groups and whether solidarity and an even burden distribution are preserved; the government saw no need for compensating measures.

The Afdeling found the departure from the Awir harmonisation of income and wealth tests insufficiently justified and asked why the essentials were not in the statute; the government defended the motivation as sufficient and consistent with existing delegation structure.

The Afdeling questioned leaving the essential elements of the wealth-income surcharge to lower regulation (Bijdragebesluit zorg); the government pointed to the existing statutory system of general administrative measures and the need for flexibility.

The Afdeling argued the box 3 wealth base is arbitrary, excludes significant assets, and treats comparable persons differently, and the 4% figure lacks rationale; the government accepted the outcomes as aligned with fiscal concepts and chose this over a bespoke regime.

The Afdeling noted risks of avoidance behaviour through shifting assets into excluded categories; the government answered that alignment with the fiscal system limits this, and textual improvements were made to the memorandum.

33213.s: The bill amends the Dutch Opium Act, the Extradition Act and the Opium Act for the Caribbean Netherlands to implement a 1995 Strasbourg treaty on maritime drug trafficking. It extends Dutch criminal law jurisdiction to drug offences committed on board foreign or stateless vessels on the high seas when acting under that treaty.
33213.j: The memorandum justifies the extraterritorial jurisdiction as necessary to exercise enforcement powers under the treaty, with flag-state consent or international law providing legitimacy.
q: In order to act under the treaty, it is necessary that the Netherlands can exercise criminal procedural powers when drug smuggling takes place on a foreign vessel on the high seas.

Teneinde op te kunnen treden onder het verdrag, is het noodzakelijk dat Nederland strafvorderlijke bevoegdheden kan uitoefenen ingeval met een buitenlands vaartuig op open zee drugssmokkel plaatsvindt.
p: Extends Dutch criminal law jurisdiction to offences committed on foreign vessels on the high seas when enforcement acts under the treaty, enabling enforcement against foreign vessels outside national territory.

parties: The CDA fractie has no questions on the bill.
They have no questions about it.
The SP fractie has no further questions on the bill.
These members have no further questions about it.
Deze leden hebben hierover geen nadere vragen.

The D66 fractie asks how suspects' legal protection is safeguarded, including differences in criminal procedure and penalties across treaty states, and what happens after the two-week flag-state period.
Can the government explain how legal protection for the suspects is observed?
Kan de regering toelichten op welke wijze de rechtsbescherming voor de verdachten in acht wordt genomen?

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a bill implementing the 1995 Strasbourg Convention on maritime drug trafficking, supporting its aim but raising points on the jurisdiction clause's terminology ('buitenlands vaartuig' and 'open zee'), the lack of a more detailed regime for boarding vessels, and consultation of the BES island governing bodies. The government's reply (nader rapport) accepted the terminology points by adding vessels without nationality and clarifying 'open zee', declined to create a separate boarding regime citing existing Sv provisions, and explained why consultation under the WolBES was omitted given the treaty obligation.
concerns: The bill's term 'buitenlands vaartuig' should be supplemented to cover vessels without nationality, and the explanatory memorandum adjusted accordingly.
The choice of 'open zee' should be clarified, and the explanatory memorandum was amended to explain the terminology.

A more detailed statutory regime for boarding and taking control of foreign vessels should be created for legal certainty, which the government declined as existing Sv provisions are considered sufficient.

The government should have consulted the BES island governing bodies on the amendment to the Opiumwet BES as required by WolBES, which the government did not do, justifying omission by the treaty-implementing nature of the change.

33222.s: The bill repeals the Wet op de Raad voor de Wadden and the Wet op het Waddenfonds, decentralising the Waddenfonds to the provinces Fryslân, Groningen and Noord-Holland. Existing claims and obligations are transferred to the province of Fryslân, which takes over the minister's role, including in pending appeals.
33222.j: The memorandum justifies the decentralisation by the cabinet's decision to give the Waddenprovincies autonomous competence over the funds from 2012, with existing project goals kept.
q: That means the Wadden provinces receive the autonomous competence to spend the funds.
Dat betekent dat de Waddenprovincies de autonome bevoegdheid krijgen om de middelen te besteden.
p: Pending administrative decisions and appeals move from the national minister to the provincial executive of Fryslân, shifting power from the national executive to a subnational body.

parties: Asks how the RLI's advisory role relates to the province of Fryslân's responsibilities and whether the province must act on RLI advice.
Who is responsible for what, and what is the status of the advice the RLI gives?
Wie is nu waarvoor verantwoordelijk en wat is de status van de adviezen die RLI doet?
currently have no need to ask questions or make remarks.
hebben thans geen behoefte aan het stellen van vragen en het maken van opmerkingen.
currently have no need to ask questions or make remarks.
hebben thans geen behoefte aan het stellen van vragen en het maken van opmerkingen.
Asks whether decentralisation addresses the evaluation's objections to transparency and simplicity, why a new regional college is needed, and whether Germany should be involved.
Can the government indicate why the chosen solution, decentralisation, does address the objections from the evaluation?
Kan de regering aangeven waarom de nu gekozen oplossing, decentralisatie, wel tegemoet komt aan de bezwaren uit de evaluatie?
currently have no need to ask questions or make remarks.
hebben thans geen behoefte aan het stellen van vragen en het maken van opmerkingen.

Supports simplification but asks why advisory tasks were not bundled into an independent college and whether the regional college retains enough authority over the central government.
These members ask whether sufficient enforcement authority remains for the central government with this.
Genoemde leden vragen of hiermee wel voldoende doorzettingsmacht over blijft voor het rijk.
currently have no need to ask questions or make remarks.
hebben thans geen behoefte aan het stellen van vragen en het maken van opmerkingen.
have also taken note of the bill and currently have no need to ask questions or make remarks.
hebben ook kennisgenomen van het wetsvoorstel en hebben thans geen behoefte aan het stellen van vragen en het maken van opmerkingen.

v.summary: The Raad van State advises that the bill abolishing the Raad voor de Wadden and decentralising the Waddenfonds be adopted, but raises points on an advisory role for the RLI toward Wadden municipalities and provinces, the legal status of a new Regiecollege, and missing financial information. The government's nader rapport removes the RLI advisory role, adds detail on the Regiecollege and on financial consequences, and follows the drafting remark.
concerns: The memorie van toelichting did not justify the attribution of an advisory role to the RLI toward provinces and municipalities lacking a statutory basis; the government deleted that sentence.
The legal status, establishing authority and powers of the new Regiecollege Waddengebied were unclear; the government supplemented the explanatory memorandum.
The explanatory memorandum lacked the financial consequences of transferring the Waddenfonds to the provinces as required by the Fv-wet; the government added a section on financial effects.
A redactional remark on the retroactive effect wording in Article IV was adopted.

33240-IIA.s: This bill amends the 2011 departmental budget statement of the Staten-Generaal (House of Representatives and Senate, budget chapter IIA) by adjusting appropriations for legislation and oversight in the Eerste and Tweede Kamer, as set out in the attached budget schedule. It takes effect the day after publication in the Staatsblad and applies retroactively to 31 December of the budget year.
q: The parliamentary groups in the Chamber receive a contribution to costs based on the number of seats.
De fracties binnen de Kamer ontvangen een bijdrage in de kosten welke is gebaseerd op het zetelaantal.

33330.s: The bill amends the Dutch Civil Code and the Rent Price Act so that annual rent increases depend on the household income of the tenant and other residents, using income bands set in the Rent Price Act and a Tax Authority statement on whether income is above those thresholds. It also sets maximum increase percentages to be fixed by ministerial regulation and requires a review report within three years.
33330.j: The memorandum justifies the Tax Authority income statement as a proportionate privacy trade-off, limited to a threshold indication, and says the Tax Authority will not get involved in subsequent proceedings.
q: Because the Tax Authority statement only indicates whether household income is above €33,000 or €43,000, the privacy of tenants and other residents regarding their income is affected as little as possible.

Doordat de verklaring van de Belastingdienst uitsluitend aangeeft of het huishoudinkomen al dan niet hoger is dan € 33 000 dan wel € 43 000, wordt de privacy van huurders en de overige bewoners waar het gaat om hun inkomen zo min mogelijk aangetast.
d: ARTIKEL II, A (Art. 10 lid 2 Uitvoeringswet huurprijzen woonruimte)
maximum rent increase percentage per income band
p: ARTIKEL I, B (Art. 7:252a BW) and ARTIKEL II, B (Art. 13 lid 5 Uitvoeringswet)
Rent increase proposals and the rent commission's review are tied to income thresholds, with the Tax Authority issuing an indicative statement that is not subject to objection or appeal.

parties: Asks whether tenants whose income data are unavailable escape the increase, how appeals are handled, and what the Tax Administration costs are, without opposing the measure.
They ask the government whether the present bill mutatis mutandis differs from the bill on the 5% rent increase above inflation.
Zij vragen de regering of het voorliggende wetsvoorstel mutatis mutandis afwijkt van het wetsvoorstel Wijziging van Boek 7 van het Burgerlijk Wetboek
Objects to tax-income data being shared with landlords, arguing it damages the tenant-landlord relationship, lacks adequate privacy safeguards and may fail the EVRM necessity test.
According to the PVV members, providing a tax income statement to the landlord damages the trust relationship between tenant and landlord.
Het verstrekken van een inkomensverklaring van de Belastingdienst aan de verhuurder schaadt volgens de leden van de PVV-fractie de vertrouwensrelatie tussen de huurder en verhuurder
Questions the proportionality and subsidiarity of breaking fiscal secrecy and the legal basis under EVRM and Article 10 of the Constitution, and doubts the measure's effect on mobility.
The SP members note that breaking the fiscal secrecy obligation is unusual.
De leden van de SP-fractie merken op dat het breken van de fiscale geheimhoudingsplicht ongebruikelijk is.
Supports the measure to promote housing mobility and asks about the Amsterdam pilot with mobility contracts.
The D66 members are strong supporters of promoting mobility on the housing market.
De leden van de D66-fractie zijn grote voorstanders van het bevorderen van doorstroming op de woningmarkt

Objects to mixing rent and income policy at the cost of privacy, questions whether the College bescherming persoonsgegevens advice was properly answered, and proposes an alternative via rent-allowance changes.
The ChristenUnie members acknowledge the importance of a more market-conform rent.Their core objection concerns the mixing of rent and income policy at the expense of privacy.'}],
De leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie erkennen het belang van een meer marktconforme huur
Asks why the government did not adopt the 2% above-inflation increase from the Wonen 4.0 agreement.
The SGP members ask why the government did not decide to adopt the proposed 2% above-inflation rent increase from the broadly supported Wonen 4.0 agreement.
De leden van de SGP-fractie vragen waarom de regering niet heeft besloten de voorgestelde huurverhoging van 2% bovenop de inflatie uit het breed gedragen akkoord Wonen 4.0 over te nemen.
Asks about protection of personal privacy and how to prevent tenants with missing income data from being caught by the rent increase.
They have two further questions for the government concerning the protection of personal privacy and the working method of the rent commission.
Zij hebben nog een tweetal vragen aan de regering betreffende de bescherming van de persoonlijke levenssfeer en de werkwijze van de huurcommissie.
Objects in principle that rents do not fall with income decline below the income thresholds and asks for legislative change to guarantee affordability.
These members do have fundamental objections to the fact that when income falls below one of the income thresholds, the rent does not fall with it to the level appropriate to that income category.
Deze leden hebben echter wel principiële bezwaren tegen het feit dat bij inkomensdaling tot onder een van de inkomensgrenzen, de huur niet mee daalt tot het niveau dat past bij die inkomenscategorie.
Considers the measures undesirable and unacceptable because many tenants will face serious financial problems, and urges lowering rents instead.
They maintain that the intended measures are undesirable and unacceptable, since it has become clear that they will cause very many tenants enormous financial problems.
Zij blijven van mening dat de voorgenomen maatregelen onwenselijk en onacceptabel zijn, daar gebleken is dat deze ertoe zullen leiden dat zeer veel huurders enorme financiële problemen krijgen.
Questions the privacy violation of passing income data to landlords, the legal basis for it, and whether the bill conflicts with European and Dutch law; asks for CBP advice to be taken seriously.
Can the government indicate to what extent it appreciates the advice of the College Bescherming Persoonsgegevens?
Kan de regering aangeven in welke mate zij de adviezen van het College Bescherming Persoonsgegevens apprecieert?
Asks about the coherence with the coalition agreement, maximum rents, the bezwaar process, and effects on low middle incomes, including a request for an affordability check.

The CDA members are concerned about the consequences of a substantial rent increase for people with a low middle income (around 34,000 euros) and ask whether the government can alleviate this concern.

De leden van de CDA-fractie zijn bezorgd over de gevolgen van een flinke huurverhoging voor mensen met een laag middeninkomen (ca. € 34.000) en vragen de regering of ze deze bezorgdheid kunnen wegnemen.
Asks how tenants can defend themselves against privacy violations by landlords and how often incorrect Belastingdienst data will force tenants to disclose detailed income information.
How can tenants protect themselves against privacy violations by landlords if they do not know what happens with their income data?
Hoe kunnen huurders zich wapenen tegen privacy schendingen van verhuurders indien zij niet weten wat er met hun inkomensgegevens gebeurd?

Asks about enforcement against landlords misusing income data, the unclear bezwaar route through the Belastingdienst, the CBP's supervisory role given its objections, and whether the government will amend the bill.
These members also ask how the CBP supervises, now that the CBP itself has stated objections to the bill.
Ook vragen deze leden hoe het CBP toezicht houdt nu het CBP zelf aangeeft bezwaren te hebben tegen het wetsvoorstel.
The SP objects to the rushed passage of the bill and calls for careful parliamentary scrutiny, opting for amendments instead of further questions.
These members regret that a careful legislative process is being thwarted.
Deze leden betreuren het dat een zorgvuldige wetsbehandeling wordt gedwarsboomd.
The SGP questions whether the rent-setting and benefit rules are consistent and fair to tenants, and asks how the temporary suspension of the maximum rent will be arranged.
How are these principles to be reconciled, these members ask.
Hoe zijn deze uitgangspunten te verenigen, zo vragen deze leden.

33402.s: The bill amends the Dutch tax laws for 2013, adjusting income tax brackets, the Wage Tax Act and Wage Tax reduction rules (including the education and R&D deductions), the scholarship expense deduction, corporate tax, transfer tax and collection rules, with a five-year sunset for the education wage-tax reduction. It also grants the executive delegated powers to exclude certain care expenses from deduction, to shorten or lengthen the transfer-tax resale period by ministerial or general administrative decree, and to set thresholds and procedures by ministerial regulation.
33402.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by the need for flexible adjustment to market conditions, budget balance, and fraud prevention, and notes the education reduction is subject to a five-year horizon and evaluation.
q: It is after all a political choice to grant a tax advantage for specific situations, and such a choice is not meant to last forever.
Het is immers een politieke afweging om voor specifieke situaties een belastingvoordeel te geven, waarbij een dergelijke afweging niet voor de eeuwigheid geldt.
d: ARTIKEL I C 6.18 eerste lid onderdeel h
expenses no longer counted as specific care costs
conditions for pension reduction not counted as disposal of pension rights
ARTIKEL V C artikel 5 lid 1 onderdeel g en artikel 30a
lowering or raising S&O reduction percentages
extend or set different transfer-tax resale period for homes and non-homes
notification procedure and threshold value for pledgeholders
correcting conflicting references in tax laws
p: Gives the tax collector a priority claim allowing recovery from pledgeholders and third parties of collateral on a debtor's floor, with a monetary liability enforceable by dwangbevel.
Lets the Minister exempt certain insurer pension reductions from being treated as a disposal, under conditions set by the Minister.
ARTIKEL V F artikel 13 en H artikel 14
Ties eligibility for education wage-tax reduction to statutory study loads and a declaration of intent, with details left to ministerial regulation.
Allows the government by general administrative decree to change the transfer-tax resale period temporarily in response to the property market.

parties: Asks for clarification on pension write-down conditions and the administrative burden of the education wage-cost deduction.
Can it be indicated which condition this concerns?
Kan aangegeven worden welke voorwaarde het hier betreft?
Raises doubts about the effectiveness of several measures and asks how to prevent abuse of the education deduction and pension write-downs.
Criticises the bodemvoorrecht measure as expanding the tax authority's position without adequate justification and asks for it to be split into a separate bill.
Is the government willing to move this part of the bill into a separate bill so it need not be part of the Tax Plan?
Is de regering bereid om dit stuk van het wetsvoorstel over te hevelen naar een apart wetsvoorstel, zodat het geen onderdeel hoeft te zijn van het Belastingplan?
Asks for evaluations and information on effects, including the Innovatiebox evaluation and the bodemrecht changes.
Does the government share the view that an evaluation is important, especially since billions of euros are involved?
Deelt de regering de mening dat een evaluatie van belang is, zeker omdat er meer miljarden euro's mee zijn gemoeid?
Questions whether the fiscal care-cost deduction restriction is fair to lower incomes and asks about the discretion of inspectors in imposing penalties.
To what extent is the inspector free in imposing this penalty?
In hoeverre is de inspecteur vrij in het opleggen van deze boete?
Asks whether the rules are not too rigorous for students and whether penalties are proportionate and enforceable.
These members want to be sure the scheme is not intervened in too rigorously.
Deze leden willen er echt voor waken dat er al te rigoureus wordt ingegrepen in de regeling.
Asks for an overview of fiscal schemes allowing interest deduction and for the non-compliance gap in horizontal supervision.
These members request insight into the compliance gap before the bill is debated in the House.
Deze leden verzoeken inzicht in het nalevingstekort voor de behandeling van het wetsvoorstel in de Kamer.
Objects to the removal of the red diesel excise advantage and the burden on agricultural firms, and asks the government to reconsider.
Would the government therefore still consider the SGP proposal to keep the red diesel excise advantage in 2013?
Zou de regering daarom alsnog het voorstel van de leden van de SGP-fractie willen overwegen om het accijnsvoordeel op rode diesel in 2013 te behouden?
Objects to regulating the extended resale period by general administrative order rather than statute and questions the vagueness of the term aanhorigheid.
The PVV finds regulating such a matter by general administrative order undesirable and prefers a statutory regulation.
De regeling van een dergelijk onderwerp bij algemene maatregel van bestuur achten de leden van de PVV-fractie niet wenselijk, een wettelijke regeling heeft hun voorkeur.
Asks how supervision of the Caribbean Netherlands tax regime will be organised and how data will be exchanged with Curaçao.
Regarding the tax system of the Caribbean Netherlands, the VVD members ask the government to explain how supervision is organised.
De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen ten aanzien van het fiscale stelsel van Caribisch Nederland de regering toe te lichten hoe het toezicht hieromtrent wordt vormgegeven.
Asks the government to report on the state of car tax developments and whether adjustments are warranted, as agreed with parliament.
The PvdA members understand that schemes should not be overhauled every year.],
De leden van de PvdA-fractie begrijpen dat je niet elk jaar de regelingen moet omgooien.
Questions the legal basis and procedure for collecting the kansspelheffing and the use of belastingdeurwaarders, and whether the approach was agreed with parliament.
The PVV members would like to know where the principle of reducing the tax bailiff's tasks for third parties has been laid down and discussed with the House.
Graag zouden de leden van de PVV-fractie willen weten waar het principe «van een vermindering van taken van de belastingdeurwaarder ten behoeve van derden» is vastgelegd en besproken met de Kamer.
Objects to tax increases burdening lower incomes and the self-employed, and asks for assessments of fraud and avoidance and the effects on citizens.
The SP members note that the government has no clear picture of how much money the Dutch state loses through tax constructions and fraud.
De leden van de SP-fractie constateren dat de regering geen goed beeld heeft van hoeveel geld de Nederlandse staat misloopt door belastingconstructies en fraude.
Questions whether the bodemrecht reform is justified, criticises the lack of consultation and impact analysis, and notes the Raad van State's advice to use a separate bill.
Should the royal route not be followed, as the Council of State advised, namely a separate bill on which a thorough debate can be held?
Moet niet, zoals de Raad van State heeft geadviseerd, de «koninklijke weg» gevolgd worden, te weten, een separaat wetsvoorstel waar een grondig debat over kan gevoerd worden?

v.summary: The Raad van State advised, in its opinion of 5 September 2012, that the Belastingplan 2013 provision strengthening the tax authority's bodem(voor)recht (ground right and priority) should be a separate bill because of its significant societal effects on secured creditors, suppliers and lessors, and that the transitional rule should cover debts arising on 1 January 2013. The government's nader rapport largely rejected the call for a separate bill, explaining the measure only repairs erosion of the existing right, but added explanation on societal effects and adjusted the transitional provision to apply to debts arising after 31 December 2012.
concerns: The Afdeling advises placing the bodem(voor)recht change in a separate bill outside the fiscal package, given its significant societal effects and need for consultation; the government kept it in the Belastingplan 2013.

The Afdeling asks the memorie van toelichting to address the significant societal consequences for SMEs, large businesses, suppliers and financial institutions; the government explained these effects and amended the explanatory memorandum.
The Afdeling asks why transitional law applies to debts arising after 1 January 2013 rather than on or after that date; the government amended the transitional provision accordingly.

33420.s: The bill amends the Dutch private security and detective agencies act to implement EU Regulation 1214/2011 on cross-border transport of euro cash by road, adding licensing, medical and training requirements, and penalties. It creates ministerial regulation powers for the minister to set transport options, medical criteria, training requirements and the designated authority, and extends sanction powers including licence suspension and bans on staff.
33420.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations as needed to implement EU regulation options and medical requirements consistently with existing practice in the private security act.
q: To make clear to transport companies and enforcement bodies which options are permitted on Dutch territory, the act creates a basis to set the choice by ministerial regulation.

Om voor met name de transportbedrijven, maar ook voor de handhavende instanties, duidelijk te maken welke opties op het Nederlandse grondgebied zijn toegestaan, wordt er in de wet een grondslag gecreëerd om de keuze bij ministeriële regeling vast te leggen.
d: permitted transport options under EU regulation
medical fitness requirements and permitted medical examinations for guards
p: Allows the minister to revoke or suspend transport licences and bar re-licensing for up to five years for violations of licence conditions.
Empowers the minister to impose administrative fines up to €11,250 on licence holders, including those licensed in other member states.

Lets the minister suspend foreign-licensed carriers' rights and bar individual guards from operating in the Netherlands, based on findings by authorities in other member states.](The bill also applies fines and licence measures to foreign licence holders on the basis of notifications from other states.)

parties: Asks how cross-border permits relate to national licences, how the integrity of information is safeguarded in permit granting, and whether permit checks at the border are workable.
What safeguards for the accuracy of the information provided are built into the permit granting process?
Welke waarborgen voor de juistheid van de verstrekte informatie zijn ingebouwd in het vergunningverleningsproces?
Asks for the current problems in cross-border cash transport and whether the regulation protects guards and prevents robberies, without raising checks on the executive.
Does this regulation offer sufficient starting points to give security guards on these cash transports adequate protection?
Biedt deze verordening voldoende aanknopingspunten om beveiligers op deze geldtransporten voldoende bescherming te bieden?

Doubts that the regulation's safeguards are sufficient, since permits from other member states allow transport through the Netherlands with supervision left to the state of origin, and questions the workability of the weapons safe arrangement and how Dutch rules are enforced.
Are the safeguards this regulation offers sufficient, and is practice in all other member states such that cross-border transport of euro cash will take place responsibly?
Zijn de waarborgen die deze verordening biedt voldoende en is de praktijk in alle andere lidstaten dusdanig dat grensoverschrijdend geldtransport van eurocontanten verantwoord plaats zal vinden?

33501.s: The bill amends the Postwet 2009 to introduce ex ante regulation of postal carriers with significant market power, allowing the Autoriteit Consument en Markt to impose access, pricing, accounting, information and tariff-approval obligations. It removes the old article 9, adds a new chapter 3a, and makes consequential changes to the Algemene wet bestuursrecht and appeal rules.
33501.j: The memorandum justifies the new powers by the risk of irreversible competition harm in a concentrated postal market, which the existing article 9 and ex post competition law cannot adequately address.
q: The current supervisory instruments of OPTA and the general competition instruments available to the NMa, which only act ex post, are not sufficiently tailored to respond effectively to this situation.

Het huidige toezichtinstrumentarium van de OPTA en het algemene mededingingsinstrumentarium dat de NMa ter beschikking staat, waarbij alleen achteraf kan worden opgetreden, zijn er niet voldoende op toegesneden om effectief op deze situatie in te spelen.
d: imposing ex ante obligations on operators with significant market power
skipping the public preparation procedure for urgent decisions
access, pricing, accounting and tariff obligations set by regulator
p: The regulator may impose specific obligations on operators with significant market power after a market analysis, subject to proportionality and appeal to the business appeals court.
The regulator may disapply the standard public consultation procedure in urgent cases, with decisions valid for up to 26 weeks.

parties: Asks what 'reasonable conditions' and 'reasonable request' mean, and whether the ACM's proportionality requirement without further definition creates unclear, ad hoc intervention.
This creates uncertainty in the market about when the ACM is expected to intervene and when not.
Dit geeft onduidelijkheid op de markt over wanneer de ACM wordt geacht in te grijpen en wanneer niet.
Asks how the ACM's measures are weighed for light or heavy effects and whether the regulator might disproportionately apply the instruments, and asks why the universal service is excluded.
Does the government think it is obvious that the AMM instrument will be applied disproportionately?
Denkt de regering dat het voor de hand ligt dat het AMM-instrumentarium disproportioneel zal worden ingezet?
Asks how the regulator should judge whether a measure is 'appropriate' given no defined proportionality standard, and wants a substantiated case for necessity.
The SP members therefore request the government to provide both a solid justification of the necessity and usefulness of this new instrument
De leden van de SP-fractie verzoeken de regering dan ook om zowel een gedegen onderbouwing van de nut en noodzaak van dit nieuwe instrumentarium
Supports the step toward a better-functioning market but warns against regulatory uncertainty and asks how far the ACM's freedom of action is bounded and how 'risk' is defined.
Against this background, can the government also estimate the consequences of the freedom of action of the Authority for Consumers and Markets (ACM)?
Kan de regering tegen deze achtergrond ook een inschatting geven van de gevolgen van de handelingsvrijheid van de Autoriteit Consument en Markt (ACM)?

Shares the government's analysis of a shrinking market with a risk of irreversible competition effects, while asking for a precise specification of proportionality and the order in which instruments are used.
The D66 members would welcome a further specification from the government of the concept of 'proportionality' as used in Article 13b, third paragraph
De leden van de fractie van D66 ontvangen graag van de regering een nadere specificatie van het begrip «proportionaliteit» zoals gebruikt in het artikel 13b, derde lid

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division supports the amendment reducing mandatory postal delivery days from six to five, but asks that the explanatory memorandum justify why Saturday may count as a working day under the Postal Directive and that the Commission be notified of the amendment. The minister's reply states that the explanatory memorandum has been supplemented on both points and adds a transitional provision and drafting corrections.
concerns: The explanatory memorandum must justify under the Postal Directive why Saturday can be counted within the minimum of five working days.
The explanatory memorandum should state that the amendment must be notified to the European Commission under Directive 2008/6/EC.
Punctuation in the proposed law is corrected and a transitional provision is added, with some editorial improvements to the explanatory memorandum.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on a bill amending the Postwet 2009 to introduce ex ante regulation of postal operators with significant market power, questioning the necessity of new instruments, the EU Postal and Services Directive compliance, and the lack of a clear criterion in the text. The government's nader rapport largely accepted the remarks, clarified necessity and effectiveness, addressed the directive concerns, added the market-analysis criterion in the explanatory memorandum, and adopted the drafting corrections.
concerns: The Afdeling questioned the need for a new ex ante instrument given existing article 9 and the absence of abuse by PostNL; the government clarified the rationale and why article 9 is insufficient.

The Afdeling flagged tension with article 16 of the Services Directive and recommended consultation with the Commission; the government consulted the Commission but rejected the claim that an obligation constitutes a requirement under the Services Directive.

The Afdeling asked that the criterion of a foreseeable future competition problem from the explanatory memorandum be written into the statutory text of article 13b; the government said it is already embedded in the statutory conditions.
The Afdeling made minor redactional corrections to articles 13f, paragraphs 1 and 3, which were adopted.

33510.s: The bill implements EU regulation 1227/2011 on integrity and transparency of wholesale energy markets in Dutch energy and financial supervision law. It gives the competition authority (NMa) new supervisory, information-gathering, registration, sanction and criminal-enforcement powers, including the possibility of courts freezing assets or imposing a professional ban.
33510.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation and new powers as necessary to implement the EU regulation's requirements for enforcement and sanctions, and notes that the NMa's powers are already largely present in existing law.
q: Under Article 13(2)(f) and (g) of the regulation, it must be possible to ask a court to freeze or seize assets or impose a temporary ban on professional activity.

Op grond van artikel 13, tweede lid, onderdelen f en g, van de verordening moet een rechter kunnen worden gevraagd om vermogensbestanddelen te bevriezen of in beslag te nemen of een tijdelijk verbod op beroepsuitoefening op te leggen.
d: rules on registration of market participants
rules on registration of market participants
p: Artikel I, D en Artikel II, D (artikelen 7 en 1g)
The NMa may request information from market participants and others, including the AFM, prosecutors and the European Commission, under broadly formulated powers.
Artikel I, F en Artikel II, F (artikelen 77i en 60ad)
The NMa is empowered to impose administrative fines for violations of the regulation, with categories of serious violations, expanding administrative sanctioning power over market participants.
Artikel IV en V (Wet op de economische delicten, Wetboek van Strafvordering art. 67)
Violations of the market abuse prohibitions are made economic offences and misdrijven, allowing professional bans, asset freezing and pre-trial detention, with court authorization.

parties: Asks how enforcement responsibilities between the NMa and the AFM are divided so that oversight does not fall short, and when criminal enforcement can be expected.
How do we prevent oversight from falling short because these two parties end up waiting for each other?
Hoe voorkomen we dat de het toezicht tekortschiet doordat deze beide partijen op elkaar gaan zitten wachten?
Asks why the NMa lacks a power to enter a home without the occupant's consent and on what substantive grounds the government rejects adding it.
On what substantive grounds, other than that the Regulation does not require it, does the government consider adding this power undesirable, the PvdA members ask.

Op basis van welke inhoudelijke gronden, anders dan dat de Verordening het niet vereist, meent de regering dat toevoeging van de betreffende bevoegdheid niet wenselijk is, zo vragen de leden van de PvdA-fractie.
Questions the necessity of new regulation for markets that have existed for a long time and asks why the urgency of entry into force arose now.
The wholesale energy markets have existed for quite some time, so why are rules only now being set up for them?
De groothandelsmarkten voor energie bestaan immers al geruime tijd dus waarom worden hier nu pas regels voor opgetuigd?
Asks why self-regulation is chosen for reporting obligations given its failure in other sectors and how supervisors divide tasks and exchange information.
The SP members ask the government, also in light of the failure of self-regulation in other market sectors, why this free scope for self-regulation is chosen.
De leden van de SP-fractie vragen de regering, mede gelet op het falen van zelfregulering in andere marktsectoren, waarom voor deze vrije ruimte van zelfregulering wordt gekozen.
Asks how market abuse is currently handled before the regulation applies, what criminal sanctions are available, and how many countries have already implemented it.
The explanatory memorandum indicates that criminal sanctions are also possible.
In de memorie van toelichting is aangegeven dat ook strafrechtelijke sancties mogelijk zijn.
Criticises vague delegation provisions allowing ministerial rules on 'necessary' and 'more than necessary' and asks for clarity or deletion, and questions the timing of entry into force.
The D66 members find the proposed delegation provisions extremely vaguely formulated.
De leden van de D66-fractie vinden de voorgestelde delegatiebepalingen uitermate vaag geformuleerd.

34000-X.s: This bill fixes the 2015 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Defence (expenditure and revenue appropriations per article) and the budget statements for its agencies DTO, DVD and Paresto. It also sets the entry-into-force rules, with retroactive effect to 1 January if the Staatsblad appears later.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Defence (X) for the year 2015 belonging to this act is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Defensie (X) voor het jaar 2015 wordt vastgesteld.

34023.s: The bill approves, for the European part of the Netherlands, the Council of the EU decision of 26 May 2014 on the system of own resources of the European Union, as required under Article 91(1) of the Constitution. It enters into force the day after publication in the Staatsblad.
34023.j: The memorandum explains that the decision is a treaty-based instrument requiring approval by all member states under Article 311 TFEU, and that the Council will adopt implementing rules.
q: Article 9 states that the Council will draw up implementing rules to calculate the data in Article 7 (the annual balance) and to check the revenue in Article 2.

Artikel 9 geeft aan dat de Raad implementatieregels zal opstellen om de onder artikel 7 genoemde gegevens (de jaarlijkse balans) te berekenen en om de onder artikel 2 genoemde inkomsten te controleren.
d: Council implementing rules for calculating annual balance and controlling own-resource revenue

parties: Asks whether a simpler single reference point for contributions could reduce ex-post corrections, and whether statistical harmonisation methods are clear.
These members are therefore also satisfied with the current system in which member states remain primarily responsible for transferring financial resources to the EU.
Deze leden zijn daarom ook tevreden met de huidige systematiek waarbij lidstaten primair verantwoordelijk blijven voor het overdragen van de financiële middelen aan de EU.
Criticises the repeated budget amendments and asks for more clarity, and urges attention to transparent accounting of EU spending in line with the European Court of Auditors' findings.
The European Court of Auditors has recently found that EU spending still cannot be adequately accounted for.
De Europese rekenkamer heeft recent geconstateerd dat de uitgaven van de EU nog steeds niet afdoende kunnen worden verantwoord.

Questions the reliability of Eurostat's GNI methodology flagged by the Court of Auditors, asks for transparency and sanctions when member state declarations are missing, and questions EFSF governance.
In the view of these members, it cannot be explained that after twenty years without audit approval statements from the European Court of Auditors, sanctions simply remain absent.
Het is in de ogen van deze leden niet uit te leggen dat na twintig jaar geen goedkeuringsverklaringen van de Europese rekenkamer, sancties gewoon achterwege blijven.
Requests detailed figures on the Dutch rebate, contributions, collection cost compensation and the ESA2010 effect on the national contribution.
The PVV members would like a complete overview of the amounts from which this rebate is built up.
De leden van de PVV-fractie ontvangen graag een compleet overzicht van de bedragen waaruit deze korting is opgebouwd.

34032.s: The bill adds a limited right of source protection for journalists and publicists (new article 218a Sv), allowing a witness to refuse questions on the source of information unless the examining judge finds a weightier public interest. It also tightens search and detention rules: searches of a lawyer-like confidant's office require prior authorisation by the examining judge, and detention of refusing witnesses is made subject to advice from a representative of their profession.
34032.j: The memorandum justifies the new powers by the need to codify the right to source protection under Article 10 ECHR and to comply with ECtHR case law requiring prior review by an independent judge.
q: In the proposed article 218a, second paragraph, the bill largely follows the Jurgens initiative. The assessment is primarily entrusted to the examining judge.
In het voorgestelde artikel 218a, tweede lid, wordt grotendeels aansluiting gezocht bij het initiatief voorstel Jurgens. De beoordeling wordt primair aan de rechter-commissaris opgedragen.
p: Artikel I, onderdeel B (art. 97 lid 1) and onderdeel A

The bill allows the public prosecutor to search a home without the occupant's consent in urgent cases where the examining judge cannot be awaited, a limited expansion of executive search power for serious offences.
New journalist source protection is subject to the examining judge's weighing of public interests, which strengthens protection against executive compulsion.
Artikel I, onderdeel E (art. 222) and F (art. 294)
Detention of refusing witnesses remains available for up to twelve or thirty days, now with consultation of a professional representative before the court decides.

parties: Asks what the bill adds to existing case law under Article 10 ECHR and why only the Sanoma ruling-based pre-seizure review was not chosen.
Asks whether judges should be able to attach conditions to authorising investigative measures and questions the vague notion of publicist.
Argues the source protection is too narrow, the broad override possibility creates legal uncertainty, and the proposal should be stronger, including for NGOs.
They therefore consider press freedom of particular importance for any democratic society; only in exceptional cases may a journalist be forced to reveal a source.

Zij vinden dan ook dat de persvrijheid van bijzonder groot belang is voor iedere democratische samenleving. Slechts in uitzonderlijke gevallen mag een journalist gedwongen worden zijn bron te onthullen.
