Objects that extending the protection to publicists departs from the ECtHR case law, which concerned only clear journalists, and that the ethics condition is not safeguarded.
With surprise, because these members note that the bill widens the scope of source protection as described by the ECtHR while not giving substance to some essential conditions the ECtHR sets.

Met verbazing, omdat voornoemde leden constateren dat in onderhavig wetsvoorstel de reikwijdte van de vereiste bronbescherming zoals omschreven door het EHRM door de regering wordt vergroot maar tegelijkertijd geen invulling wordt gegeven aan enkele essentiële voorwaarden.
Asks what the practical added value of the bill is over current Article 10 ECHR protection and why publicists need the right.
These members ask what the difference in protection level is between the current Article 10 ECHR regime and the protection the bill would offer.
Voornoemde leden vragen wat het verschil in beschermingsniveau is zoals die nu geldt op basis van artikel 10 EVRM en de bescherming die het beoogde wetsvoorstel gaat bieden.

Welcomes statutory anchoring but asks why the bill does not define the protected group by activity, why no narrower list of override grounds is given, and how use of investigations to prevent publication is guarded.

These members do not share the view that the Prosecution Service's guideline on coercive measures against journalists can suffice; independent assessment before access is necessary to protect source protection.

Deze leden delen de opvatting niet dat de Aanwijzing toepassing dwangmiddelen tegen journalisten van het college van procureurs-generaal van het OM inzake de toepassing van dwangmiddelen bij journalisten kan volstaan.
Asks why protection is limited to sources expressly guaranteed confidentiality, why override modalities are not in the statute, and how appeal is safeguarded against premature access.
These members ask how source protection is safeguarded in the case of appeal.
De aan het woord zijnde leden vragen op welke wijze de bronbescherming gewaarborgd is in het geval van hoger beroep.

Welcomes the bill but says it does not go far enough; asks that the privilege cover a wider group of publicists and all investigative services, and that confidentiality not depend only on explicit agreement.
They ask whether the so-called journalistic privilege should not cover a larger group of publicists.
Zij vragen of het zogenoemde journalistieke privilege niet een grotere groep publicisten zou moeten omvatten.
Asks whether the bill adds value beyond ECtHR case law, warns the undefined notions of journalist and publicist could expand the privilege too widely, and asks about the override criterion.
They ask to what extent this bill has genuine added value.
Zij vragen in hoeverre dit wetsvoorstel een daadwerkelijke toegevoegde waarde heeft.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the draft bill introducing source protection for journalists and publicists in criminal cases, flagging an overly broad circle of protected persons, the need for a clear and consistent scope with the parallel Wiv 2002 bill, unclear professional ethics standards, insufficient justification for a general testimonial privilege and for the consultation provision, and the need to delete the search power for lawyers' offices. The government's nader rapport accepted some points (removing the emergency search, clarifying the memorie van toelichting on ethics and consultation, rewording 'afgifte') but rejected the narrowing of the protected circle to journalists and kept publicists and the general privilege.
concerns: The Afdeling advised restricting protection to journalists as defined under Wiv 2002 and rejecting the broader publicist category as going beyond ECtHR case law; the government kept publicists in scope.

The Afdeling found the scope of protected persons too indeterminate and advised a clear, consistent scope across both bills and clearer ethics standards; the government explained its differing approach but added clarification in the explanatory memorandum.

The Afdeling questioned whether a general statutory testimonial privilege was necessary given ECtHR case law, since a judicial prior review could suffice; the government deemed a statutory basis necessary.

The Afdeling advised dropping the proposed public-interest exception clause because courts can apply ECtHR criteria directly; the government maintained the clause because fundamental-rights limitations should be set in formal law.
The Afdeling advised clarifying in the explanatory memorandum who could serve as representative of the professional group consulted by the judge; the government supplemented the explanation.

The Afdeling advised deleting the power for the officier van justitie to search a lawyer-type confidant's office without the rechter-commissaris present; the government removed the emergency search exception.
The Afdeling made redactional comments, including replacing 'afgifte' with 'verstrekking' and deleting a sentence; the government adopted them.

34041.s: The bill amends the Mining Act, Environmental Management Act and Economic Offences Act to implement EU Directive 2013/30/EU on offshore oil and gas safety, introducing major-accident reports, independent verification, notification duties, expanded regulator tasks, and cost recovery from operators. It also gives the state supervisor SodM a confidential reporting mechanism and lets ministerial regulations and general administrative orders set detailed requirements.
34041.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations as needed for detailed technical implementation of the EU directive and the regulator's supervisory role, with cost recovery justified by the polluter-pays principle.
q: Passing on costs to mining companies fits government policy of recovering the costs of public supervision as far as possible from those who benefit (polluter-pays principle).
Het doorberekenen van kosten aan mijnbouwbedrijven past in het kabinetsbeleid om de kosten van overheidstoezicht zoveel mogelijk te verhalen op degenen die hiervan profiteren (profijtbeginsel).
d: Artikel I, onderdeel C (artikel 9a, derde lid, Mijnbouwwet)
information on applicant safety and environmental performance
Artikel I, onderdeel H (artikel 43, derde en zesde lid, Mijnbouwwet)
safety zone exemptions and application rules
Artikel I, onderdeel I (artikel 45b, lid 5, en 45c, lid 2, Mijnbouwwet)
content and submission of major-hazard reports
Artikel I, onderdeel I (artikel 45l, lid 4, Mijnbouwwet)
requirements for independent verification arrangements and verifier selection
Artikel I, onderdeel I (artikel 45j en 45k, Mijnbouwwet)
content of safety policy and safety and environmental management system
content of notifications and obligations regarding regulator comments
Artikel I, onderdeel N (artikel 133, lid 2 en 3, Mijnbouwwet)
cost recovery rules and fee amounts (fees set by ministerial regulation)
p: Artikel I, onderdeel N (artikel 133, lid 4, Mijnbouwwet)
The minister may collect cost-recovery amounts by compulsory writ, applying the general administrative enforcement title with some exceptions.
Artikel I, onderdeel H (artikel 43, lid 4, Mijnbouwwet)
The minister may grant exemptions from the safety-zone prohibition on request, with conditions attached.
Operators may be required by general administrative order to transport inspection officials and provide them accommodation and meals during inspections.
The former article 133 is repealed and replaced by a new cost-recovery provision.

parties: Asks whether extending the rules to onshore activities amounts to a national add-on and how the added administrative burden fits the goals of the Omgevingswet.
As the cabinet itself writes, extending these measures to onshore mining leads to extra administrative burdens for mining companies of a one-off €7,074,000 and then structurally €4,400,000 per year.

Zoals het kabinet zelf ook schrijft leidt de uitbreiding van deze maatregelen naar mijnbouw op land tot extra administratieve lasten bij mijnbouwondernemingen van eenmalig € 7.074.000 en vervolgens € 4.400.000 per jaar structureel.

Questions the independence of verifying firms that may be linked to the industry and asks whether a stricter independence requirement should be considered; also asks how the SodM's role in approving reports works in practice.
How independent are the verifying firms in practice? Are they not also linked to the gas and oil industry?
Hoe onafhankelijk zijn de verifiërende bedrijven in de praktijk? Zijn zij niet ook gelieerd aan de gas- en olie-industrie?

Welcomes that an independent body (SodM) supervises, and asks whether responsibility for assessing material damage is taken away from the extracting party, and how public participation and legal challenge rights work.
These members would like to know whether, by extension, this also means that responsibility and decision-making power for assessing material damage is taken away from the oil or gas extracting party.

Graag zouden deze leden willen weten of in het verlengde hiervan dit ook betekent dat de verantwoordelijkheid en beslissingsbevoegdheid voor het beoordelen van materiele schade ook weggehaald wordt bij de olie- of gaswinnende partij.

Asks how the independent inspection role of SodM is safeguarded given the growth in its tasks, whether it has enough capacity, and why certain safeguards (prior approval before production, confidential reporting) do not apply onshore.
These members ask the government to explain how the independent inspection role of SodM is safeguarded despite the large increase in tasks.
Deze leden vragen de regering toe te lichten hoe de onafhankelijke inspectierol van het SodM wordt gewaarborgd ondanks de grote toename van taken.

Criticises that the bill sets a weaker risk-reduction standard than the directive ('zwaar onevenredig' instead of 'volstrekt onevenredig') and asks how best practices are determined and independently assessed.
This means the bill sets fewer requirements for risk reduction than the directive.
Dit betekent dat het wetsvoorstel minder eisen stelt aan de risicoreductie dan de richtlijn.
Argues the Mijnbouwwet contains too few environmental safeguards and asks whether mining in Natura 2000 areas can be excluded by law, including salt extraction under the Wadden Sea.
In the view of the Partij voor de Dieren members, far too few safeguards for the environment are included in the Mining Act.
Er zitten naar mening van de leden van de Partij voor de Dieren-fractie veel te weinig waarborgen in voor het milieu.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised on a bill implementing EU Directive 2013/30/EU on offshore oil and gas safety, criticising the failure to justify excluding some safety and liability measures for onshore extraction and the cost-recovery approach. The government's reply states that the bill was amended to apply financial/technical criteria, financial security and liability onshore, and to differentiate cost recovery by public interest.
concerns: The Afdeling found no justification for excluding certain accident-prevention measures (confidential reporting, technical criteria) for onshore extraction, and the government extended them onshore.
The Afdeling found no justification for excluding onshore operators from financial-capacity criteria, financial security and liability rules, and the government applied them onshore.

The Afdeling advised explaining how far supervision costs are passed on to mining companies given the public interest, and the government differentiated cost recovery by task while keeping a cost-recovery principle.
Several technical and drafting remarks were taken over, except one on adding an internal disaster plan, which the government placed in a different regulation.

34200-V.s: This Dutch bill amends the 2014 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and the budget statement of its agency CBI, changing the appropriations and realisation figures as shown in the attached statements. The bill takes effect the day after publication in the Staatsblad and applies retroactively to 31 December of the budget year.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (V)
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken (V)

34203.s: The bill transfers a set of existing tasks under the Zorgverzekeringswet and related laws (such as premium collection, extra contributions for defaulting insurees, and conscientious objector matters) from the Zorginstituut Nederland to the CAK, and amends many references accordingly. It also grants the CAK authority to process personal data and transfers pending cases, archives and ombudsman matters to it.
34203.j: The memorandum justifies the transfer as bundling related tasks, clustering information flows and reducing complexity for the ministry, without new discretionary powers.
q: By bundling these tasks, information flows to citizens can be clustered and processes better aligned with each other.
Door bundeling van deze taken kunnen informatiestromen naar burgers worden geclusterd en processen beter op elkaar worden aangesloten.

parties: Asks how the quality tasks at the Zorginstituut will be shaped and whether freed-up resources stay there, and how operational transition risks are covered.
They do ask how it will be ensured that the freed-up attention at the Zorginstituut actually goes to the quality tasks it retains.
Wel vragen zij hoe er gevolgd gaat worden dat de vrijkomende aandacht bij het Zorginstituut daadwerkelijk gaat naar de kwaliteitstaken die zij overhoudt.
Doubts the CAK can handle the new tasks given past failures, asks about postponement and emergency scenarios, salary and WNT compliance at the CAK, and lessons from earlier problems.

Given that the drama surrounding the implementation of the personal budget (PGB) entitlement by the SVB is still not resolved, the SP members are worried whether the CAK can handle all these new tasks.

Gezien het feit dat het drama rondom de uitvoering van het trekkingsrecht van het Persoonsgebonden Budget (PGB) door de Sociale Verzekeringsbank (SVB) nog altijd niet is opgelost maken de leden van de SP-fractie zich wel zorgen of het CAK al die nieuwe taken aan kan.

Refers to the Algemene Rekenkamer's criticism, asks whether conditions are secured, requests the Privacy Impact Assessment and asks for a CBP advice and BIT opinion; asks whether the minister has instruction powers over the CAK.
The Algemene Rekenkamer, in its 2014 accountability audit regarding the transfer of tasks, indicated that more attention should be paid to the execution of these tasks.
De Algemene Rekenkamer heeft in zijn verantwoordingsonderzoek 2014 ten aanzien van de overheveling van taken aangegeven dat er meer aandacht dient te zijn voor de uitvoering van deze taken.
Asks who is responsible for citizen hindrance if the transfer goes wrong and asks the minister to closely monitor possible linking of data files to protect privacy.
They want to ask the Minister to monitor this thoroughly in order to safeguard privacy.
Zij willen de Minister vragen dit grondig te monitoren, om de privacy te waarborgen.
The SP doubts the independence of the ministry CIO's IT study and wants an independent risk analysis before the transfer is approved.
The members of the SP faction are not at all convinced of the independence of the study carried out by the ministry's Chief Information Officer.
De leden van de SP-fractie zijn in het geheel niet overtuigd van de onafhankelijkheid van het door de Chief Information Officer van het ministerie uitgevoerde onderzoek.
The CDA asks about the external audit, the IT transition risks, the go/no-go decision and whether the College Bescherming Persoonsgegevens should have been consulted on privacy.
Finally, the members of the CDA faction regret that the government did not submit this bill for advice to the Data Protection Authority (College Bescherming Persoonsgegevens).
Tenslotte vinden de leden van de CDA-fractie het jammer dat de regering deze wetswijziging niet ter advisering heeft voorgelegd aan het College Bescherming Persoonsgegevens.

34212.s: The bill modernises and digitises civil procedure by replacing the summons (dagvaarding) and petition (verzoekschrift) with a uniform procesinleiding, renaming terms such as terechtzitting to zitting, and introducing electronic filing and a notification system in the courts. The explanatory memorandum adds that a claimant's remaining court fee is retained after withdrawal, that informal service is allowed subject to a later formal service step, and that the judge gains more case-management powers.
34212.j: The memorandum justifies the changes as simplification and digitisation of procedure, with the Raad van State and Hoge Raad advice incorporated, and gives rationale for retaining the claimant's partial fee refund rules.
q: A new simple basic procedure is the starting point.
Een nieuwe eenvoudige basisprocedure is hierbij het uitgangspunt.
p: Artikel I G, I, N, O (judicial discretion provisions)
Judges gain expanded case-management and discretionary powers over procedure, such as deciding whether recordings replace minutes and drawing adverse inferences from experts not signing reports.

parties: Supports digitisation and simplification of civil procedure and asks procedural questions about splitting the KEI project into several bills and the entry-into-force timing.
Digitisation and simplification of civil procedure are seen by these members as a great good.
Digitalisering en vereenvoudiging van het procesrecht zien deze leden als een groot goed.
Asks whether the reduced refund of court fees on early withdrawal of a claim might deter settlement and whether the one-third refund rule is justified.

Do these members understand correctly that having to pay at least two thirds of the court fee, subject to the statutory maxima, rather than full refund, serves among other things to prevent plaintiffs from starting proceedings too lightly?

Begrijpen deze leden het goed dat het tenminste moeten betalen van twee derde van het griffierecht met de in de wet genoemde maxima in plaats van het volledig terugbetalen van de griffierechten onder andere er toe dient te voorkomen dat eisers te lichtvaardig procedures zullen aanvangen?
Raises concerns about enforcement problems, legal consequences for unrepresented citizens of informal service, pilot problems and whether the Judiciary has adequate reserves.
Could it lead to problems or disappointments in enforcing the judgment if the bailiff has not served the writ of summons?
Zal het kunnen leiden tot problemen of teleurstellingen bij de executie van het vonnis, indien de deurwaarder de procesinleiding niet heeft betekend?
Questions access to justice for functionally illiterate citizens, possible delays for creditors, pilot teething problems, and financial risks and oversight of KEI costs.
These members ask the government to pay attention to the accessibility of the law, in particular the position of functionally illiterate people.
Deze leden vragen zekerheidshalve aandacht van de regering voor de toegankelijkheid van het recht, in het bijzonder de positie van de laaggeletterden.
Asks about privacy safeguards, fraud prevention, expert involvement and provision for parties who continue to proceed only on paper.
What measures have been taken regarding the bill to prevent possible privacy violations or problems?
Welke maatregelen zijn met betrekking tot het wetsvoorstel genomen teneinde mogelijke schendingen en of problemen met de privacy te voorkomen?
Supports simplification but insists access to the judge must never be jeopardised, asking what alternatives exist during system failures and about the withdrawal fee rationale.
They regard it as an essential starting point that access to the court must in no case be jeopardised.
Zij beschouwen het als essentieel uitgangspunt dat in geen geval de toegang tot de rechter in het gedrang mag komen.

34302.s: This Dutch tax bill (Belastingplan 2016) adjusts income tax rates and brackets, the general tax credit, the box 3 savings return rates, the S&O (R&D) wage tax reduction, inheritance and gift exemptions, and various excise and environmental tax rates for 2016 onward, with scheduled annual rate increases through 2031. It also introduces indexation mechanisms that let the minister adjust the general tax credit percentage and box 3 rate percentages by ministerial regulation each year.
34302.j: The memorandum justifies the ministerial power to adjust percentages by the need to keep computations automatic and aligned with yearly inflation and market returns, using fixed formulas.
q: Article 10.6bis ... This percentage is set at 131% of the average return on household deposits, as published by De Nederlandsche Bank.
Artikel 10.6bis ... Dit percentage wordt gesteld op 131% van het gemiddelde rendement op deposito's
d: Artikel I, onderdeel K (art. 10.6b Wet IB 2001)
annual change of the general tax credit phase-out percentage
Artikel II, onderdeel J (art. 10.6bis Wet IB 2001)
annual re-setting of box 3 return class percentages and long-term returns
conditions for gift exemption for own home
conditions attached to increased gift exemptions
rules for S&O administration and reporting
p: Allows correction of inter-law conflicts and wrong cross-references in tax laws by ministerial regulation rather than by statute.
Artikel II, onderdeel J (art. 10.6bis) and Artikel I, onderdeel K (art. 10.6b)
Lets the minister set annual percentages and long-term return assumptions that determine taxable box 3 returns and the tax credit phase-out, with formulas fixed in the statute.

parties: Welcomes the €5 billion relief for workers and the later top-rate entry, with no checks-related concern raised.
The VVD members fully support the government's choice to free up €5 billion in tax relief for workers.
De leden van de VVD-fractie steunen voluit de keuze van de regering om € 5 miljard lastenverlichting voor werkenden vrij te maken.
Supports the package and box 3 forfait but worries about its legal robustness and asks whether it has been tested for legal soundness.
Has the government ascertained the legal tenability of the proposed box 3 measure, and how does it assess in this light the Supreme Court rulings of 3 and 24 April 2015?
Heeft de regering zich vergewist van de juridische houdbaarheid van de voorgestelde box 3-maatregel en hoe beoordeelt de regering in dit licht de arresten van de Hoge Raad van 3 en 24 april 2015?

Criticises the opaque, incomplete relief design and the legal vulnerability of the stacked forfaits in box 3, questioning whether the government has accounted for the risk that the scheme is not permitted.
Has the government taken into account that there is a considerable chance the proposed scheme is not permitted under the mentioned ruling, ask the CDA members.

Heeft de regering er rekening mee gehouden dat er een aanzienlijke kans bestaat dat de voorgestelde regeling op grond van het genoemde arrest niet is toegestaan, vragen de leden van de fractie van het CDA.

Criticises the missed opportunity for fundamental reform and asks how the government will follow up the Raad van State advice; also asks about behavioural effects and the lack of a tegenbewijs (counter-proof) safeguard.
These members ask how the government will give effect in the coming years to the Raad van State advice to better spread the fiscal bills over the year.
Deze leden vragen hoe de regering de komende jaren invulling gaat geven aan het advies van de Raad van State om de fiscale wetsvoorstellen beter te spreiden over het jaar.
Asks why relief goes only to workers and why the relief is permanent while the older-person correction is one-off.
The members ask the government to explain why it chose a package that delivers tax relief only for workers.
De leden vragen de regering aan te geven waarom is gekozen voor een pakket dat enkel voor werkenden lastenverlichting oplevert.
Regrets that relief is not accompanied by structural reform and that the focus on paid work discourages volunteering and care.
The SGP members consider it a missed opportunity that the proposed tax reliefs are not accompanied by a reform and simplification of the tax system.
De leden van de SGP-fractie vinden het een gemiste kans dat de voorgestelde lastenverlichtingen niet gepaard gaan met een herziening en vereenvoudiging van het belastingstelsel.
Endorses the Algemene Rekenkamer's view that the package is not a structural reform, criticises the weak position of pensioners, and asks for detailed government replies.
The 50PLUS member endorses the view of the Algemene Rekenkamer in its advice on this bill that the 2016 fiscal package cannot be seen as a broad and structural tax reform.

Het lid van de 50PLUS-fractie onderschrijft de mening van de Algemene Rekenkamer in haar advies bij dit wetsvoorstel, dat het fiscale pakket voor het jaar 2016 niet kan worden gezien als een brede en structurele belastingherziening.

v.summary: The Council of State advisory division advised on the Belastingplan 2016 bill, criticising the lack of broad tax reform, the mixing of budget-neutral measures into it, the retroactive emigration rule, the new box 3 yield system and the reintroduced coal tax exemption. The government's reply accepts some points (moving measures to OFM 2016, justifying the coal exemption) and defends the box 3 differentiation, the retroactivity and the housing gift exemption while promising evaluation.
concerns: The Afdeling argues the package is a missed chance for broad structural tax reform and that the measures are a regular tax package rather than fundamental reform.
Measures lacking budgetary significance (box 3 partly, partner rules, motor vehicle tax) should be moved to the Overige fiscale maatregelen bill; the government moved two of them.
The introduction of a prejudicial procedure before the Hoge Raad and country-by-country reporting do not belong in the OFM 2016 bill and are not urgent for 1 January 2016; the government disagreed.
The box 3 differentiated yield lacks a reasoned justification, and stacked fictions may disadvantage cautious investors; the government added explanation but kept the design.
Retroactive effect of the emigration rule for substantial shareholders is insufficiently justified; the government kept retroactivity citing anticipation risk.

The new structural gift tax exemption departs from the inheritance-tax buyer's-luck principle and lacks adequate justification or evaluation of the earlier exemption; the government argued the context differs and added evaluation.
Reintroducing the coal tax exemption needs justification and possible notification under the Energy Tax Directive and state aid rules; the government will notify the Commission under the directive.

34320.s: The bill amends the pending Wet algemeen pensioenfonds (Kamerstukken 34 117) by changing several article references, notably removing the reference to mergers of mandatory sectoral pension funds from the ringfencing and related provisions. It makes its entry into force conditional on the entry into force of article I(R) of the underlying bill.
34320.j: The memorandum explains that the Tweede Kamer adopted the Lodders/Vermeij amendment allowing ringfencing for mergers and that the government sought the Raad van State's advice on the legal risks to mandatory participation, but it does not justify any delegation or new executive power.
q: This amendment makes it possible that, in a merger of mandatory sectoral pension funds, separate assets are maintained (ringfencing).
Dit amendement maakt het mogelijk dat er bij een fusie van verplichtgestelde bedrijfstakpensioenfondsen gescheiden vermogens worden aangehouden (ringfencing).

34401.s: The bill amends the Electricity Act 1998 to create a separate offshore grid operator for wind parks at sea, with its own tariff, cost-recovery and subsidy rules. It lets the minister set an offshore development framework and allows the ACM to set tariffs and allowed revenues, with ministerial and general administrative order powers.
34401.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by the technical nature of the grid and the need to meet renewable energy targets on time, with ACM later reviewing the actual costs.
q: This bill gives ACM the task of estimating the costs in advance and taking that estimate into account when setting the allowed annual revenues.
Dit wetsvoorstel geeft ACM de taak om de hoogte van de betreffende kosten vooraf in te schatten en deze schatting te betrekken bij de bepaling van de toegestane jaarinkomsten.
d: I (Art. 20ca) / I Art. 20a-20c applied to offshore grid
spatial planning procedures for offshore grid
rules on compensation claims for producers
rules on subsidy for offshore grid operator
ACM method for efficiency discount on allowed revenues
ACM policy rule on efficiency assessment
designation of offshore grid operator without ownership
p: ACM sets allowed revenues, efficiency discounts and cost recovery for the offshore grid operator largely by its own methods and policy rules with limited parliamentary input.
Allows the operator designation and certification to depart from the ownership requirement and from the referendum-law entry-into-force period.
Minister sets and may amend the offshore wind development framework, which fixes locations, capacities and timing without parliamentary approval.

parties: Welcomes the swift introduction of the bill and hopes for quick handling in both chambers to avoid delays to wind plans and Energieakkoord targets.
These members therefore welcome the swift submission of this bill and hope for prompt handling in both chambers of the States General.
Deze leden verwelkomen daarom de snelle indiening van dit wetsvoorstel en hopen op een spoedige behandeling in beide Kamers der Staten-Generaal.
Questions the urgency invoked for the bill, challenges the use of the Belemmeringenwet Privaatrecht for wind parks, and asks for parliamentary involvement in changes to development frameworks.
The SP members would like a detailed explanation of the apparent urgency to anchor 'Wind op Zee' in the manner now proposed.
De leden van de SP-fractie willen graag een uitgebreide uitleg over de nu geschetste haast die nodig lijkt om op de nu voorliggende wijze «Wind op Zee» te verankeren.

Objects to the government's pressure for speedy handling, questions the democratic legitimacy of overriding delays, and criticises the wide compensation and cost rules and the bypassing of permit processes.
These members therefore find it inappropriate that the government is now exerting so much pressure on the Chamber to handle this bill urgently.
Deze leden vinden het dan ook ongepast dat de regering nu zoveel druk uitoefent op de Kamer om dit wetsvoorstel met spoed te behandelen.
Asks detailed questions on cost reduction claims, the changes from the earlier bill, and the treatment of wind parks as works of general interest affecting landowners and municipalities.
The CDA members have serious question marks about the proposed amendment under D, article 9g.
De leden van de CDA fractie hebben grote vraagtekens bij de voorgestelde wijziging onder D, artikel 9g.

Asks what the development framework will cover, the role of provinces and municipalities, and whether ACM can adequately assess efficiency of preparation costs; also asks about state aid talks with the Commission.
The D66 members ask whether ACM is able to make a sufficient assessment of the efficiency and effectiveness of these preparation costs so that it can correctly recalculate them.
Deze leden vragen of het voor de ACM wel mogelijk is om voldoende inschatting te maken over doelmatigheid en efficiëntie van deze voorbereidingskosten zodat zij deze correct kan nacalculeren.

Wants Parliament to be able to speak on the development frameworks and conditions, since offshore wind affects nature and marine ecology, rather than changes being made only in the Council of Ministers.
The PvdD members therefore consider it desirable that the Chamber retains influence over changes to development frameworks.
De leden van de PvdD-fractie achten het daarom wenselijk dat de Kamer invloed houdt op de wijziging van ontwikkelkaders.
Values swift enactment to increase the share of clean energy in the short term and asks for clarification of the tariff wording on 'unreasonable' contributions by grid users.
They attach importance to swift introduction of the law in order to increase the share of clean energy in the short term.
Zij hechten aan snelle invoering van de wet om het aandeel schone energie op korte termijn te vergroten.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advises the bill amending the Electricity Act 1998 (offshore grid, revenue regulation, timely realisation of Energy Agreement targets) to be sent to parliament, but asks for a reasoned justification on EU law, state aid and revenue regulation, deletion of the phrase 'including the quality of the grid' in article 42b, and more on the uncertainties of the structuurvisie/ontwikkelkader pre-financing. The minister's nader rapport adopts the EU-law and state-aid clarifications and the pre-financing explanation, and rejects deleting 'including grid quality' while making a minor wording change.
concerns: The Afdeling asks the explanatory memorandum to explain how the revenue regulation for the offshore grid relates to the tariff regulation under the EU electricity directive and regulation.
The Afdeling asks for explanation of possible state aid elements, including pre-financing advantages for TenneT and selective advantages for large consumers and wind park operators.

The Afdeling advises deleting the phrase 'including the quality of the grid' because it limits the independence of the regulator ACM, which the minister rejects as consistent with EU rules on division of competences.
The Afdeling asks for justification of the accelerated pre-financing of grid investments under structuurvisie and ontwikkelkader given the global nature and uncertain costs of these documents.
The Afdeling makes editorial remarks, which are followed, and the minister adds the word 'doelmatig' in article 42b(5).

34475-H.s: This bill amends the 2015 budget statement of the BES-fonds (Caribbean Netherlands fund) by adjusting appropriations and expenditure figures, as a closing budget act (Slotwet). It takes effect the day after publication in the Staatsblad and applies retroactively to 31 December of the budget year.
q: Is amended, as shown in the corresponding budget statement attached to this act.
Wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

34725-J.s: This Slotwet amends the 2016 budget statement (begrotingsstaat) of the Deltafonds, adjusting appropriations and realisations across articles 1 to 7 in thousands of euros, and makes it effective from the day after publication, retroactive to 31 December 2016. The explanatory memorandum states that the bill contains only technical implementation, bookkeeping, and audit-finding adjustments, with some changes already shared with parliament via letters.
34725-J.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes as technical implementation, bookkeeping, and audit-finding adjustments, and as changes previously shared with parliament.
q: This bill contains only technical implementation changes, bookkeeping-type changes, or changes arising from audit findings.
In dit wetsvoorstel zijn alleen technische uitvoeringsmutaties, mutaties van boekhoudkundige aard of mutaties voortvloeiend uit controlebevindingen opgenomen.

34950-J.s: This bill adopts the closing budget adjustment (Slotwet) for the Deltafonds for 2017, amending the expenditure and revenue figures per budget article in thousands of euros. The explanatory memorandum describes technical execution changes, bookkeeping adjustments and control findings rather than new executive powers.
34950-J.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes as technical execution, bookkeeping and control-finding adjustments, with no delegation of rule-making power.
q: This bill contains only technical implementation changes, changes of an accounting nature, or changes arising from control findings.
In dit wetsvoorstel zijn alleen technische uitvoeringsmutaties, mutaties van boekhoudkundige aard of mutaties voortvloeiend uit controlebevindingen opgenomen.

34960-I.s: This bill amends the 2018 budget statement of the Royal Household (begroting van de Koning), increasing expenditure by EUR 803 thousand under the first supplementary budget. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and provides that the amendment takes effect on 1 June 2018, with retroactive effect if published later.
q: Is amended, as shown in the corresponding statement attached to this law.
Wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

35004.s: The bill amends the Wet opslag duurzame energie to set the sustainable energy surcharge rates for electricity and natural gas consumption for 2019 at specified euro amounts, alongside the existing 2018 rates. It enters into force on 1 January 2019, or on a date set by royal decree if the Staatsblad is published after 31 December 2018.
q: Whereas it is desirable to set the sustainable energy surcharge rates for the year 2019 on electricity and natural gas consumption
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat het wenselijk is tarieven voor de opslag duurzame energie voor het jaar 2019 vast te stellen

parties: Questions whether the government's tariff split respects the polluter-pays principle and whether the SDE+ reserve will be used only for renewable energy production.
Can the government confirm that this budget reserve will in future not be used for anything other than renewable energy production?
Kan de regering bevestigen dat deze begrotingsreserve in de toekomst niet zal worden gebruikt voor andere zaken dan hernieuwbare energieproductie?
Questions the basis for projected SDE+ spending and the growing reserve, and asks for the studies underpinning the 50-50 split and the household impact.
Argues the 50-50 split is unfair because a small group of companies uses most energy, and asks whether the surcharge could be broadened to energy saving.
Therefore a different split of the ODE surcharge costs between households and businesses should be applied than the government's 50-50 for 2019.``
Daarom zou een andere verdeling van de kosten van de ODE-opslag tussen huishoudens en bedrijven gehanteerd moeten worden, dan waar de regering voor 2019 aan vasthoudt (50%-50%).

35013.s: The bill amends the Crisis- and herstelwet to speed up housing construction and energy sustainability, mainly by shifting designation of experimental areas and projects from general administrative orders to ministerial regulations and by broadening and loosening the criteria for experiments and the projectuitvoeringsbesluit. It also moves several competences from municipal councils to mayors and aldermen and extends the list of laws from which experiments may deviate.
35013.j: The memorandum justifies the shift to ministerial regulations as avoiding time-consuming and uncertain AMvB procedures that slow down housing and energy projects.
q: Therefore this bill provides that adding concrete projects or areas to previously AMvB-regulated experiments can also take place by ministerial regulation.
Daarom wordt met dit wetsvoorstel geregeld dat het toevoegen van concrete projecten of gebieden aan eerder bij AMvB geregelde experimenten ook bij ministeriële regeling kan plaatsvinden.
d: designation of development areas for experiments
designation of local projects of national significance
Artikel I, onderdeel D (art. 2.4, eerste en vijfde lid)
experiments deviating from listed laws, including Erfgoedwet, Huisvestingswet 2014, Leegstandwet
Artikel I, onderdeel D (art. 2.4, vierde lid)
requirements for experiment applications and situations where experiments are excluded
Artikel I, onderdeel D (art. 2.4, vijfde lid)
extending scope of experiments to new areas and projects, with maximum duration
p: Expands the set of laws from which experiments may deviate and lets ministers add areas and projects by ministerial regulation without parliamentary scrutiny or a new general administrative order.
Moves competence for the projectuitvoeringsbesluit from the municipal council to mayor and aldermen and limits appeal to a single instance, shortening citizens' legal protection.
Requires only a no-objections statement from the municipal council before a permit can be granted, narrowing council control over deviating permits.
Artikel I, onderdeel C (art. 2.3, derde lid, onderdeel c)
Allows mayor and aldermen to designate categories of cases in which no statement of no objections is required.

parties: Asks how much the municipal council is involved in the proposed changes and what kinds of extra requirements may be set for new experiments.
To what extent is the municipal council currently involved in this?
In hoeverre is de gemeenteraad daar nu bij betrokken?
Supports faster housing but worries about citizen participation and the reduced role of the municipal council in project decisions.
The D66 members consider the involvement of residents and other stakeholders very important.
De leden van de D66-fractie vinden de betrokkenheid van bewoners en andere belanghebbenden zeer belangrijk.
Asks how democratic legitimacy, the position of third parties and legal protection are safeguarded and how careful deliberation is ensured.
The GroenLinks members consider it very important that decisions are democratically legitimised.
De leden van de fractie van GroenLinks achten het van groot belang dat besluiten democratisch gelegitimeerd zijn.
Questions the need for the expansion, the shift of power from council to mayor and alderman, and removing decisions from parliament to ministerial regulation.
This raises for these members the question of why the elected representatives are being kept further at a distance.
Het roept bij deze leden de vraag op waarom de volksvertegenwoordiging verder op afstand wordt gezet.
Objects that project deviations are removed from direct municipal council control and asks why democratic oversight is weakened.
Why does the government choose to weaken democratic control?
Waarom kiest de regering ervoor om de democratische controle af te zwakken?
Objects to shortened procedures, limited consultation and bypassing safeguards, and asks whether environmental and animal interests are adequately protected.
They ask whether speeding up the procedures by a number of months outweighs the loss of care.
Zij vragen of het versnellen van de procedures met een aantal maanden opweegt tegen het verlies aan zorgvuldigheid.
Supports the goal but asks whether the provincial executive's statement of no objections is needed and questions the case for a Wilg experiment.
They would like to know whether the government is willing to drop that statement of no objections.
Graag vernemen zij of de regering bereid is die verklaring van geen bedenkingen te laten vervallen.
Asks why the Raad van State's critical advice on ministerial regulation for designating projects is set aside and how much faster the process becomes.
These members would welcome further clarification of this acceleration.
Deze leden ontvangen graag een nadere duiding van deze versnelling.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advises that the bill amending the Crisis- and herstelwet to expand experimentation with Omgevingswet instruments may proceed, but asks for stronger motivation on the transition to the Omgevingswet, deletion of ministerial-regulation addition of new areas/projects, justification of broader scope of experiments, and consultation. The government's nader rapport accepts several points (more explanation in the memorie, monitoring of litigation, consultation justification) but rejects the core objection that adding areas/projects by ministerial regulation needs an AMvB, arguing such additions are a further elaboration not affecting the experiment's core.
concerns: The Afdeling asks for a substantive motivation of the necessity and effectiveness of broadening the scope of experiments (woningbouw and Huisvestingswet, Leegstandswet, Monumentenwet), which the government answers only by noting that the bill opens options for later experiments.

The Afdeling advises deleting the possibility to add new areas and concrete projects to existing experiments via ministerial regulation, arguing it requires an AMvB; the government rejects this, calling it a further elaboration rather than a change to the experiment's core.

The Afdeling warns that the Chw's time-unlimited deviation possibilities and overlapping plan types create complicated transitional law and uncertainty for municipalities and residents; the government nuances the time limit and points to transitional provisions in the Invoeringswet.

The Afdeling asks for explanation of the consequences of broader deviations for affected parties such as homeowners, including their rights and legal protection; the government says consequences will be described per experiment in the Bu Chw rather than in the bill.

The Afdeling asks for a fuller explanation of the transition from crisis law to transition law and of the complications it brings; the government agrees to clarify this in the memorie van toelichting.

The Afdeling asks that the title and preamble be balanced with the bill's main motive, and that the terms verzoek and aanvraag be aligned; the government adopts the redactional points except the preamble.
The Afdeling asks to explain the meaning of duurzame ontwikkeling as a criterion in relation to other legislation; the government adds this to the memorie van toelichting.

The Afdeling asks that the consultation with affected parties be carried out on the final proposal; the government points to earlier consultation and the voorhang for new experiments and adds a response to NEPROM.

35022.s: The bill amends the Woningwet to introduce a certification regime for work on gas-fired combustion installations, prohibiting such work by uncertified firms to reduce carbon monoxide accidents. Detailed rules are delegated to an algemene maatregel van bestuur, with the Minister of BZK designating certification bodies and schemes and overseeing the system.
35022.j: The memorandum justifies the broad delegation by the need for technical flexibility and the prevention of carbon monoxide accidents, following the Safety Board's recommendations.
q: Within the system of the Woningwet and the Bouwbesluit 2012, a broad delegation basis was chosen, whereby specific requirements for work on gas-fired installations are not already set out at statutory level.

Binnen de systematiek van de Woningwet en het Bouwbesluit 2012 is gekozen voor een ruime delegatiegrondslag, waarbij niet reeds op wetsniveau voorschriften worden gesteld aan de specifieke werkzaamheden aan gasverbrandingsinstallaties.
d: non-technical rules and prohibition on unlicensed gas installation work
rules on designation of certification bodies and conformity documents
p: Ministerial power to designate certification bodies and documents is established by general administrative order, with the Kaderwet zelfstandige bestuursorganen excluded for these bodies.
Enforcement of the certification requirement shifts from municipalities to the Minister of BZK, who designates supervisors with Awb inspection powers.

parties: Asks about the scope of the gas connection policy and the analysis of alternatives, and whether the conformity assessment bodies themselves will be supervised.
With that they form the linchpin of the new system. The members ask whether and how the CBIs are checked.
Daarmee vormen zij de spil in het nieuwe systeem. De leden vragen af of en hoe de CBI's gecontroleerd worden.
Supports the certification scheme but argues public supervision by municipalities should be reconsidered and asks about municipal accountability.
The CDA members believe public-law supervision of compliance by the municipalities should be reconsidered.
De leden van de CDA-fractie menen dat het publiekrechtelijk toezicht op de naleving door de gemeenten moet worden heroverwogen.
Asks about the cost of certification passed on to consumers and whether municipal inspection behind the front door is necessary.
Is it not the case that only the person performing the work (maintenance and/or installation) is certified, and not the installation?
Is het niet zo dat alleen de verrichter van de handeling (onderhoud en/of installatie) gecertificeerd wordt, en niet de installatie?

Criticises the government for not following the OvV recommendation of a mandatory uniform licensing scheme, the reliance on market parties to write certification schemes, the independence of conformity bodies, and weak enforcement without mandatory inspection access.

The SP members ask whether it is correct that the government is working with the same companies that were previously responsible for the aforementioned quality marks and recognitions for certification.

De leden van de SP-fractie vragen of het klopt dat de regering met dezelfde bedrijven, die eerder verantwoordelijk waren voor de genoemde keurmerken en erkenningen, in zee gaat omtrent de certificering.

35031.s: The bill amends the Dutch gambling tax law to extend the kansspelbelasting to providers and beneficiaries of land-based sports bets and totalisators, and to foreign-lottery prize recipients resident in the Netherlands, while adjusting cross-references and exemptions. It is mainly a tax-base and tax-liability change driven by European Commission concerns about equal treatment of land-based and online gambling.
35031.j: The memorandum justifies the change by pointing to the European Commission's view that land-based and online sports betting must be taxed equally, not by reference to new executive powers.
q: it is proposed to make providers of land-based sports bets taxable, with the gross gaming result as the base
wordt voorgesteld om de aanbieders van landgebonden sportweddenschappen belastingplichtig te maken met als grondslag het brutospelresultaat

parties: Asks about the status and timing of the online gambling bill, the size of the tax increase after the prize exemption, budgetary effects of changing the exemption, and how the sector is compensated and how concerns of operators and charities were addressed.
The VVD members ask how account has been taken of concerns about the effects of the change in gambling tax for sports betting providers on their operations and on charities.

De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen op welke manier rekenschap is gegeven aan de bezorgdheid over de effecten van de wijziging van de kansspelbelasting voor aanbieders van sportweddenschappen voor hun bedrijfsvoering en doorwerking naar goede doelen.

Asks whether the gambling tax system should be modernised and simplified given its diffuse structure, asks where the boundaries of private-circle games lie, asks how promotional games are classified, and asks why only part of the budgetary yield is returned to the sector.
The CDA members ask the government where the boundaries lie for these games within a private circle.
De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen de regering waar de grenzen liggen van deze kansspelen in besloten kring.
Asks for a breakdown of the net 12 million euro tax increase and how it compares with the large rise in effective tax rate from 5% to 29%.
How does the small amount of 12 million euro relate to the large difference in effective tax rate, which rises from 5% to 29%?
Hoe verhoudt het geringe bedrag van 12 miljoen euro zich tot het grote verschil in effectief belastingtarief, dat van 5% oploopt tot 29%?

Welcomes equal treatment of land-based and online operators but asks why the effective tax rate rises so sharply, whether the prize exemption lapses, the reason for the difference between the 13 and 12 million euro estimates, and the effect of possible abolition of dividend tax.
These members consider it a good thing that a fiscal distinction is no longer made between land-based and remote providers and that they will be treated equally after the law takes effect.

Deze leden vinden het een goede zaak dat er niet langer fiscaal onderscheid wordt gemaakt tussen landgebonden en aanbieders op afstand en dat deze na inwerkingtreding van de wet gelijk worden behandeld.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised that the bill on the gambling tax for land-based sports betting should be sent to parliament, but noted that other land-based games (lotteries, betting in general, prize contests) may face a similar differential tax treatment compared with online games, and asked the explanatory memorandum to address this and adapt the bill if needed. The government reply states that the bill covers the sports betting prize contests and totalisator, that lotteries are always classed as land-based under the KOA bill, and that the explanatory memorandum has been supplemented.
concerns: The Afdeling asked the explanatory memorandum to address whether other land-based games beyond sports betting create unequal tax treatment versus online games, and to adapt the bill if necessary to avoid unlawful state aid.
The Afdeling noted the broad term sportweddenschappen should be clarified, and the government explained it covers sports prize contests and the totalisator, with the memorandum supplemented.

35095-I.s: This bill amends the 2018 budget statement of the Royal Household (begroting van de Koning), adjusting the Second Supplementary Budget for 2018 in thousands of euros across articles 1 to 3. It sets the amended budget to take effect from 1 December of the budget year, with retroactive effect if published later.
q: Is amended, as shown in the relevant statement attached to this law.
Wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

35121.s: The bill amends the Scheepvaartverkeerswet, Havenbeveiligingswet and Wet voorkoming verontreiniging door schepen to create a legal basis for processing personal data of ship crew and passengers, implementing EU Directive 2017/2109 and related reporting rules. It also updates ministry names and adds data-processing provisions tied to ship safety, port security and waste reporting.
35121.j: The memorandum justifies the new data-processing powers by the need to implement EU directives and by ship safety, port security and efficient waste management, and cites Article 8 ECHR and Article 10 of the Constitution as requiring a formal-law basis.
d: rules on participation in shipping traffic, signs, data handling and River Information Services
Artikel I B (art. 4a, lid 1 and 3 Scheepvaartverkeerswet)
rules on protection of personal data processed for safety and shipping traffic
rules on equipment and software for River Information Services
designated competent authority for Rhine patent applicants and their health and criminal-law data
designated competent authority as controller for processing personal data for port security compliance
Artikel III B (art. 12aa Wet voorkoming verontreiniging door schepen)
designated competent authority as controller for processing personal data for waste reporting compliance
p: Artikel I B (art. 4a, lid 1 and 4 Scheepvaartverkeerswet)
Authorises processing of personal data, including health and criminal-law data, by the competent authority, with purpose limitations and retention limits stated in the memorandum.
Artikel II B and Artikel III B
Adds open-ended grounds for processing personal data for port security and waste reporting compliance and supervision, with the minister or designated authority as controller.

parties: Asks how compliance with the law is controlled, which service enforces it, what sanctions apply and how they are imposed, and whether registering passengers can help detect terrorists or unwanted persons.
The VVD members ask how monitoring of the law takes place.
De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen hoe controle op de wet plaatsvindt.
Welcomes the bill and has no further questions or comments.
The CDA members have noted the bill with approval and have no further questions or comments.
De leden van de CDA-fractie hebben met instemming kennisgenomen van het wetsvoorstel en hebben geen nadere vragen of opmerkingen.

35210-IIB.s: This bill amends the 2019 budget statement for the other High Councils of State, the Governors' cabinets and the Electoral Council, adding funds for the Council of State, the Court of Audit, the National Ombudsman and other bodies. It mainly re-allocates budget and makes the amendment retroactive to 1 June 2019 when published later.
35210-IIB.j: The memorandum justifies the budget increases by agreements on the task-and-resource analysis 2018–2021 with the Council of State, including digitalisation and organisational capacity.
q: For this purpose, additional funds have been added to the budget through 2021.
Hiervoor zijn tot en met 2021 extra middelen aan de begroting toegevoegd.

35211.s: The bill amends article 7.22d of the Water Act so that funds from the Delta Fund can also be used for subsidies to decentralised governments to combat water nuisance caused by heavy rainfall. The change itself is not a subsidy scheme; a separate subsidy regulation under the Framework Act on Subsidies will be drawn up later.
35211.j: The memorandum justifies the change by the need to enable subsidies to municipalities and provinces for combating water nuisance under climate adaptation policy, and notes that a subsidy scheme will follow under the Framework Act on Subsidies.
q: ARTICLE I In article 7.22d, seventh paragraph, of the Water Act, after 'other expenditures' the words 'and subsidies' are inserted.
ARTIKEL I In artikel 7.22d, zevende lid, van de Waterwet wordt na «komen voorts andere uitgaven» ingevoegd «en subsidies».

parties: Doubts that co-financing and subsidies will not shift tasks away from decentralised authorities or undermine primary Deltafonds tasks; asks for firm guarantees.
These members therefore have well-founded doubts about the guarantees that this amendment will not come at the expense of the primary tasks described in the Deltafonds.
Deze leden hebben daarom gegronde twijfel over de waarborgen dat deze wetswijziging niet ten koste gaat van de primaire taken zoals beschreven in het Deltafonds.
Asks whether the explanatory memorandum is enough to clearly ensure flood-safety investments remain the first priority, since the bill itself does not write that limit down.
The amendment does not clearly set out that limitation.](Hm)
In de wetswijziging wordt die beperking niet duidelijk vastgelegd.

Asks about criteria for effectiveness and efficiency, who checks them, how municipalities claim funds, co-financing shares, reimbursement if money is misspent, and whether municipalities have capacity.
They also ask by which concrete criteria efficiency and effectiveness will be tested and who will test them.](Hm)
Ook vragen zij langs welke concrete criteria «doelmatigheid» en «doeltreffendheid» worden getoetst en wie dit gaat toetsen.
Welcomes the bill as a good step for regional and local authorities; asks why the scheme is temporary and when it takes effect.
It is a good thing that regional and local authorities can request support from the national government for structural measures against water nuisance.
Het is een goede zaak dat regionale en lokale overheden steun kunnen vragen aan het Rijk voor structurele maatregelen tegen wateroverlast.

35300-IIB.s: This bill sets the 2020 budget (begrotingsstaat) for the minor Hoge Colleges van Staat, the Governors' cabinets of Aruba, Curaçao and Sint Maarten, and the Kiesraad, totalling about 133.8 million euros in expenditure and 5.9 million in receipts. The explanatory memorandum covers the Raad van State and the Algemene Rekenkamer, describing their budgets, caseload forecasts and tasks.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on 9 September 2019 that it had no remarks on the 2020 budget bills for the Other High Colleges of State, the Governors' cabinets and the Electoral Council (IIB), and recommended submitting them to the House of Representatives. The Minister of Finance's reply of 16 September 2019 states that some budgets require amendments, which are set out in annexes.

35310.s: The bill amends the Higher Education and Research Act to have the Minister designate a legal entity to collect and freely disseminate objective, reliable and comparable study-choice information and to run student satisfaction surveys. It also lets the Minister set the required student data and survey rules first by ministerial regulation, later by general administrative order, and allows revoking the designation if the entity fails its duties.
35310.j: The memorandum justifies the temporary delegation to a ministerial regulation by the need to hold a student survey in the 2019–2020 academic year, given the time needed for a general administrative order.
q: Temporary delegation to a ministerial regulation was chosen given the intended rapid entry into force of this bill.
Voor tijdelijke delegatie naar een ministeriële regeling is gekozen gezien de beoogde spoedige inwerkingtreding van dit wetsvoorstel.
d: student data and rules for survey data provision
student data and rules for survey data provision (replaces ministerial regulation)
p: The Minister may revoke the designation of the legal entity if it neglects its duties or fails the accounting and oversight requirements, giving the executive a control lever over the entity.

Personal data of students may be processed for the surveys, with the categories of data set by ministerial regulation and later by general administrative order, with the explanatory memorandum noting students retain rights of access, correction and objection.

parties: Asks how free-of-charge dissemination and continued availability of study-choice information will be guaranteed and what alternatives were considered.
Furthermore, the members of this faction read that the legal person to be chosen must distribute study-choice information free of charge.
Voorts lezen de leden van deze fractie dat de te kiezen rechtspersoon de studiekeuze-informatie kosteloos dient te verspreiden.
Sees no necessity to make study-information collection a public task in law and designate a legal person; prefers voluntary agreement and asks why the minister deems herself responsible.
Nevertheless, these members currently see no need to make the collection and dissemination of study information a public task by laying it down in law and designating a legal person for it.

Desalniettemin zien deze leden op dit moment geen noodzaak om het verzamelen en verspreiden van studie-informatie tot een publieke taak te maken, door deze vast te leggen in de wet en hiervoor een rechtspersoon aan te wijzen.
Probes privacy risks of person-level feedback of student answers, consent, rights of access and objection, and consultation with student bodies.
These members wonder whether feedback at person level could unintentionally lead to a serious infringement of students' privacy.
Deze leden vragen zich af of een terugkoppeling op persoonsniveau niet onbewust tot een grote inbreuk op de privacy van studenten kan leiden.

Supports the NSE but asks whether scope should widen, how manipulation is prevented, and cites the Algemene Rekenkamer's point that governance requirements (supervisory board, checks and balances) are missing from the statute.
In the statutory text, however, these requirements are not regulated, the Algemene Rekenkamer notes.
In de wettekst worden deze eisen echter niet geregeld, zo constateert de Algemene Rekenkamer.
Asks why private institutions are excluded from mandatory data delivery and what the real privacy obstacles are, and whether student bodies will be consulted on the implementing decree.
These members wonder why the umbrella organisations are involved in this, and not the student unions.
Deze leden vragen zich af waarom wel de koepels hierbij worden betrokken, en niet de studentenbonden.
Asks for justification of designating mandatory information provision as a public task and for the administrative burden impact.
The members of this faction point out that for sectors such as primary and secondary education no comparable obligation for institutions specifically aimed at school choice applies.
De leden van deze fractie wijzen erop dat voor sectoren als het primair en voortgezet niet een vergelijkbare verplichting voor instellingen geldt die specifiek op schoolkeuze gericht is.

35400.s: The bill ends the mandatory affiliation of Dutch primary-education and expertise-centre employers with the replacement-cost fund (Vervangingsfonds), and converts the unemployment-benefit equalisation fund (Participatiefonds) into a statutory body with a defined re-integration and administration remit. It also gives the Minister approval rights over the fund's statutes, power to withdraw its designation, and authority to set further rules by general administrative order (AMvB).
35400.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations as technical implementation of the fund's reform and notes that details will be set by ministerial regulation and in consultation with the Algemene Rekenkamer.
q: The board of the participation fund sets rules on how and under what conditions benefit costs are charged to the competent authority.
Het bestuur van het participatiefonds stelt regels vast voor de wijze waarop en de voorwaarden waaronder de uitkeringskosten bij het bevoegd gezag in rekening worden gebracht.
d: fund board sets rules on how and under what conditions benefit costs are charged to employers and the own contribution
further task description of the fund, conditions for ministerial approval of statutes, consequences of withdrawing designation
fund board rules on subsidies for activities, including a subsidy ceiling
fund board sets the periodic premium payable by employers
p: The Minister gains approval over the fund's statutes and the power to withdraw the fund's designation, strengthening executive control over a private-law body.
The Minister decides on exemptions from affiliation on religious or philosophical grounds, and the fund's conditions for exemptions are only partly fixed in statute.

parties: Asks how school boards that have not yet chosen self-insurance will be protected from financial problems when the Vf ends, and how the temporary safety net will work.
How will the government ensure that these school boards do not end up with a financial problem when the Vf is terminated?
Hoe gaat de regering ervoor zorgen dat deze schoolbesturen, bij beëindiging van het Vf, niet met een financieel probleem komen te zitten?
Asks whether employers accept the simplification of compensation grounds and how the reintegration duties and the Pf's added value relative to UWV are justified.

Asks for scenarios on the structure, scope and accountability and supervision of the temporary safety net and whether these will be assessed by the Algemene Rekenkamer, and how Vf cash flows are separated.
Is the government prepared to submit these scenarios for assessment to the Algemene Rekenkamer, these members ask.
Is de regering bereidt deze scenario´s ter beoordeling voorleggen aan de Algemene Rekenkamer, zo vragen deze leden.

Worries that the new rules make court dissolution via the kantonrechter more lucrative for school boards, risking mass judicial dissolutions, and asks how toezicht on the Pf's reintegration function is exercised.
These members ask how it will be prevented that this proposal leads to mass dissolutions by the kantonrechter.
Deze leden vragen hoe wordt voorkomen dat dit voorstel leidt tot en masse kantonrechterontbindingen.

Asks how the Pf's individual reintegration approach will work, whether reintegration within education is prioritised given teacher shortages, and what standards apply to school boards' proof of effort before dismissal.
When is, according to the government, this effort considered to have been met? Are certain requirements set for this by the government or the Pf?
Wanneer is volgens de regering voldaan aan deze inspanning? Worden hier bepaalde eisen aan gesteld door de regering of het Pf?
Asks whether the government considered giving school boards a renewed choice to opt out of mandatory Pf membership and self-manage unemployment benefits, with minimum wage-bill conditions.
Has the government considered offering that option for the Pf as well?
Heeft de regering overwogen om die mogelijkheid ook te bieden voor het Pf?

35570-K.s: This bill establishes the 2021 departmental budget statement for the Defence materiel budget fund, setting out commitments, expenditure and receipts in thousands of euros across maritime, land, air, infrastructure and IT materiel. It also contains standard entry-into-force and promulgation provisions.
q: Adopted departmental budget statement of the Defence materiel budget fund (K) for the year 2021
Vastgestelde departementale begrotingsstaat van het Defensiematerieelbegrotingsfonds (K) voor het jaar 2021

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State issued a blanket advisory opinion on the draft 2021 budget bill for the Defensiematerieelbegrotingsfonds, raising no remarks and advising submission to parliament. The Minister of Finance's nader rapport confirms the opinion and notes that amendments are being made to several other budgets.

35850-J.s: This bill amends the 2021 budget statement of the Deltafonds (Delta Fund) through a first supplementary budget, adjusting commitments, expenditure and receipts across investment, water management and experimentation articles. It is a budgetary adjustment that takes effect the day after publication and is backdated to 1 June 2021.
q: We have deemed it appropriate ... the budget statement of the Delta Fund for the year 2021 is amended
Wij Willem-Alexander ... hebben goedgevonden en verstaan ... de begrotingsstaat van het Deltafonds (J) voor het jaar 2021 wordt gewijzigd

35975-B.s: This second supplementary budget bill amends the 2021 budget statement of the municipal fund (gemeentefonds), raising the commitment amount for the general and supplementary grants to EUR 29,238,583,000 and setting the integration and decentralisation grant commitments. It takes effect the day after publication and is retroactive to 1 December 2021.
35975-B.j: The memorandum justifies the amendment by the need to adjust the fund's budget statement and notes that revenues and expenditures of the fund must balance per grant year, without any new delegated power.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the budget statement of the municipal fund for the year 2021
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van het gemeentefonds voor het jaar 2021

36003.s: This omnibus bill makes numerous technical and minor corrections across Justice and Security laws, including civil code, criminal procedure, police, gambling and immigration statutes, and renames a few bodies. It also makes targeted substantive changes such as extending the Public Prosecution Service's debt-collection powers to the Minister for Legal Protection, adding a police-data access route for the gambling authority, and clarifying criminal procedure on terrorism-related measures.
36003.j: The memorandum justifies the technical delegations as routine and the substantive changes as corrections of earlier omissions or needed clarifications, and cites advisory consultations.
q: At present, however, the confidentiality provision of Article 22(1) Wwft stands in the way of efficiently sharing information obtained from Wwft supervision when carrying out tasks under the Gambling Act.

Op dit moment staat echter de geheimhoudingsbepaling van artikel 22, eerste lid, Wwft in de weg aan het efficiënt delen van informatie verkregen uit Wwft-toezicht bij de uitoefening van de taken op grond van de Wok.
d: designation of electronic facilities for procedural documents
rules on when a work is deemed out of trade
p: Allows direct transfer of police data to vetting authorities and the intelligence services without the usual intermediate safeguards.
Permits the gambling authority to receive anti-money-laundering supervisory information, for purposes defined in the Gambling Act, despite the confidentiality rule.
Concentrates complaints about non-prosecution of police use of force in a single appellate court, a specialised judicial safeguard.
Lets the prosecution seek authorisation to apply imprisonment as a coercive measure against juveniles for unpaid confiscation orders, subject to a judge's decision.

parties: Asks why certain amendments already published in the Staatsblad have not entered into force and about how the Wet Amicus curiae and related provisions are being implemented, plus questions on rehabilitation of convicted terrorists.
The VVD members have taken note with interest of the Omnibus Justice and Security Act 2022 (hereinafter: the bill).
De leden van de VVD-fractie hebben met belangstelling kennisgenomen van de Verzamelwet Justitie en Veiligheid 2022 (hierna: het wetsvoorstel).

Objects to bundling diverse and contested measures into one omnibus act, and to the government adding amendments after Council of State advice, which bypasses advisory review; also questions the scope of the GVM expansion and data sharing safeguards at the Kansspelautoriteit.
These members consider this an undesirable course of events.
Deze leden achten dit een onwenselijke gang van zaken.
Asks when the separate bill on raising the penalty for human smuggling will be submitted and about the effects of preventive measures against terrorism.
These members therefore ask the government to submit the bill to the House as soon as possible and to indicate in this letter when they expect to do so.
Deze leden vragen de regering daarom zo spoedig mogelijk het wetsvoorstel aan de Kamer voor te leggen en middels dit schrijven aan te geven wanneer ze dat verwachten te doen.

Shares the Council of State and NOvA objections to extending the GVM via an omnibus act, argues it is a substantial expansion rather than clarification, and questions the lack of evidence of recurrence reduction and the review grounds for ECtHR and CJEU rulings.
Endorses the Council of State's view that the GVM extension is not a purely technical change and warrants a separate bill, and asks about the compensation measure for juveniles.
They are of the view that this is not merely a technical proposal and that a separate bill is justified.
Zij zijn van mening dat hier niet sprake is van een louter technisch voorstel en een aparte wetsvoorstel gerechtvaardigd is.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering advised against including the increase of maximum penalties for people smuggling and the power to impose a GVM for terrorism convictions in an omnibus bill, recommending separate bills instead. The government followed the advice on people smuggling by dropping that change but did not follow it on the GVM, arguing the change is merely clarifying and fits the omnibus bill.
concerns: Increasing maximum penalties for people smuggling does not fit an omnibus bill as it is neither technical, clarifying nor minor policy; the government dropped this change.

Adding terrorism-preparation and related offences to the GVM grounds goes beyond clarification since several listed offences do not clearly target bodily integrity; the government considers it merely clarifying and kept it.
Extending the GVM is premature given the pending evaluation of the Wlt and no demonstrated effect on recidivism; the government disagreed and maintained the change.

The relationship between the criminal GVM and existing administrative terrorism measures under the Twbmt raises an open question, which the government answered by noting the two frameworks differ in nature and complement each other.

36021.s: The bill approves the 2021 Tel Aviv treaty between the Netherlands and Israel on the status of their armed forces for the European part of the Netherlands, as required under article 91(1) of the Constitution. The explanatory memorandum notes that some provisions have direct effect and that Israeli personnel cannot be sued before Dutch courts for loss, damage or injury arising from military activities.
36021.j: The memorandum justifies the jurisdictional immunity for military activities by stating it follows from the treaty's allocation of competences, with no further explanation given in the extract.
q: If Israeli Personnel causes loss, damage or injury to Dutch third parties during the exercise of Military Activities, those third parties will not be able to summon them before Dutch courts, and vice versa.

Ingeval Israëlisch Personeel aan Nederlandse derden dus verlies, schade of letsel berokkent tijdens de uitoefening van Militaire Activiteiten, zullen zij door deze derden niet kunnen worden gedagvaard voor Nederlandse rechtbanken, en andersom.
p: Under the treaty, Dutch third parties harmed by Israeli personnel during military activities cannot sue them in Dutch courts, removing a judicial remedy for citizens.

parties: Asks the government to confirm the agreement creates no obligation to cooperate militarily with Israel and which other countries have similar agreements.
The CDA members ask the government to reconfirm that the Status of Forces Agreement between the Netherlands and Israel does not oblige the Netherlands to cooperate militarily with Israel.

De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen de regering nogmaals te bevestigen dat het Verdrag tussen de regering van het Koninkrijk der Nederlanden en de regering van de Staat Israël inzake de status van hun strijdkrachten Nederland geen verplichtingen geeft om militair samen te werken met Israel.

Criticises cooperation with an occupying power, questions compatibility with international law and the ICC, and asks whether prosecution of participants can be waived and whether the agreement can be terminated.
These members ask whether under this agreement it is also excluded that the government exempts participants in these activities from possible prosecution by the International Criminal Court.
Deze leden vragen of het overeenkomstig dit verdrag ook is uitgesloten dat de regering deelnemers aan deze werkzaamheden vrijstelt van mogelijke vervolging van het Internationaal Strafhof.
Worries about Israeli violations of international law and asks about the consequences for the agreement if the ICC finds war crimes, and how Palestinian rights are safeguarded.
They ask what the consequences for this agreement would be if the ICC, after its ongoing investigation, concluded that Israeli forces were guilty of war crimes in occupied territories.

Zij vragen wat volgens de regering de gevolgen zijn voor dit verdrag wanneer het Internationaal Strafhof na het momenteel lopende onderzoek 1 zou concluderen dat Israëlische strijdkrachten zich schuldig hebben bevonden aan het plegen van oorlogsmisdaden in bezette gebieden.
Asks for legal advice on international-law risks, disclosure of the memorandum of understanding, and how democratic parliamentary control over annual cooperation plans is guaranteed.
Opposes closer military cooperation with Israel over alleged human rights violations and cyber-espionage, and asks whether cooperation can be suspended if war crimes occur.
