The BIJ1 member asks why military cooperation with an occupying power is desired by the Netherlands.
Het lid van de BIJ1-fractie vraagt waarom militaire samenwerking met een bezettende mogendheid door Nederland gewenst wordt.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised, on 15 December 2021, that it had no substantive remarks on the bill approving the 2021 Tel Aviv agreement on the status of Dutch and Israeli armed forces, and recommended submitting it to the Tweede Kamer. The Minister of Foreign Affairs, on behalf of the Minister of Defence, forwarded the bill and the advice to the King, noting that no changes were needed.

36030.s: This first supplementary budget amendment to the 2022 departmental budget of the Ministry of Justice and Security raises commitments and expenditure by €35 million, mainly for COVID-19 support to gemeenten and businesses checking the Coronatoegangsbewijs (CTB). It takes effect on 26 January 2022, with retroactive effect if the Staatsblad is published later.
36030.j: The memorandum justifies advance funding before parliamentary authorisation by the need for essential checks on the CTB during the pandemic.
q: Compliance with and control of the Coronatoegangsbewijs (CTB) are essential to managing the coronavirus pandemic.
De naleving en controle van het Coronatoegangsbewijs (CTB) zijn essentieel in de beheersing van de coronapandemie.

36102.s: The bill bans trust service providers in the Netherlands from offering or using so-called doorstroomvennootschappen (pass-through companies) for clients, and bans trust services involving high-risk third countries or non-cooperative tax jurisdictions. It amends the Wet toezicht trustkantoren 2018, adds criminal enforcement under the Wet op de economische delicten, and sets a six-month transition period.
36102.j: The memorandum justifies the exemption power by noting that some services, such as stichting administratiekantoor, do not carry the identified risks and could be exempted by ministerial regulation.
q: Provision is made for granting exemption from the ban by ministerial regulation.
Er is voorzien in de mogelijkheid om bij ministeriële regeling vrijstelling te verlenen van het verbod.
d: exemptions from the ban on pass-through company services

parties: Asks how the ministerial exemption power will avoid arbitrariness and whether a separate assessment framework will be drawn up, and how enforcement capacity at DNB is assessed.
How will arbitrariness in granting exemptions be prevented? Is the government willing to draw up a separate assessment framework for this?
Hoe wordt willekeur bij het verlenen van vrijstellingen voorkomen? Is de regering bereid hier een apart toetsingskader voor op te stellen?
Questions the link with the broader analysis of the future of the trust sector and the reporting duty for unusual transactions, and asks how relocation of services is monitored.
These members ask how an integrated approach to trust services from the Netherlands is secured.
Deze leden vragen hoe een integrale aanpak van de trustdienstverlening vanuit Nederland wordt geborgd.
Asks for justification of the integrity-risk finding and clarification of the scope of the exemption power by ministerial regulation.
The PVV members ask for a justification of this finding.
De leden van de PVV-fractie vragen naar een onderbouwing van deze constatering.
Asks whether DNB is equipped for the additional enforcement tasks and whether definitional clarity has been achieved after DNB's comments.
The CDA members ask whether DNB is sufficiently equipped for this and whether expansion of enforcement capacity is necessary and/or desirable.
De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen of DNB hier voldoende voor is toegerust en of uitbreiding van de handhavingscapaciteit noodzakelijk en/of gewenst is.
Asks why the advice of the Commissie doorstroomvennootschappen was not followed and how DNB can check whether services move into illegality.
The SP members ask the government to justify why it does not follow the advice of the Commissie doorstroomvennootschappen in identifying shell companies.

De leden van de SP-fractie vragen de regering te motiveren waarom niet wordt aangesloten bij de adviezen van de Commissie doorstroomvennootschappen bij het identificeren van doorstroomvennootschappen.
Supports tighter regulation but prefers a full ban; asks why the committee's recommendations were not adopted and whether a notification duty could replace the licence requirement.
However, these members wish to note that they favour a complete ban on trust services given their very limited social contribution and major risks of abuse.
Wel willen deze leden opmerken dat zijn voorstander zijn van het volledig verbieden van de trustdienstverlening gezien de zeer beperkte maatschappelijke bijdrage en grote risico's op misbruik.
Asks which countries are classified as high-risk and what will happen to the services after entry into force, and whether supervision should be placed with DNB.
In light of this, has the government considered placing these services under a specific sector with a gatekeeper function and supervision by, for example, De Nederlandsche Bank?

Heeft de regering in het licht van dit laatste overwogen om de onderhavige dienstverlening onder te brengen bij een specifieke bedrijfstak met een poortwachtersfunctie en toezicht door bijvoorbeeld De Nederlandsche Bank?

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised splitting the trust-services bill because the non-urgent measures (ban on pass-through companies and on services involving high-risk third countries) lack the urgency of the Russia/Belarus emergency measure, and asked for justification of the measure's reach over EU citizens. The government reply reports that the bill was split, that the non-urgent measures are now in a separate bill, and that the proportionality question was addressed in the explanatory memorandum.
concerns: The Afdeling asked whether the ban on services to Russian and Belarusian residents, which also affects EU citizens, is proportionate and whether less far-reaching options were considered; the government added to the explanatory memorandum.

The Afdeling said the non-urgent measures lack an urgent character and should not be processed in an emergency procedure, so they should be submitted as a separate bill; the government split the bill.

The Afdeling flagged possible tension between the ban on pass-through companies and the European Commission's Unshell proposal; the government explained the two measures are distinct and added clarifications to the explanatory memorandum.

36120-IIA.s: This bill amends the 2022 budget of the Staten-Generaal (States General) through a first supplementary budget, raising appropriations by about EUR 29 million in commitments and expenditure. The increases mainly fund the Eerste Kamer apparatus, the Tweede Kamer apparatus, fractions, parliamentary inquiries and wage and price adjustments, and the bill takes effect retroactively from 1 June 2022.
q: About EUR 1.7 million is added to the budget of the Eerste Kamer for professionalising the civil service organisation of the Eerste Kamer.
Er wordt circa € 1,7 mln. aan de begroting van de Eerste Kamer toegevoegd voor professionalisering van de ambtelijke organisatie van de Eerste Kamer.

36200-IIB.s: This bill adopts the 2023 budget statement (begrotingsstaat) for the other High Colleges of State, the Governor's cabinets of Aruba, Curaçao and Sint Maarten, and the Electoral Council (IIB), in thousands of euros. The explanatory memorandum describes the budgetary goals and policy changes of these bodies, including new tasks for the Electoral Council and the Council of State.
q: This follows the advice of the Council of State's Advisory Division and the interdepartmental policy review on Kingdom relations to substantially expand the overview of state expenditure on Caribbean Netherlands.

Dit naar aanleiding van de voorlichting van de Afdeling advisering van de Raad van State (RvS) en het Interdepartementale Beleidsonderzoek Koninkrijksrelaties (IBO) om het overzicht Rijksuitgaven aan Caribisch Nederland aanzienlijk uit te breiden

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State raised no remarks on the 2023 budget bill for the other High Councils of State, Governors' cabinets and the Electoral Council (IIB) and advised submission to the Tweede Kamer. The Minister of Finance's nader rapport states that some budgets require amendments, which are set out in attached annexes.

36210.s: The bill broadens the mandatory local consultation ordinance into a participation ordinance covering preparation, implementation and evaluation of policy in municipalities, provinces, water boards and Caribbean public bodies. It anchors a right to challenge (uitdaagrecht) letting residents and civil-society parties take over execution of public tasks, under conditions set by the council.
36210.j: The memorandum justifies the decentral discretion by saying participation supplements representative democracy and that councils should decide how participation takes shape locally, while the council keeps its headship role.
q: For this reason the government leaves the council free in this bill to decide how participation takes shape in the municipality.
Daarom laat de regering in dit wetsvoorstel de vrijheid aan de raad om te beslissen op welke manier participatie in de gemeente vorm krijgt.
d: conditions under which residents take over municipal tasks
conditions under which residents take over provincial tasks
conditions under which residents perform water board tasks
Artikel IV A, lid 2 (Wet openbare lichamen BES art. 154)
conditions under which residents perform island public body tasks
p: Artikel I A, lid 3; Artikel II A, lid 3; Artikel III; Artikel IV A, lid 2

Residents and civil-society parties may be permitted to carry out execution of public tasks normally held by the executive, under council-set conditions, with the executive remaining politically accountable.

parties: Asks who bears liability and accountability when residents take over municipal tasks, and insists that representative bodies keep control over participation frameworks.
Control over the frameworks for citizen participation must rest with the representative bodies.
De zeggenschap over de kaders van de burgerparticipatie moet bij de vertegenwoordigende organen worden belegd.
Welcomes participation but asks for a clear framework and conditions, and questions how participation can be broadened to a more representative group.
These members stress the need for a clear framework and conditions to align expectations of all stakeholders in the democratic process.
Deze leden wijzen tegelijkertijd op de noodzaak van een helder kader en randvoorwaarden om de verwachtingen bij alle stakeholders in het democratisch proces op een lijn te krijgen.

Supports the participation regulation and statutory right to challenge but asks whether codes and rules on responding to citizens are actually enforced, and whether challenges could be used as cost-cutting.
Does the government share the view of these members that the right to challenge should not be seen as a cost-cutting measure?
Deelt de regering de mening van deze leden dat het uitdaagrecht niet mag worden gezien als een bezuinigingspost?
Doubts the bill addresses the growing disengagement of lower-educated citizens and warns participation may widen the gap and become a cosmetic fix.
The question for them is whether the proposal is a suitable solution, and they have serious doubts about it.
De vraag voor hen is dan ook of het onderliggende voorstel daarvoor een geschikte oplossing is en hebben daar grote twijfels over.
Asks how practical and legal obstacles to the right to challenge will be removed and how it applies to tasks under joint arrangements.
Many practical and legal obstacles are currently experienced with the right to challenge in practice.
Er worden nu in de praktijk veel praktische en juridische belemmeringen ervaren bij het uitdaagrecht.
Welcomes the bill as strengthening local democracy and trust, while asking what it can and cannot deliver and how to reach a broad group of residents.
They see that there is considerable organising capacity in society, among citizens, neighbourhoods and communities.
Zij zien dat er een groot organiserend vermogen is in de samenleving, onder burgers, in buurten en gemeenschappen.
Questions whether the bill adds real value, whether it could narrow municipal autonomy, and whether it risks privatisation and commercialisation of public tasks.

Relays the Raad van State concerns that participation may undermine representative democracy, give disproportionate influence to small groups, and endanger public law safeguards such as transparency and equal treatment.
Finally, the Division points out that certain safeguards must be observed when carrying out government tasks.
Tot slot wijst de Afdeling erop dat bij het uitvoeren van overheidstaken bepaalde waarborgen in acht moeten worden genomen.
Supports broader participation but insists on transparency about who influences policy and warns against participation becoming a box-ticking exercise.
These members want to prevent this from happening again.
Deze leden willen voorkomen dat dit nu weer gebeurt.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division's opinion of 1 October 2020 concludes that the bill strengthening citizen participation at local level (participatieverordening and uitdaagrecht) is insufficiently motivated and advises fundamental reconsideration, with serious doubts about necessity, problem analysis, effects on representative democracy, delegation of public tasks and legal safeguards. The government's nader rapport of 19 September 2022 responds point by point, largely clarifying the aims, adding justifications and accepting some adjustments while maintaining the bill's core.
concerns: The Afdeling finds the problem analysis and necessity of the bill inadequately motivated; the government clarified the aims and added background but did not fundamentally change the bill.
Concern that citizen participation may undermine the representative democracy and the hoofdschap of the councils; government argues councils retain final responsibility and set the frameworks.

Concern that public-law safeguards (transparency, equal treatment, legal protection) may be compromised when tasks are delegated to citizens; government points to existing legal frameworks and guidance.

Concern that the scope and limits of delegating public tasks to citizens under the uitdaagrecht are left unclear and largely to local authorities; government added some examples and clarified the medebewind distinction.
Terminology adjusted (gemeentebestuur, provinciebestuur, eilandsbestuur, waterschapsbestuur; 'opgedragen' replaced by 'gevorderd' in medebewind provisions) and differentiated entry into force added.

36300.s: The bill adds article 107b to the Vreemdelingenwet 2000 creating a legal basis for processing biometric data (facial scans) at automated border control e-gates for unique identification and verification of travellers, with retention limited to 24 hours. The Minister may attach conditions and restrictions to such processing by ministerial regulation.
36300.j: The memorandum justifies the new processing basis by the compelling general interest in efficient, effective border control given rising passenger numbers, staff shortages and the need for automated checks where manual checks are not feasible.
q: This bill provides a basis for making a facial scan of the e-gate user for the purpose of unique identification and verification of the traveller's identity for border control.

Dit wetvoorstel regelt een grondslag om een gelaatsscan van de gebruiker van de e-gate te kunnen maken met het oog op de unieke identificatie en verificatie van de identiteit van de reiziger ten behoeve van grenscontrole.
d: conditions and restrictions on biometric data processing at e-gates
p: Creates a statutory exception to the GDPR prohibition on processing biometric data for border control via automated e-gates, limited to unique identification and verification and to what is necessary for border control.
Limits retention of biometric data to a maximum of 24 hours, a safeguard for travellers' data protection.

parties: Supports e-gates for border security and shorter waiting times, asking questions on EU alignment, retention period and whether all controls should move to e-gates.
These members consider it important that there is a legal basis to make a facial scan of an e-gate user for the unique identification and verification of travellers' identity for border control.

Deze leden vinden het belangrijk dat er een wettelijke grondslag bestaat om een gelaatsscan van een gebruiker van een e-gate te kunnen maken met het oog op de unieke identificatie en verificatie van de identiteit van reizigers ten behoeve van grenscontrole.

Not fully convinced the compelling general interest justifies processing special personal data; asks about bias in algorithms, use for investigation after a hit, and privacy/data-breach risks of 24-hour storage.
The Self-Service Passport Control System (SSPC) appears, however, to be a far-reaching step in processing special personal data.
Het Self-Service Passport Control-Systeem (SSPC) lijkt echter een vergaande stap te zetten in het verwerken van bijzondere persoonsgegevens.
Asks the government on what basis the 24-hour retention period rests and why it is not longer.
These members ask the government what the 24 hours is based on, what legal basis it has, and why it is not a longer period.
Deze leden vragen de regering waarop die 24 uur is gebaseerd, welke juridische grondslag dit heeft en waarom dit geen langere termijn betreft.

Biometrics are special personal data to be used only for weighty interests; questions necessity versus less invasive systems, proportionality and subsidiarity, error margins, access safeguards, effects on asylum access, and voluntariness of biometric processing.
These members note that biometric characteristics are counted as special personal data and must therefore be handled with the utmost care and processed only for weighty interests.

Deze leden constateren dat biometrische persoonskenmerken worden gerekend tot de bijzondere persoonsgegevens en daarom alleen met de grootst mogelijke zorgvuldigheid moeten worden behandeld en alleen bij zwaarwegende belangen mogen worden verwerkt.
Asks whether the system will make more errors for people with darker skin and whether such people will be checked more, and requests monitoring results be shared with the House.
what measures the government then intends to take.
welke maatregelen de regering dan van plan is te treffen.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advises (5 October 2022) on a bill amending the Vreemdelingenwet 2000 to create a legal basis for biometric processing at automated border control (SSPC e-gates). It raises concerns about accuracy and indirect discrimination by skin colour and gender, and about the unclear relationship to the EES regulation and the amended Schengen Borders Code; the government's reply (31 January 2023) explains testing, notes ongoing research, and clarifies the explanatory memorandum.
concerns: The Afdeling asks the explanation to address the accuracy of the SSPC system across skin colour and gender and how indirect discrimination is prevented or justified; the government responds with testing history and ongoing TNO research and clarifies the memorandum, without full empirical resolution.

The Afdeling notes the explanatory memorandum unclearly positions the national bill relative to the EES regulation and amended Schengen Borders Code; the government clarifies the transitional scope and the delayed entry into force of those regulations.

36435-J.s: The bill amends the departmental budget statement of the Delta Fund for 2023, adjusting commitments, expenditures and receipts across articles such as flood safety, freshwater supply and water quality, in line with the supplementary budget of Budget Day. It sets the budget in thousands of euros and makes the amendment effective the day after publication, retroactive to 19 September 2023.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the Delta Fund for the year 2023
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Deltafonds (J) voor het jaar 2023

36470-K.s: This bill amends the 2023 departmental budget statement of the Defence Materiel Budget Fund (K), adjusting commitments, expenditure and receipts across material, infrastructure and IT lines in the second supplementary budget. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and makes the change effective the day after publication, retroactive to 1 December 2023.
q: Whereas the need has become apparent to amend the departmental budget statement of the Defence Materiel Budget Fund (K) for the year 2023
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Defensiematerieelbegrotingsfonds (K) voor het jaar 2023

36550-L.s: The bill amends the 2024 budget statement of the National Growth Fund (Nationaal Groeifonds) through a first supplementary budget, changing expenditure and commitment figures for its policy articles on knowledge development, research and innovation, and infrastructure. It also sets the amounts in thousands of euros and provides that the law takes effect the day after publication in the Staatsblad, retroactive to 1 June 2024.

36560-K.s: This bill amends the departmental budget statement of the Defence Materiel Budget Fund (K) for 2023, setting out the final (slot) budget adjustments to appropriations and commitments by article. It is a routine budgetary law that adjusts figures and carries no new delegation of rule-making power.
q: The Slotwet for the Defence Materiel Budget Fund (K) contains technical implementation changes, accounting-type changes, and changes arising from audit findings.
In de Slotwet voor het Defensiematerieelbegrotingsfonds (K) zĳn technische uitvoeringsmutaties, mutaties van boekhoudkundige aard of mutaties voortvloeiend uit controlebevindingen opgenomen.

36613-L.s: This bill amends the 2024 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of the National Growth Fund, lowering commitments and expenditure across the knowledge, research and innovation, and infrastructure articles. It sets the budget in thousands of euros and takes effect the day after publication in the Staatsblad, retroactive to 17 September 2024.
q: The budget statement of the National Growth Fund (L) for the year 2024 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.
De begrotingsstaat van het Nationaal Groeifonds (L) voor het jaar 2024 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

36740-K.s: This bill (Slotwet) adjusts the 2024 departmental budget statement of the Defence Materiel Budget Fund (K) to record final budget variances, with amounts in thousands of euros. It enters into force the day after publication in the Staatsblad, with retroactive effect to 31 December of the budget year.
q: The Slotwet for the Defence Materiel Budget Fund (K) contains technical implementation changes, bookkeeping-type changes, and changes arising from audit findings.
In de Slotwet voor het Defensiematerieelbegrotingsfonds (K) zĳn technische uitvoeringsmutaties, mutaties van boekhoudkundige aard of mutaties voortvloeiend uit controlebevindingen opgenomen.

36850-I.s: This bill amends the 2025 budget statement of the Crown (Koning I) through a second supplementary budget, adjusting appropriations and receipts by small amounts in thousands of euros. It sets the effective date and orders publication in the Staatsblad.
q: Is amended, as shown in the corresponding statement attached to this law.
Wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.
